text.96395: The... Thane... my mighty... Thane... he... needs to... rest. Please... help him... help him... rest... Consumed... by... ancient... grudge... No... rest...
text.3461: Tymor didn't give me anything to pay you with, so I suggest you take it up with him when you get back to Ironforge. I'm sure he'll still be in his place in the Mystic Ward. Just go knockin' and make sure he pays you good. This place ain't no picnic... that's for sure. Thanks again for helping him out though, and good luck. Oh, and I don't need the drawing kit. Why don't you just bring it back to Tymor when you go to see him?
text.96435: <Felflick cackles gleefully as he regards the bloody bones of the Ashen Reign leaders.> Oh this is just perfect! <Felflick hops back and forth in his cage, snickering all the while.> Now it is time to give those warlocks the fate they deserve. There is a massive bone pile to the west of here if you follow the road. Trust me, it's impossible to miss. That's where all their 'failed' experiments go. That is where I wish to dump these fools' remains. Let the whole world know what failures they are!
text.92527: I dispatched a local courier to deliver a vital piece of correspondence to Valanaar yesterday and it seems the messenger never made the delivery! When I reached out to the intended recipient in Valanaar today via the sending stones I received word back that they had no record of receiving my courier. I need you to find that useless courier and ensure that he's not drinking his wage away, passed out at some vagrant camp in the wilds. The message was of the utmost importance and is... highly sensitive.
text.8857: I'm looking for battle hardened adventurers willing and able to get a fresh husk sample from the fallen Colossus of Ashi to Oglethorpe in Booty Bay. No, no, I wouldn't want you to go anywhere near that thing's corpse. Just take one of my samples and make it snappy. These things are no good to him rotten!
text.96776: I have had a vision. Deep in the place known as Maraudon, past the earth song falls, there is a chamber filled with brilliant white crystals and guarded by mighty giants. At the highest part of this chamber is a crystal of exceptional brilliance. It is an aspect of the sun god, the right eye of the Earthmother herself--An'she. I've dreamed of its radiance and it calls to me. {class}, remove An'she's Radiance from that place and bring it here where it belongs, under the open skies of Mulgore.
text.4726: I have been studying the dragonkin of the Burning Steppes for weeks, and I think I've finally had a breakthrough! I created a device--I call it the Draco Incarcinatrix 900. It can capture the essence of dragon whelp broodlings! Or, at least I think it can. Here, take the device and zap a broodling in the Burning Steppes with it. While it's under the device's effects, defeat the broodling and its essence should be released. If it is, then splendid! Bring me back samples so I can study them!
text.8770: As the war effort mounts, the silithid presence in the area presents an ever increasing threat to our operations. You've been selected to partake on an assault on Hive'Ashi where your primary target will consist of Hive'Ashi defenders. Report back to Commander Mar'alith after your task is completed.
text.321: The shipwrecks off the shore here are the doomed Third Fleet of Kul'Tiras, burned and sunk by Red Dragons during the last Great War. The Fleet hailed from Lordaeron, but one ship, an Elvish Destroyer: Flying Osprey, was with it. It was shipping a load of Lightforge Iron and joined the Third Fleet for protection. Ironic that it sunk to the same dragons... Enough history. The Flying Osprey is wrecked to the south of Menethil Harbor. If you find the Lightforge Iron there, bring it to me.
text.95320: There is a caged demon just up the road near the entrance of the demon caster encampment that has been making a great deal of fuss. All this ranting and raving about imprisonment and freedom. Something about scorching bones and revenge? <The crow leans in and gives you a mischievous look. As if to emphasize, she then dangles an iron key in one of her talons.> Let's see if we can't make a deal with our little 'friend' and see what he knows about these nasty demon casters.
text.4402: It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials. <Galgar wipes his brow.> If only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat. I'll tell you what, <name>. If you bring me 10 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures, and a free training manual, too. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
text.98216: Old Gods?! This cannot be good news at all! I've made out a new bit on the stone that speaks of a guardian of some kind. Whatever it is, it must be linked to the stone! Take it with you and see if you can find a big Titan construct of some sort in the excavation. Read this here final passage on the stone and see what happens! If I'm right, you'll activate the thing. Take it out if so, but try to preserve anything interesting! We simply must know more!
text.95615: If you don't mind, I'd like you to do the honor of lighting these memorial candles. Go to the cemetery just outside and place a fresh candle wherever you see one that's gone out. Such a task is a far cry from the excitement of your other adventures, I'm sure. Think of this as an opportunity for service and reflection--a quiet moment to acknowledge those who left this world before us, so that we might carry on and make it a better place.
text.97281: <Before you is a strange orb with a dull surface. When picked up a small electrical current seems to vibrate from within. Upon closer inspection, it looks as if a dark mist swirls within and every so often a small electrical spark can be seen. It is clear the harpy was using it for some purpose. Perhaps Rezlak would be interested in this object?>
text.93949: We've been bugged. It's skyhopper season in the lowlands, which means the pests are everywhere. One of the High Order mages reported that one of the insects that they killed had an enchantment of some kind placed upon it. When we inspected it closely it seems to be some sort of listening spell. We suspect that the cult is using these enchanted insects as spies. Go and exterminate them for us. You won't be able to tell which are enchanted by looking at them, so you'll just have to kill them all.
text.95285: <Sergeant Ulka struggles to sit up to speak with you. You offer your hand in aid, but she merely swats it away.> Alright recruit... let's get you caught up.
text.84014: We still need more Moonroot to reverse the Nightmare Incursions. Travel through the Emerald Portal in Dream Bough and bring me back some.
text.8240: The destruction of the various Hakkari Bijous is of grave importance to us, so much so that we welcome outsiders of the tribe to do so for themselves! Take any one of the bijous that you find in Zul'Gurub to the Altar of Zanza and destroy it. For this one time alone, I will give you an additional Honor Token from our tribe; this is above and beyond what you would normally receive. Witness for yourself the blessings of Zanza!
text.95198: Take this. It's a handy bit o' glamour that the mages back home put together to make a quick disguise. It'll make you look like a Kul Tiras Marine which should do nicely for this mission. Sneak in to the tower and do yer best to listen for any mention of the man that washed up on the beach. I warn you though, do not get too close to Jaina. She will see right through this disguise. Come back and see me if you lose your disguise, I'll set you up with a new one.
text.95066: The message we've delivered is clear. Return to Brant within the keep and show him the report. I'm certain he'll be pleased with our progress.
text.1093: Terrible what the Venture Company has done here, eh? What were they thinking? Goblin company hiring a gnome! Lucky for me, Sputtervalve knows a genius when he sees one. Hired me just after I'd been kicked out! Tells me they built some enormous woodcutting machine, and Sput' wants me to steal the plans for him. Unfortunately, Gerenzo--bloody gnome--wants me dead on sight... maybe you could steal the plans for me? You should be able to find them on one of their operators.
text.94331: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Huge Thorium Battleaxe, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.96959: War. By the time I heeded the call of our clans, the battle had passed, and only ashes answered my blade. My purpose is forged anew. This mountain remembers strength--ancient power riding its winds and holding its water. I would earn the right to walk its spine, to reach the fallen stronghold that lies upon the road to the summit. Demons profane these graves. Before I fight at your side, I must know you stand capable. Light the two bonfires and return to me. Their flames draw our enemy out.
text.85600: Zanza can create the ancient troll enchantments with the right components. The first is a primal Hakkari idol that must be taken from the most powerful of the Hakkari lieutenants: Jin'do and the Bloodlord. The second is a punctured voodoo doll. These can be found in the piles of refuse that litter this foul place. Look inside the jinxed hoodoo piles. Bring me these things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
text.95293: Those goods you procured from the Eastsea pirates were supposed to be shipped directly to me. That means ol' Bentcoin thinks he can muscle in on my turf. Looks like he's fixin' to start a trade war. We, however, are civilized people. Lesson two, lackey. We don't need to stoop to their level. Take this crate I made 'specially for the good captain. You'll find him on his ship along the Eastwind Shore. He deserves a reward for his shrewd negotiatin' tactics.
text.97290: You... abomination... Why should... help you... Be gone...
text.323: Morbent Fel is a necromancer, and an ally to the dark riders. I would pit you against the power of Morbent Fel, but I will not send you against that vile fiend without first knowing your strength. You have already proven your bravery to me, but if you truly wish to face the necromancer, then you must now prove your skill against his minions.
text.95122: Those Eastsea pirates you whacked, while dangerous, were just the small fries. They've got bigger, badder brothers in arms north of here. They ransacked Windstead--took all the plunder they could, then burned it to the ground. They've gotta be stopped before their turf gets any farther inland. Thin out their ranks so that doesn't happen.
text.129: Can you do me a favor? I've prepared a lunch for Guard Parker, but he's out on patrol...he's a big, strong Stormwind guard who can defend himself, but it's much too dangerous out there for a townsperson like me. So if you deliver his lunch for me, then come back here and I'll give you a free lunch! Parker patrols the stretch of road leading to Duskwood.
text.99079: The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid. This is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety. I must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.
text.2418: A while ago, I had an incident with the Shadowforge Dwarves. They brought me to Angor Fortress to study two types of strange stones from Uldaman. I discovered that the stones were sustained, stable power sources if treated correctly. It's amazing the things one can find in that old dig site! Anyway, after I told them the secret of the stones they kicked me out of Angor Fortress and began digging for more in Uldaman. I want those stones for myself! Bring me both types and I'll pay you plenty!
text.54: <name>, you are a {class} with proven interest in the security of Northshire. You are now tasked with the protection of the surrounding Elwynn Forest. If you accept this duty, then I have prepared papers that must be delivered to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire. Goldshire lies along the southern road, past the border gates.
text.92749: Industrial sabotage? You've got my attention! We'll start with some dynamite...
text.4362: It would seem as if my old adversary, Dagran Thaurissan, has me and the kingdom of Ironforge at his mercy. You may be my last hope, <name>. You must rescue my dear daughter, Moira! There is only one way to make sure that the spell Thaurissan has cast on Moira is broken: Kill him. And <name>, do not harm her! Remember, she is being controlled by Thaurissan! The things she may do or say are a result of Thaurissan's evil spell!
text.93035: You need not peer far to see the undead shambling about ahead of us, but have you noticed something unusual about them? They walk on two legs, not four! These skeletons are not even our fallen kin. The Magram must be defiling the bodies of those who died long before the Desolace was our domain. I cannot imagine how they justified turning their backs on Mother Theradras and took to desecrating corpses that have rested here for centuries. Put the undead to rest, <name>.
text.8279: The Twilight's Hammer are not kind to those that leave their ranks. They hunt me to this day like I'm some sort of beast! Needless to say, an enemy of theirs is a friend of mine! To decipher this Tablet I'll need the book used by their scribes to encode secret messages: the Twilight Lexicon. It's such an important tool that they keep its three chapters in different locations! The officers entrusted with the Lexicon are known as Twilight Keepers, look for them at the Twilight's Hammer camps.
text.95163: As you can see, there are more pigs strewn about the valley than there are in their pens. Gorgegut has been less than an ideal farmhand, but he keeps the humans away. Some of the little ones have escaped across the river. They're still too small to be harvested out in the field so we need to return them here. Take this stick and give them a good swat! That should send them scampering back to their pens.
text.92449: Ever since we escaped the war we have struggled to secure our safety, surrounded by foes on all sides, beset by constant danger. Our old holdout to the east is overrun with undead. These scourge meander mindlessly--a sad but dangerous remnant. Without the guidance of their commanders, they are lost... but still deadly. Though we've tried, we have yet to succeed in eliminating their presence. At the very least, with your help, we can push them back to secure our safety... for now.
text.878: You must strike my enemies. <snort> You must help Mangletooth and the Razormane by weakening the Bristlebacks. Both tribes are very spiritual--tied to the earth and its power. <snort> It gives us strength in all things... especially war. If you want to find out who really causes Thork <snort> and the Horde such anguish, then help Mangletooth! You attack the spiritual leaders of the Bristlebacks to the north; weaken them so the Razormanes can defeat them and rule the Barrens.
text.97173: The Blackmaw furbolgs in the mountains overlooking Azshara have been dabbling in dark magic. While a primitive people being corrupted by demonic magic is nothing new for Azeroth, Lan'dalock and I would like to study their spell foci. Travel to the stronghold known as Blackmaw Hold and recover one of the Blackmaw Ritual Totems for us. Only the most powerful of the Blackmaw's shamans will be carrying one of these, so bring allies and take care.
text.8598: <The text on this note is made up of various typefaces glued onto the parchment's surface.> We've got your precious book, gnome. If you ever want to see it again, you'll do exactly as we ask. <A detailed set of instructions is listed, spanning 3 pages.> Bring the money and come alone!
text.762: Ambassador Infernus was sent to Angor Fortress by Ragnaros himself to mind the Shadowforge seeking lost artifacts in Uldaman. It has already meant tremendous casualties for our people, but it has obviously grown worse. I hesitate to guess how many artifacts they would be able to find and use against Ironforge. Our goal is simple, {class}. Return to the Badlands and destroy Ambassador Infernus. Once the threat is eliminated, return to Advisor Belgrum with proof of your victory. It is in your hands now.
text.913: The thunderhawk, <name>, is a fierce beast. It is time for you to face them. You must find where it roams, and bring me its wings as proof of your successful hunt. Do this, and your time with me will near its end.
text.92596: The aura of arcane energy that surrounds you is strong, even though you are not initiated as a mage. I am quite sure that you are going to be a capable adventurer, and your connection with our ancient magic will only ever be a boon to you even if you were to never utter a single word of power in spellcasting. Come, let us sit and speak some on my order, the nature of the arcane here on Zephras, and the plight of our people.
text.1137: Indurium has an amazing resistance to heat! I'm sure it will work for Fizzle's pistons. But he'll need true indurium ore, not just the flakes. To get the ore, it must be mined from deep within Uldaman, on the northern borders of the Badlands. That is the true source of indurium. Send Fizzle Brassbolts my regards, and tell him what I told you. Safe travels, <name>. And it won't surprise me if we meet again -- once Fizzle learns of indurium he'll probably send you to Uldaman to acquire it!
text.3122: Here are the herbs, <name>. Take them to Witch Doctor Uzer'i. Please let him know that I am satisfied with the shrunken head.
text.84161: Hail, {class}! I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world. Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this. Perform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers. I'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus. Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
text.84377: The deed is done. Dal'rend Blackhand, Warchief of the Dark Horde, lies dead at your feet. Take his head and present it to Master Shaw.
text.9233: Wilhelm, If you are reading this, I have perished - finally. I want you to know that my dying thoughts revolved around you and your ineptitude when it comes to tradeskills. Unfortunately, the bearer of this handbook is in even worse shape than you in regards to crafting. About the book: These are the rest of my recipes. Make the bearer of this book whatever they request. I'm sure you will charge a hefty fee for your services because you are, after all, a bastard. In Disdain, Omarion
text.6626: The Forsaken do not pass on their... illness... from what I have seen. This diplomat seems to be granting undeath to would-be followers. I am beginning to think he is one of the Scourge. For now, my concern is not with him though, it's with the growing ranks around him. They creep from the shadows daily, almost begging him for more power. I'm not powerful enough to fight them on my own, <name>. What do you say? Are you up for some hunting?
text.2398: The dig site at Uldaman wasn't always overrun. We Ironforge dwarves used to control the area, but... that was before the troggs came. They came so fast and in such numbers that not even dwarven might could stop them! In fact, their attack was so sudden that I fear some of our people may be trapped behind enemy lines. My friend Baelog led a small band of dwarves deep within the site just before the troggs showed up. If he and his company live, then I want you to find them.
text.8185: Zanza can create the ancient troll enchantments with the right components. The first is a primal Hakkari idol that must be taken from the most powerful of the Hakkari lieutenants: Jin'do and the Bloodlord. The second is a punctured voodoo doll. These can be found in the piles of refuse that litter this foul place. Look inside the jinxed hoodoo piles. Bring me these things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
text.3914: After a strong flash of light, you are able to pick up the sword again. It has been transformed!
text.8928: The core will provide us with enough juice to power our device; now we just have to build a rod that can channel that energy without melting. I met an imp in Winterspring that sold all manner of exotic goods. He had an elemental rod that would do perfectly. I'm kicking myself in the head right now for not having bought it. He lives inside a cave in the entrance to Darkwhisper Gorge. Sneak in there and try to find him. Make sure he only charges you forty gold; that's the price he quoted me!
text.5762: I have a package for an old customer of mine, a dwarf named Hemet Nesingwary. The package took weeks to arrive, and Hemet's long gone by now. He said he was going to Stranglethorn to hunt the beasts there, but he left me some money to send his delivery when I could. Hemet's a rich dwarf and it's a good idea to keep up relations with the rich ones, yeah? So... you want to deliver the package for me? I heard Hemet has a camp in Stranglethorn, north of Grom'gol.
text.94314: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Cindercloth Robe, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.8592: The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity. They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos. In my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns. But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs. Bring me the components I require, <name>. I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.
text.5222: Two cauldrons have been successfully opened; while you will be able to access them indefinitely, we still want to open up the other two that remain. This will provide all of us with more options to introduce the counter agent! This time, you'll be hitting the Writhing Haunt's cauldron. It is almost due east of Andorhal, relatively close to the ruined city walls; again, eliminate the cauldron lord present there for its key. Use this bottle to obtain the sample from the cauldron. Good hunting, <name>!
text.525: I decrypted the letter, but I don't know what to make of it. You found this among thieves in the Alterac foothills? Very strange... You should take this to the magistrate of Southshore. Although this letter is cryptic, his is the closest town to Alterac; if a threat is brewing, then he should know.
text.81781: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in Forest Song. Defeat the satyr Zalius there and return to me.
text.6403: It has been quite the adventure, friend. I owe you a great debt of gratitude. Perhaps, when all is said and done... As you have no doubt ascertained by now, Lady Prestor is Onyxia: Brood of Deathwing, twin to the tyrant of the Spire, Nefarian. For too long she has held our kingdom in her captivating gaze. Even the Highlord is controlled by her trickery - a puppet. It all ends today... The spell will be broken. Worry not, for together, we shall be victorious! Are you ready?
text.8936: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux. I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin. Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade. I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
text.94872: The fierce Magram are undoubtedly winning the war of territories at the moment. While we can all be thankful the clashes haven't erupted too frequently throughout the desert, every day their village just to the east grows a little bigger; their soldiers a little bolder. I worry gravely about the consequences of an unchecked Magram clan, but I cannot deny their potential as an ally. If you wish to earn their trust, offer this sack of totems to their quartermaster, but be careful.
text.2941: I have studied many subjects in my time, and my latest fascination is with the snapjaw that occupy the beach in the Hinterlands. There's one in particular I'd like to see, a giant snapjaw named Gammerita. I'd like to go myself, but my research keeps me here. I think a picture of her would be the next best thing. Take this letter to Curgle Cranklehop in Tanaris. She has created an invention for me that can capture a picture. She called it a "snapshot," I think...
text.98685: This Libram is unlike the others. A most unique piece. It will not provide greater ability to dispatch one's foes, nor survive their assault. No, this is used to allow the binding of certain beings. I don't believe Master ever did successfully find a vessel for it. I will require a pristine black diamond, large brilliant shards, and an arcane crystal in order to fashion this. You'll likely find it where the binding ritual itself took place. The Master thought it would be of use.
text.459: Something evil is brewing in the forests of Teldrassil. Look long the hills to where the peaceful furbolgs used to dwell. They have deserted their homes and are amassing under the name of the Gnarlpine tribe. Only the corruption of wicked Fel Moss could cause such a transformation. The grells and grellkin have infested the area and are threatening the residents of Shadowglen. Engage these grells and grellkin, <name>, and see if they are indeed caught under the enchantment of the wicked Fel Moss.
text.7101: Towers and bunkers are important positions, and we must capture and hold them all! So to that end, I want you to attack a bunker that is controlled by the enemy. To do that, enter one with an Alliance banner. You will see another banner inside. Pull out that banner, and a white Horde banner will appear in its place. Well done! At that point your task for me will be complete, but if you hold the place long enough, and if the Alliance doesn't take it back, then it will be destroyed!
text.5361: My brother Nataka is stationed at Ghost Walker Post over in Desolace. I'd like to ask you... could you give this report to him for me? A year has passed since the last time I wrote, there has been unusual centaur activity since then and he should be informed. Journey to Stonetalon Mountain north of the Crossroads, and then head west into Charred Vale. From there, head south into Desolace; there you will find a road going south to Ghost Walker Post.
text.94997: We mustn't linger. Take these to the keep at once. Find Ashe Amberhall. She may be a pain, but she's well respected in her field of study. Perhaps she can shed some light on what energies are contained within these objects.
text.94241: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Dark Leather Tunic, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.9013: A truly amazing story, <name>! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past. As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
text.80154: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
text.602: From what I've heard, the mages of Dalaran are busy with the reconstruction of their destroyed city, I'm sure you can find one of them who will spare some time to look at the bracers. If there's anything I know about mages, they can't resist a magical puzzle. Take the bag of water elemental bracers and see if they can shed any light on the Stone's curse. Look for the Archmage Ansirem Runeweaver in particular. I've dealt with him before, and his knowledge is vast.
text.92644: <You reach beneath the still-warm body of the turncoat cultist and recover a small, glowing blue crystal. It appears to be damaged, but it may still be important. High Elder Shadowsong may be interested in this.>
text.94242: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Pilferer's Gloves, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.2768: Sergeant Bly stole from me! He said he'd only borrow it, but he stole my cherished divino-matic rod!! Without that rod how will I know where to dig new water holes?? Find Bly and bring me my rod! I heard he led his band of ill-reputed adventurers to go treasure hunting in Zul'Farrak to the west. I bet you'll find him there. Let's hope the trolls took care of him, because if you have to fight him for the rod then you're in for a serious fight.
text.9007: A truly amazing story, <name>! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past. As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
text.6543: I recently deployed a few scouts into Ashenvale and I need a runner to take them their orders, and bring me back a report of what they have observed. Your first stop should be the Zoram'gar Outpost, along the coast to the west, at the Zoram Strand, to locate the first runner. You also need to stop at Splintertree Post, to the north, and along the road to the east, near Azshara. You will find a scout and an outrider there. Give them each a report, and from them, get an update on their findings.
text.8693: I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, <name>. I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, {class}. I shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course. I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp. I promise you won't be disappointed.
text.5601: I fled Lordaeron during the great war, and was lucky to escape before the Scourge swept through my homeland and turned it into a plagued nightmare! I was lucky, but my family was not. I fear they were all killed during the battle of Darrowshire. Darrowshire is a village in the Eastern Kingdoms, nestled in the southern hills of what is now the Eastern Plaguelands. Will you go there and search for my family? I miss them so much, especially my little sister Pamela. Please, find her for me!
text.9018: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us. The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for. I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
text.95483: Thrall needs to know what happened here. I will meet up with Ulka and see to it that he is fit to travel before returning to Orgrimmar, so I am trusting you to bring this information to the warchief in my stead. Go now, soldier of the Horde. Tell our warchief what fate befell Varian Wrynn.
text.732: I heard from Sigrun that you have been a great help to him. Perhaps I might enlist your help. I was sent here by my master, Krasus of the Kirin Tor, to put an end to the trouble brewing in Lethlor Ravine. I cannot divulge the exact nature of my assignment here or the tasks that I must undertake, but be assured it is of vital importance. A band of wandering ogres, sometimes seen near Camp Boff, stole an object called the Sign of the Earth; I must have it. Bring it to me, and I will tell you more.
text.684: A bounty has been placed on the head of Marez Cowl, a high-level advisor and operative of the Syndicate. She was last seen within the Syndicate controlled territory of Stromgarde. Bounty may be collected from Captain Nials. Be warned: Marez is a skilled and cunning Warlock, known for her trafficking with demons. Extreme caution is advised when hunting her.
text.3542: Andron Gant is my next contact. He usually holds himself up in the Undercity... right near the Apothecarium. He was a little more loose-lipped when it came to speaking about what he wanted the Tablet for. Apparently some of the mages of Undercity are looking to study some of the arcane spells the highborne used. They think this tablet will help them. Markri was adept at summoning creatures; especially elementals. Take the Tablet of Markri and return to me for your part of the reward.
text.8963: {class}, listen closely. Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade. Isalien, our priestess, grew up in Winterspring at Starbreeze Village. I need you to gather a Starbreeze Village Relic from the Frostmaul giants of Frostwhisper Gorge in southern Winterspring, who are known for raiding to the north from time to time.
text.2318: At an impasse of sorts, you know that you will need the book translated into a language you can understand. There certainly are a number of people in the world who could do it; the closest location that might have someone who could, however, is the Kargath outpost in the Badlands. Perhaps that is a good place to start.
text.94339: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Field Repair Bot 74A, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.92751: You need something destroyed? Would this have anything to do with your activities in Moonbrook? Don't look surprised. SI:7 stays apprised of all that goes on in Stormwind's lands. If you're planning to set off an explosion in the caves below Westfall, you'll want to be well outside beforehand. Take this remote detonator--it's a recent prototype from our own engineers. Oh--and it would be best if you didn't mention my involvement to your elf friend.
text.82002: These new Land Mines work like a charm, but we can't just be playing saboteur. We're gonna need a few upgrades to our own rides so they don't call foul play. So we need to do the most obvious upgrade there is, a sweet paint job. And you don't even got to ask what color we are using! Hotrod red baby! The fastest color there is! Who know who's got the perfect red tint? Those Scarlet Crusade jabronis. Why don't you go sneak into Hearthglen and find me some of that nice scarlet dye.
text.9096: As a Watcher, I was allowed access to many of Medivh's personal effects. Among those items, I found the tomes most enlightening. While the majority of the books were filled with - to put it bluntly - tripe, there were some gems. One of those tomes documented the creation of a set of armor fit for an archmage: Frostfire. <Angela points to her head.> It's all in here and I am willing to share the fruits of that knowledge with you as long as you are able to provide me with the necessary materials.
text.986: <name>, your skills have already helped me in my endeavor. Could I impose on you again to help Grimclaw and his master Volcor? In addition, I can craft you a magical cloak that will allow you to walk unhindered by Darkshore's creatures while you look for him. To create the cloak, I'll need five fine moonstalker pelts from a moonstalker sire or matriarch to have enough material. The cats can be found near Wildbend River to the south, or even farther south near Ashenvale.
text.5243: I look at my undeath as a malady, {race}. An illness that merely requires treatment; however, it is also a great blessing for the Argent Dawn. What better vessel to smite the heathens of the Scourge than through the undead? I am revered by my colleagues because of the sacrifices I have made, but the accolades mean nothing to me. If you are interested in assisting the Argent Dawn, then a job I can offer. Venture to Stratholme and recover our surplus of holy water. Search the supply crates.
text.1431: Be still, {class}, and allow me to share with you something important to our people, but far from obvious. We are a proud race, and the war with the humans tried even Thrall's great patience. You see, our Warchief is wise and prudent, and he continues to put his people first. Ultimately, he is a diplomat, and in his time with the humans he learned much of their ways. If the tale I've started piques your interest, then find Keldran near the western exit of the city. His hovel is there.
text.5533: On the island of Caer Darrow lies Scholomance - a wretched center of Scourge necromancy and evil. Our enemy dwells within, conducting unspeakable acts of depravity on unwitting victims... at least, we surmise as much. A door bars the way, and try as we might no entry is to be had without a proper key. Alchemist Arbington is well versed on Scholomance, and has an idea how to obtain a key. You have proved your worth to me, and now I entrust this task to you. Speak with him on this matter.
text.88758: I just need to finish repacking, and I can get out of here! If you'll do me one last favor, here--take this note to Corma. It'll let her know that I'm alive and I'm on my way!
text.1385: Desolace is a land at war. The centaurs wage war with each other, and we believe the victor among them will spill out and threaten our strongholds. That, we cannot allow We must learn how to beat the centaurs, and to do that... we must ally with one of the clans. The Magram centaurs war with the Gelkis. If you fight the Gelkis then the Magram might consider an alliance. Earn the favor of the Magrams then speak with Warug, in the Magram village in southeastern Desolace.
text.92894: I can see the excitement in your eyes, outsider. Do you grasp the potential of necromancy yet? Of course you do. And that is why I am ordering you to hone your skills further. As you venture deeper into the Valley of Bones, you will see the remains of failed attempts at raising the dead. Gelkis attempts, no doubt. Hardly able to claw out from the dirt. Funny, were it not so pathetic. I have imbued your staff with greater power. Use this to grow our army, and crush the ones that fight back!
text.7722: When that bastard, Maltorius, left our clan, he left with something more valuable than a pristine arcane crystal: Our recipe for fiery flux! I'd bet anything that the recipe was part of the deal in his new promotion amongst the Dark Irons. I want you to get our secret plans back, <name>. I'm sure they're somewhere near Maltorius, deep inside the Slag Pit.
text.9244: Thanks to you and Omarion, may he rest in peace, I am now able to create Icy Scale bracers. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
text.8407: Don't forget the fight for Warsong Gulch is about more than just protecting trees. It's about keeping a natural barrier between Ashenvale and the Barrens. Do you bring any news from the battlefield, <name>?
text.7862: With the loss of Guard Captain Malkhor, the position of Guard Captain of Revantusk is once again open. If you are interested in becoming Captain of the Guard for Revantusk, complete the following tasks and submit your application to Primal Torntusk: Exterminate Vilebranch Berserkers. Exterminate Vilebranch Shadow Hunters. Exterminate Vilebranch Blood Drinkers. Exterminate Vilebranch Soul Eaters.
text.4970: If you wish to prove yourself, you may begin by doing a very simple, but very important task. Gather meat from the chimaera and from the shardtooth bears in the area. Bring it to me so that I may use it to feed the frostsabers that are being trained.
text.5065: The troll with whom you spoke did not tell the truth. The two tablets you gained for him spoke of containing the essence of Hakkar, but there is more to that legend. I have studied long, and found that there are six Tablets of Mosh'aru, not two! Six! And I fear that we will not like what secrets the others hold.. Find the third and fourth tablets of Mosh'aru. They're in the Eastern Plaguelands, held by the mossflayer trolls. Find them, and bring them to me.
text.95809: I need a moment to rest before I find my own way out. <He pulls some reeds from his pack and quickly braids and bends them into a heart.> Take this, and bring it back to Caitlin. Let her know I'll be home soon! Now that we have a path cleared out thanks to you, I'll gather my bushels and follow your trail. Thank you.
text.7067: Though exiled as a heretic, my beliefs still ring true--that alone drives me onward. But for my destiny to be complete, I need the aid of an outsider... one not of any centaur tribe. The task requires someone to enter the holy halls of Maraudon--a tomb my people protect, and only the most devout are ever allowed to enter. If you agree to aid me, then you need only nod. I will pass you a parchment with my instructions on it. Read it over and consider my words.
text.7871: Beyond this tunnel you will find a field of strife and turmoil, young {class}. The Horde continue to decimate our sacred forest, cutting down the evergreen foliage to power their machines of war. Enter Warsong Gulch and defend Silverwing Hold. Push back the invading Horde forces! Do this, and earn a talisman of merit. Bring me such a talisman, <name>, and I shall reward you.
text.368: While you were collecting samples for me, my experiments led me to realize that more reagents will be required for this new disease to spread properly. Poisoning some hapless victim is child's play. Plaguing an entire world proves to be a bit more complicated. I will need 5 Vile Fin Scales from Murlocs in the vicinity. You will find the creatures along the coast to the north or to the west.
text.94254: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Greater Adept's Robe, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.4447: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a night dragon plant. The fruits that hang from the plant appear rotten and poisonous. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
text.8541: The Cenarion Hold guard is in short supply of grinding stones. Procure a batch and deliver them immediately to Captain Vish Kozus in Cenarion Hold.
text.9226: Greetings, friend. Have you insignias of the Dawn or the Crusade that you would like to redeem for items of power? Items offered to those revered amongst the Dawn are priced quite reasonably. I encourage you to make a purchase!
text.85633: It yearns to grow, <name>. The talisman has soaked in all that you have done. The thousands of troll corpses littering Zul'Gurub have fueled its power. Hand it to me and I shall make the final enhancement.
text.8597: I knew that book would come in handy some day! Thankfully, I had the wit and foresight to stow it somewhere safe. Don't worry, it's in a place that nobody could ever hope to find it! I needed a gyrocopter just to get there the first time. Unfortunately I crashed it on the beach on my way back. It was through that accident that I gained these super-gnomish psychic powers! Look for my crashed gyrocopter somewhere on Land's End Beach and swim south from there! You'll know the spot when you see it!
text.6804: A force of elemental scouts was sent to the eastern plaguelands of Lordaeron, and the disease of that place twisted and infected them. The Waterlords cannot allow this affront to our purity! Take this vial. In it is a quantity of one aspect of Neptulon. If used on the plagued elementals it will fight the poison within their bodies and cure them! But their inner conflict will drive them into a surging madness. Defeat the discordant surges and bring me their bracers of binding.
text.95294: Friz sure knows how to get her point across. Well, you won't hear any objections from me. The Eastsea pirates won't interfere with her business. In exchange, maybe we can come to an arrangement. Pirating's a little difficult when you've got a scorned goblin sending marauding adventurers after you all day. Run along back to your master, {class}. Let Friz know there's a new captain in charge, and he foresees a profitable relationship in our future.
text.6032: Although the people of Timbermaw delight in the feel of runecloth, it is not sacred to us. But mooncloth is sacred. Bring me a small supply of this holy cloth, and I will teach you a secret fashioning technique.
text.85622: We Zandalar invest power in those who speak with the authority of divinity. Our priests are more than just healers - they are our confessors. Evil comes both from outside threats - such as Hakkar - and from within the tribe. Our confessors act as the judges amongst us, preserving us from the same evil that devoured the Gurubashi from inside itself. Go to Zul'Gurub and bring back the Paragons of Power from the Gurubashi. Learn what it means to be the confessor, and preserve us from evil.
text.9100: As a Watcher, I was allowed access to many of Medivh's personal effects. Among those items, I found the tomes most enlightening. While the majority of the books were filled with - to put it bluntly - tripe, there were some gems. One of those tomes documented the creation of a set of armor fit for an archmage: Frostfire. <Angela points to her head.> It's all in here and I am willing to share the fruits of that knowledge with you as long as you are able to provide me with the necessary materials.
text.5045: Warriors of all types <snort> have need of a strong spirit. It drives you to greater feats when all hope has been lost. This is not unknown to the <snort> Razormane. We are a spiritual tribe--we are more proud of our connection to Agamaggan than our prowess <snort> in battle. Bring me 4 blood shards and I will bless your spirit for battle. <snort>
text.84159: Hail, {class}! I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world. Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this. Perform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers. I'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus. Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
text.1398: I owe you greatly, <name>. An honorable heart beats within you. And now I have another task for which I humbly ask your aid. If I'm ever to reach Nethergarde, then I must fix this wagon. And for that... I will need wood. Strong, dry wood--not the spongy, tangled wood of the swamp's trees. <name>, go east to the coast and search for driftwood that has been dried by the sun. Bring it to me.
text.94974: The moulding is crude and worn, but we may be able to fashion a key. It may take some time to gather the components necessary. I'll keep these embers running hot while you gather the materials.
text.3508: You are foolhardy, <name>. It is an admirable quality of your kind - to blindly enter battle when you have little to no chance of success. I will assist you, if only to see just one of Razelikh's minions fall. To break the ward placed over Razelikh's subordinates will take time and require the acquisition of rare artifacts. Be still, I must first perform the enlightenment ritual. The information I gather will assist me in forging weapons of great power.
text.696: Here's what your lookin' for: Trelane's phylactery, Trelane's orb, an' Trelane's ember agate. All three should be in chests within the tower an' you shouldn't have a problem opening the chests on your own; you just have to be careful of the ogres. The tower's defenses won't take care of 'em on their own; you'll need to have your weapons at the ready. Those ogres find out you're there and stealing from 'em, an' they'll be sure to put the hurt on you. Be careful, an' good luck.
text.807: My scouts report that some of the Durotar wildlife have become infected with a demonic taint. They were seen to the north and west. They wander among their brethren as normal beasts, but evil powers flow through them, and burning within each one is a heart scorched by black magic. These beasts must be destroyed! If you find such an animal while you explore Durotar, kill it and collect its Scorched Heart. Bring the hearts to me and I will have them studied, then destroyed.
text.93835: Lorthuna fled up to the spires above using some sort of portal. Ayessa and Elaadrin went in after her. That was just a few moments ago. I'm afraid I took one too many hits and this is where I stay. Go through the portal, find Elaadrin and help them stop Lorthuna. Unless that help that Elaadrin and Ayessa said they sent for arrives soon, you are on your own from here. Good luck, {class}.
text.69: Oh my! Must have missed this the first time. In the registry, right beneath the first address for Stalvan there's another one listed, only partially scratched out. Looks like he was headed to The Lion's Pride Inn over in Goldshire. Might want to check there, <name>.
text.67: Stalvan, eh? Let me check the town registry. Stalvan. . .Stalvan. . .let's see. Ah, here we go! I have a record of a Mr. Stalvan Mistmantle. The last recorded address is the Moonbrook Schoolhouse. My, talk about outdated! Do me a favor will you, friend? If you happen to go out to Moonbrook, let me know if you get any update on this fellow. I like to keep the records clean.
text.8587: I'm a goblin of my word, kid. Here's your 500 pound chicken. What a gnome wants with a 500 pound chicken, I'll never know... <Dirge grumbles something unintelligible.> Probably to sleep in it... Dirty gnomes...
text.92469: You've done enough here, {class}. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there. Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
text.389: VanCleef and I were members of the Stonemasons Guild. Our main project was to rebuild Stormwind after the War. When we had finished our duties, we were cheated. The nobles refused to pay us for our work. Some of the more senior of the Stonemasons were offered governmental jobs, but VanCleef refused it out of loyalty to all the Stonemasons. He led a riot and left the city, swearing revenge. His lieutenant, Bazil Thredd, might know more about VanCleef's plans. He's being held prisoner in the Stockade.
text.1282: I can't help it if I feel sorry for ol' Jim there. He wasn't always like that. Ran an inn out in the marsh for a while, wonderful place. Look, I don't really want to talk about it. Bring it up with Captain Vimes if you really have to.
text.93552: Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us. You'll find raw windstones scattered around the grove. Think you can help me harvest them?
text.808: I hear the voice of my brother, Minshina, calling to me in my dreams. He was taken by Zalazane, the warlock on the Echo Isles to the east. And he is dead. But death is not freedom for my brother. Minshina's spirit was trapped within his own skull by Zalazane's magics. In my dreams I see it with other skulls, in a circle of power on the largest Echo Isle. As long as it remains there my brother's soul is doomed. Please, <name>. Find the circle and retrieve Minshina's skull. Bring it to me. Free him!
text.7488: The mage Lethtendris, a vicious blood elf whose brutality is matched only by her twisted addiction to magic, has fled into Dire Maul. She has created a device, a web to ensnare the magical energies of that place and we fear that, if left unchecked, she will cause irreparable damage to our world! Stop her, <name>. Find her and retrieve her web. She is likely near the satyrs in Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul. Bring the web to me so that its power may be released safely back into the wilds...
text.135: I wonder what Wiley meant when he mentioned the Stonemasons. Perhaps that was a slip of tongue. Could the Defias gang be related to the Stonemasons? Only one man would know for sure: Mathias Shaw, head of SI:7. Show him Wiley's Note and see if he has anything to add to this growing mystery. If you have trouble finding Shaw, check the Barracks in Old Town.
text.7823: <name>, you've been a tremendous contributor to our cloth drive. As we work hard to replenish our reserves, one form of cloth remains critically low - runecloth. We are in absolutely dire need of it, and we hope that you will be able to help us as you have in the past! If you are willing, please bring me what runecloth you can spare. We'll initially accept a single donation of sixty, and then we'll go from there.
text.4842: To tell you the truth, although there are no volcanoes here in Winterspring, I believe that there are far more threatening reasons for these hot springs... Well, I think you'll want to see it for yourself. You'll need to travel the length of Winterspring, and head to the very south. When the air becomes thick and muggy, and the sky turns dark, you'll have found what I believe to be the source of the hot springs. Have a look. I'm sure you'll have many questions when you return.
text.49: Amber is the hue of my life's longest love Like the last embers of dusk in the sky above Retrieve for me so that my love shall be born One sack of each: barley, rye and corn.
text.7224: When you fight the enemy, gather the scraps of their armor and bring them to me. I'll use those scraps to make armor for our own troops!
text.7427: Once I have enough spines, I will load them all up on one of our catapults and launch them into Dun Baldar. The Stormpike will be covered in a horrific layer of death and dismemberment. I can hardly wait. We are going to need more spines.
text.714: <name>, you've done your job well beyond all standards. <Lotwil's obviously distracted by his work.> If we ever meet in Kharanos, feel free to come apply for work. Whoops! Quick, grab the... yes, that. Thanks. Now I just need one more thing. It's a small part, but rather crucial, I'm afraid: a gyrochronatom. If you could just go grab one and bring it to me, I should be ready to complete this.
text.95184: The rigors of training for battle are one thing, but these trainees don't yet understand the difference between a training sword and the well-kept blade of a seasoned veteran. I think it's time we show our recruits how a sharpened blade can be the difference between victory and death. If you can find us a few sharpening stones, we'll put them to good use. There are certain craftsmen known to study this trade. I'd suggest starting there.
text.93759: You have done well and helped me, and the mountain, greatly. I am just preparing some stew, and I would be glad to share it if you would help me gather some of the ingredients. While I am loath to slay any among the wild animals, the cycle of life requires sustenance. A balance of ingredients would serve us well. A few Hyjal Venison Cuts from the Hyjal Stags would pair well with the starchy roots of the Scarlet Dart Tuber plants that grow in the green places nearby.
text.5901: So, to bring pain and strife to the Scarlet Crusade, I want to take their precious lumber mill from them. I'm sure the loss of such a resource will cause them a great deal of harm in defending and rebuilding the town for their own reasons. Will you help me, <name>? Start by taking this jar to Plaguewood in the Eastern Plaguelands. Fill it with the termites you find in their mounds throughout the woods. Come back when you have enough.
text.3362: Have you ever seen Thistleshrub Valley? It's a mighty dangerous place, <name>. Those strange beasts there, I don't trust them for a minute! Gnarled thistleshrubs and thistleshrub rootshapers, that's what I think they were called... Anyhow, I want to get into the valley, but with so many of those thistleshrubs around, there's no way I'm going back there. But here's where you come in -- if you clear some of them out, I just might think about going back. What do you think, <name>? Help me out?
text.95816: Greetings, accomplished craftsperson! Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth! Once completed, please bring this to your local Azeroth Commerce Authority branch's Contract Coordinator to begin processing. Happy crafting!
text.3512: <name>, our first step will be to devise a method to speak with Eranikus through the gem. He lies in a precarious state between sleep and death now, twisted within a weave of nightmares. Though the essence you have given me is badly tainted, there is a chance we can reach him. Travel far to the icy lands of eastern Winterspring and seek one of our mortal allies, Umbranse the Spiritspeaker. He is a human medium who speaks for the dead. Though Eranikus is not truly dead, he may be of aid to us still.
text.4294: Have you heard of the Un'Goro Crater, <name>? It is near the Tanaris desert, and it is a magnificent place: lush, vibrant, full of creatures and plant life. It is there you must go. Word has reached me that the place seems completely untainted by outside hands. Explorers are just now discovering its secrets. I would like to test the slimes or oozes there. If it is true--that they are uncorrupt--then I would like to see how such creatures have evolved.
text.61547: The Scarab Gong looms ominously before you. Steel yourself, <name>; for once the Scarab Gong is rung, the gates of Ahn'Qiraj will be opened. From the slackened maw of the beast can only come chaos and destruction. Defend your people!
text.94669: First things first. I'm gonna need a deposit for your, uh... safety. Look, I don't make the rules here. It's required. Now if you should choose not to pay I'll be forced to tell old Clugfist our new friend wasn't so keen on proving their strength to our warm, welcoming friends here. That would be a real shame. Catch my drift, bub?
text.94346: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Runic Leather Headband, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.99199: <name>, thank you for your previous contributions to the Windshapers. As we work hard to keep up with our needs for cloth, runecloth is in particularly high demand. We sincerely hope that you will be able to help us as you have in the past! If you are willing, please bring me what runecloth you can spare. We'll initially accept a single donation of sixty, and then we'll go from there.
text.317: I'm preparing to start a mission for the Siege Brigade. It's a long one, and I need to stock Jetsteam with a month's worth of supplies. So while Steelgrill is working on my tank, can you do some hunting for me? I'll need some fur for bedding, and boar meat for food. You can get meat from boars and fur from the bears... you can find them both in the snow fields south of the Grizzled Den.
text.8111: Hey mon! It be good to see you again. The tribe be talking about your killin' of the Hakkari and all that. Molthor gave me the word to be adding more mojo to your talisman. Just give it here and Maywiki make it better.
text.94884: I've had enough of this cave. Once you clear your way out, I'll slip out amidst the chaos. I'm afraid I'm in too weak of condition to carry those samples, however. Their energy is overwhelming, and I've been trapped down here for Light knows how long. Once we get out of here, please take them to Lady Amberhall immediately. I must rest.
text.1076: Ah, I think I have it. A messaging spell... I believe that's the effect he's looking for. I'll have to create a scroll with the spell impressed upon it. To do that I'll need debris from a dust devil. While I gather the rest of the components, why don't you head to Westfall and find one of the foul creatures? They are dangerous, but I'm sure it's nothing you can't handle if you're willing to subject yourself to one of Gaxim's experiments. I'll be here when you return.
text.537: The letter you brought me was written by a being who calls himself Nagaz, a member of the Argus Wake. I don't know what this Argus Wake is, but if they're in alliance with the Syndicate then they must be a threat. I want you to find Nagaz and the Argus Shadow Mages mentioned in that letter. I want you to find them, and kill them. Search in the Uplands, where the Syndicate is strongest. It is north of Strahnbrad. With luck, you'll find these envoys of the Argus Wake there.
text.92842: I have a cousin who, some time ago, mentioned a plan to visit Mount Hyjal and see what has been happening there. Foolishly. Hyjal is a world away; it could take months for mail to reach him, if he can even find a mailbox. In the unlikely event that you find yourself on that side of the world, I would appreciate someone looking in on my fool of a cousin.
text.174: My Gnomish friend, Cog, has promised to help me build a device which will let me peer towards the stars. A truth exists, beyond magic, that can explain the strange transformation in the forest. Bring to me a bronze tube made by a skilled engineer. That is the first step, according to Cog's blueprint.
text.95884: <The scrap of note is mostly illegible. What is still readable, however, are notes about preparations for an offering. An offering stone is mentioned, as well as a ritual. Perhaps you can find this offering stone nearby.>
text.5161: We understand what the cursed brood of Deathwing attempts to do and we know that it cannot be allowed. Because of the protection Blackrock mountain affords Nefarian, it has become increasingly difficult for us to intercede. We can, however, empower you, mortal - should you so choose. The path before you is one full of peril. You must decide whether to accept our help. Ponder this and speak with me again when a decision has been made.
text.507: It is clear that Perenolde must be killed, his foulness removed from the world. His manor lies a ways to the north of here, on the shores of Lordamere Lake. Do your duty, <name>, then retrieve the pendant that the Warchief desires, and return here.
text.285: This grouping of Murloc hovels, after a thorough inspection, reveals nothing. ...but you're certain that the next clue you find will be fruitful. One of the hovels to the north must have the Menethil Statuette!
text.97225: When we fled the isles that Zalazane and his ilk now inhabit, we left behind many precious idols that help us commune with spirits we worship: our loa. They are of grave importance to our tribe. The followers of Zalazane show no reverence for our loa and have scattered these idols across the largest of the isles. This is an action that will not go unnoticed if we are not able to collect these idols, and offending a loa is a grave matter. Go, find as many loa idols as you can and return them to me.
text.94296: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Wild Leather Shoulders, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.7385: You have the option of offering larger quantities of the blood taken from our enemies. I will be glad to accept gallon sized offerings, <name>.
text.97253: Hey, got a sec? So, apparently, nobody I've sent to deal with the recent pirate problem has come back alive. After five or six attempts I thought, "what if I sent a machine instead?" Turns out, scimitars double as screwdrivers in a pinch, and before I could redirect it home, it was already in pieces and scattered across their camp! I need those parts back, and since this is a quick little retrieval mission, I'd wager your odds for survival are MUCH higher than the others. Whaddya say?
text.81900: <The carving before you depicts a two-headed beast emerging from the Dark Portal. Fel-fire spews forth from its mouths. A plaque beneath the image reads: "Calefactus the Unleashed". Intuition tells you the Twilight cultists may have plans to harness this creature's destructive power for their own aims. You reason that the next step in your hunt is towards the Blasted Lands. Someone there may know more of this hellish beast.>
text.5150: Dadanga looks up at you as you approach her. She seems to be hoping for something... She's probably hungry! There's got to be something growing in the crater that would be just the perfect snack for a large herbivore. Dadanga's a big girl; whatever you bring her, there would need to be a lot of it!
text.5052: Along with the thorns, the blood affected <snort> other aspects of the earth: blood red stones mixed in with other minerals. The Bristleback dig up these shards and carry them as totems <snort> for strength in battle and as totems for their magics. <snort> I know the secrets of that magic. Bring Mangletooth one of these blood shards to show you understand. Bring Mangletooth many of the shards, and he will bless you with quilboar magic--the magic of Agamaggan! <snort>
text.98970: This was once a helm of sorts, though it is difficult to tell it now in its twisted form. We can restore it, however. Like all things, there is a cost to this. Go to the bastion of Blackrock Spire and claim the left eye of the false warchief, Rend Blackhand. From there, reach the pinnacle of the stronghold and claim the right eye of General Drakkisath, chief agent of the Lord of Blackrock. Do this and you will remove two great evils from the world. Then I will cleanse the artifact you hold.
text.3882: You'd think that being chief digger for Marshal Expeditions means I like digging. There might be worse things to do in this world... but none really leap to mind. We were supposed to be digging in Terror Run - FANTASTIC name by the way - for dead stegodons and diemetradons. Well, there are plenty of live ones there too! Wil and Hol are still all about studying this death trap, so we need those dinosaur bones. Between you and me though, bringing some from live ones will work out just as well.
text.84166: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux. I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin. Bring me the belt and set of gauntlets that you wish to upgrade. I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
text.88713: Bring me any doomed souls that cross your path, <name>. Let me rephrase that - you MUST bring them to me. MY duty is to stay and guide the souls of the lost. YOUR duty is to bring them to me. A word of advice, never handle more than one soul at a time. Trust me, your soul can only handle so much, and your mind... well... it can handle even less. This burden is now yours. Because you can, you must. Consider this a moral obligation.
text.1102: Cairne is a noble leader for uniting our people here on Thunder Bluff. But I cannot forgive those who drove us from our ancestral lands as easily as some. My people inhabited the southern Barrens for decades. The land was holy to us. But we were driven off by numerous foes. A vengeful fate awaits the crone, Charlga Razorflank, who musters a foul army from within Razorfen Kraul. Bring me Razorflank's heart and I can die in peace, <name>.
text.80140: Opening the box produced by the Sparklematic 5200 reveals a shiny ring! Donning the ring, you feel magic power surge through your body. Inside the band is a small but nonetheless discernable imprint of the seal of Orgrimmar. Engraved letters are next to it, but only the first three stand out even after cleaning: "NOG..." This may signify either the initials of the previous owner, or perhaps the initials of the ring's crafter. Keep the ring... or find "NOG" - decisions, decisions...
text.81859: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Twin Colossals. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Gorlas there and return to me.
text.1059: The Bloodfuries have been subdued. But they will regroup soon enough if action is not taken. Far south of the Barrens lies a land known as Thousand Needles. If you travel west in Thousand Needles until you reach the lush forest's edge of Feralas, you will find a druid named Falfindel Waywarder. This great and wise druid is capable of calling forth great forest spirits which can aid in the reclamation of the Charred Vale. Send word of our need! Seek him out at once!
text.99208: You are back. Good. It's time for you to learn to master the steed of a true Forsaken--the skeletal warhorse. Zachariah will provide you with a free mount once you have completed the final round of your training with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you desire. Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about skeletal warhorses.
text.5462: Upon tainted soil, the keepsake must be attuned. It is rumored that Stratholme is where Frostwhisper succumbed to the Lich King. Upon those bloodied grounds he gave his life - freely and with motive - to become one of the undying. It is those grounds that must be found. There is one, an undead dissenter of the Scourge, freed by the Banshee Queen but loyal to the cause of the Argent Dawn. Find him: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered. He may know more. Seek out Light's Hope, <name>.
text.93831: You smell like mountain winds, strong and free! I have a task, if your paws are not full. We love bear berries, they're round, red, and sweet as honey after frost. Look for them near the shade of trees. Too many sharp rocks and mad wings for us to get the ripest bush. Bring me a bunch, and I make Sweetpaw Jam! My best treat, and I will share a taste. Deal?
text.1455: You take a few moments to figure out what pried the chest open, and you notice along the sides and top of the chest, long, deep scratches that reveal that something other than a man or giant took interest in it. The marks don't appear as if they were caused by dagger or sword. After going through the chest you find it to be completely empty. Not having another course of action, you close the chest and prepare to leave. Kreldig will be disappointed.
text.7921: You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. Continue to aid the cause and bring me more talismans of merit. Do this, and you will earn even more of our trust.
text.96913: You again, eh? Ready for the next test? I hope you aren't squeamish. You might need to bleed for this one... or preferably make the other guys bleed first.
text.3453: Give me a moment to combine the pieces and apply the necessary enchantments.
text.92679: H--Hello, stranger. You have the look of a capable adventurer about you. I... <The Skyborne man winces, clearly suffering terrible pain> ...I was wondering if you were seeking employment? I came here to Valanaar to recruit fighters to help save my farm. If you are interested, please go find my wife Aamelia Windfield at our orchard to the west of Valanaar, in the lowlands.
text.94889: It seems every day the Twilight's Hammer are drawing more into their order, while we haven't heard so much as a word from Stormwind. Sooner or later we'll be overrun. I don't care what a bureaucrat like Amberhall says. I'm not abandoning this position while an army amasses in our own homeland. If we leave now, we'll only have to deal with these cultists again later. Only next time, on our doorstep. If your orders are to babysit me anyway, at least make yourself useful and help me cull these zealots.
text.453: Good luck, <name>. I hope you find the chap, and I hope you find him alive. If he's left the safety of Darkshire then he could be prey to the beasts of the wilds.
text.1322: Hmmm, there's writing right here on the rim of the shield, but it's hard to read from all the burned stuff. I need acid to make it clear. Venom from the Darkfang spiders in the marsh would do good. Get me some of their sacs and I can clean this up.
text.7732: You've done doubly well in addressing the threat that the Zukk'ash insects pose to Camp Mojache. The threat these things pose is far from over, and I'd like to ask you for one last task on behalf of the Horde. This is a document that details all the information we have learned about these Zukk'ash insects. I want you to deliver it to Zilzibin Drumlore in the Drag of Orgrimmar. He's an expert on alien creatures like these; I hope he can do something with the lore we've obtained.
text.95511: Greetings, friend! I see today is a big day indeed; today you will bond with your first saber. As you may or may not know these sabers are fiercely intelligent and extremely loyal to their bonded rider. You won't find a more noble and steadfast companion. As such, you have an important choice to make. You and your saber will traverse the world together, so choose wisely! Fear not, whatever choice you make will be the correct one. Go, examine the sabers and return to me when you have made your choice.
text.542: I need to spend some time studying the Arm of Gri'lek book you brought me, though I'm sure Milton is eager to get the other recovered books into Stormwind's collection. Here are the books you gathered from the Ruins of Alterac, packed and catalogued. Take them back to Milton Sheaf in Stormwind and I'm sure he'll be grateful.
text.5888: If you possess a Cenarion beacon while mining in Felwood, you will be able to see tainted vitriol that corrupts a vein of raw metal. I know how to purify that vitriol and turn it into a reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve. You will then use that salve on plants you find in the wild that need saving. If you have collected any tainted vitriol, I'll give you some Cenarion plant salve I have already prepared.
text.2902: Gnolls aren't the sharpest tools in the shed, but they will no doubt have some sort of documented strategy on their recent activity. If we were to find those plans, then we'd have a clearer idea of what is making them so worked up. I want you to head back to the Woodpaw and find anything that might resemble their battle plans. They have to have something; their attacks have been too coordinated to be done without them. Find them, and return to me when you have them.
text.161: If my suspicions are correct, this is some type of explosive powder. This must be analyzed by an explosives expert so we know just what we're dealing with here. Ashlan Stonesmirk was assigned to the regiment guarding Dun Modr and the Thandol Span. I need you to make a grave and perilous journey, <name>. Travel through the Algaz Gate, follow the road through the Wetlands and seek out Stonesmirk in Dun Modr. Heed my advice: stick to the roads and stop for nothing!
text.2439: This object is an incredible find. The ancient Titans, or the Creators as these discs refer to them as, are the link to our enchanted creation, if the lore stored in here is correct! We'll need to invest as much research time into this as possible. As for you, heroic {class}, take this voucher to Dinita Stonemantle at the vault. It grants you what I think is a fitting for such a tremendous find! Return to me directly when you are ready; there is much more to do for the Explorers' League!
text.93617: The hierarchy of the Wild Gods is bent. Now, all is in motion, and the nature of the world is as malleable as clay! No more will my kin suffer the fangs of predators, for now, we shall prey upon all who have devoured us! Tremble, fragile creature, for you have neither the strength nor the speed to dissuade us!
text.5542: If you are going to remain here, I ask only that you earn your keep. We have many nuisances that could use some 'discipline.' You can start with the Plaguehounds and their runts. I cannot offer much in return, but you are guaranteed a warm meal and some conversation should you succeed.
text.93362: Please spare the details of how the life may have been twisted there. My heart is broken enough with the loss of my necklace. But while I weep, the plants suffer. <name>, I would like you to go back to the garden and cull some of the angered flora. Please be swift and merciful; they can feel pain, and they have been hurt enough. If you intend to go hunting for my necklace as well, I would ask you to prioritize that before visiting the gardens again... in the unlikely chance you find it.
text.94228: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Green Iron Boots, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.7806: Greetings once again, <name>! Our need for runecloth is constant, and we can always use additional resources if you are willing to part with them. For an additional stack of twenty runecloth, I will make sure that you are recognized for your continuing efforts on behalf of Ironforge. Whenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it.
text.82: All right now, these reports about the bugs... what we know is that they are draining the water pools that used to be where the Noxious Lair is. What we DON'T know is, well, everything else. Let's figure out who our enemy is first! I want you to head into the Noxious Lair and get some parts off of those critters. Get five from the Centipaar there and bring them to Alchemist Pestlezugg for him to dink with. With him on the case, we'll figure out what they are!
text.971: As you might know, I collect lore. Old lore. Powerful lore. Lore that opens doorways, and lore that can awaken Those Who Sleep. There are rumors of an old piece of lore, the Lorgalis Manuscript, at the bottom of Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale. That place is the old dwelling of long-dead elves. Elves who held great knowledge before their city fell to ruin. Search Blackfathom Deeps for the manuscript. Do this, and I will not forget it. Not even after ... the end days.
text.95772: Me brother tried draggin' me off tae the Wetlands with some diggin' crew out o' Loch Modan. Said they were headin' into hills no dwarf's ever set boot in for some sort o' excavation. Aye, I'd 'ave gone, if I wasn't already behind on this pile o' girdles I've got to refit. Daewyn normally writes after he sends off, though. Haven't heard a thing, gives me a strange feelin' this time. If yer marchin' that way, mind checking in on me brother?
text.3563: Take this letter to Jediga. Let her know that our deal has been beneficial and I be pleased with her work. You tell her she come back to Orgrimmar fast and Jes'rimon make sure he take good care of her. Tell her that, and maybe in the future I have need of your services again, <name>.
text.96026: Dese good rock. Now need finishing touch. More rock. Only rock can make rock stronger. Dat the way of rocks. Me see some tinies make extra heavy rock. Bring me heavy rocks and me make weapon.
text.80134: As long as you have the transponder in your possession, all you need to do is step on the pad and you'll be teleported to Gnomeregan. You may experience some unusual side effects, but none of those should be permanent... anymore. I almost forgot the most important part - getting back.
