I want to know more, and I ask for your help. Bring me ten morrowgrain, and I will be sure to take care of you.
text.94350: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Runic Leather Bracers, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.1016: Take this divining scroll--it can determine the creator of these elementals. But you will need something from them to use as a reagent to focus scroll's magic--their bracers should do nicely. A few intact bracers from the creatures should be enough. The other bracers will be useless for our purposes, but they may be worth something to a merchant if you wish to sell them. Once you have the intact bracers attempt to use the scroll. Return to me with the results and we shall proceed from there.
text.84212: Nami hands over Jurgens' book. With it safely stowed, you begin the long journey back to the other side of the world.
text.99010: The ruin known as Dire Maul is a solemn tomb. Countless kaldorei souls have died to pay the balance of a grim bargain struck with an unthinking, uncaring evil. All in the name of maintaining the splendor and immortality of a privileged few. Go there and slay the beast known as Immol'thar that lies at the center of the western wing of the city. Bring me a phial of its cursed blood and break the cycle of death in that haunted place. Then I will cleanse the artifact you carry.
text.2932: The Witherbark trolls were once allies to the Horde, but they betrayed Thrall... and that must be punished! Here, take my pike and go to the Hinterlands, far to the north. You will find it northeast of Tarren Mill, a village held by our allies, the Forsaken. When you enter the Hinterlands, hunt Witherbark trolls. Gather their skulls and drive my pike into the ground at one of their smaller villages, Hiri'watha or Zun'watha. Show them their vile actions are of consequence!
text.790: {class}! I thought I would die out here with none to know of it. While I was hunting the scorpids of the Valley, I came across a particularly vicious-looking one. Hurling myself at it, I managed to inflict a massive blow to its claw before it closed around my leg. I wasn't ready for its stinger though, and it sliced down and into my chest, cutting into my flesh and letting my blood. Please, you must kill the scorpid for me! My honor must be upheld! I fought it up on the plateau to the south.
text.91921: Here is the new potion to aid in Quinn's recovery, made with love extracted from six whole hearts. Now, please excuse me before your presence necessitates more paperwork.
text.278: Begin collecting the disarming materials immediately, <name>. Lurker Venom can be found on the indigenous spiders in Loch Modan. Crocolisk tears are found here in the Loch as well. But a Mo'Grosh crystal will be very difficult to procure. The ogres to the northeast mine them but the crystals are a very rare commodity. We need to be prepared to defuse a Dark Iron attack! Return to me once you've collected the needed items and I will prepare the mixture.
text.95261: That monster...with the long neck, just like you said. I've seen 'im around those islands -- out on my boat. I tried <hic> tellin' folks, but ohh nooo, you can't <hic> believe ol' Argo. He's just some...some...drunkard fisherman! Makin' up stories! We'll show 'em...soon as I get some bait... Hey! Quit standin' around! I'm gonna need entrails, a LOT of 'em. Any beast from around here. The smellier <hic> the better. I'm also gonna need some Rotflesh mushrooms. Those grow in that cave by Windstead.
text.8758: Your continued defense of the children of Kalimdor has been acknowledged. Hand me your signet ring so that I may enhance its powers.
text.9008: A truly amazing story, <name>! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past. As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
text.553: Here, take the Rod of Helcular. You will need it. Helcular fashioned 3 ceremonial pyres as part of his most powerful spell. The Flame of Azel and the Flame of Veraz lie within the Foothill Caverns. The Flame of Uzel lies in a cave above the caverns, further north in the mountains. The Rod of Helcular must be charged from each of the three flames. Once the ritual is complete, drive the rod into Helcular's grave in Southshore, the heavily guarded human town to the south. Vengeance shall be ours!
text.6395: My friend Marla Fipps lived with her husband Samuel before the plague, but when the plague came Samuel succumbed and joined the Scourge's ranks. Marla was spared an undeath only to die at the hands of her now mindless husband. So strong was her love, however, that her last dying wish was to be buried with her beloved Samuel. Samuel Fipps roams at a ruined camp along the road northeast of Deathknell. Defeat him and grant Marla's wish: bury him at her grave, in the first row of our graveyard.
text.96083: You have done all you can here, for now. If you wish to be of further aid, go up the hill to the chapel. It is the smaller building outside the main church. Sister Rowland is looking after a few quarantined soldiers there who have contracted an unknown illness.
text.1041: Turns out I was wrong about you, and that isn't something that happens everyday. It just so happens that I remember this Velinde you're looking for. Isn't every day that a night elf priestess that wants to travel with a dirty old--but great for your shipping needs!--caravan like my own. We split up on the way north, she was headed for Darkshire. The clerk there keeps all sorts of records. Might know something useful. Be careful in the jungle, it is a deadly place even at the best of times.
text.99602: Valdrus Blackthorne. The 'Wild King'. <Jereman lets out a low hiss.> He has turned his back on his oath as a druid and will pay for his crimes against the natural order! Only blood can repay the harm he has done here. Go, <name>! Enter the domain of Wild King and end him. I will remain here with Nythus to ensure that he is protected from any lingering remnants of Blackthorne's forces, and to ensure that none interfere as you bring the Wild King to justice.
text.1500: The Fanglords are dead! All hope is not lost! The awakening ritual is quite complex, however. It cannot be done alone. I will handle all of the necessary preparations but I will need you to protect me. The nightmares summoned from Naralex's journey through the Emerald Dream prove to be quite formidable. Without your help, this mission is doomed. When you are ready to defend me, say the word, and I shall lead the way to Naralex's chamber.
text.86434: I've come to this timeline in search of a dangerous agent of the void. This creature has wreaked havoc across their own timeline and I fear that they will do the same here. I've followed a trail of voidstuff to this place but the trail has gone cold, which is why I'd like to enlist your aid. Nearby, there is a camp of Twilight's Hammer cultists. This creature has a way of influencing susceptible minds, so keep an eye out for anything that would be out of place, even for deranged cultist types.
text.92526: So you wish to help our governor maintain peace and order? Well, it's quite encouraging to see our youth so devoted to the rule of law. Very well, let's put your sense of duty to the test with something easy. The yokels in these parts are, let's say... somewhat lax at maintaining payments for their debts to Zephras. There are several citizens who owe the provincial seat a tidy sum and I need you to help me collect. The largest debt is owed by Shen'dar Village itself, so I'd start with Constable Aonda.
text.4804: In Winterspring, you will fight great flying creatures called da Chillwind. These beasts possess da power ta wield frost magics. If you wish ta gain resistance ta frost, bring me da E'ko you find from da Chillwind. Rememba, you must have the Cache of Mau'ari in your inventory if you want ta hunt for E'ko.
text.81774: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Warsong Lumber Camp. Retrieve a powerful artifact known as the Dreamengine and deliver it to me.
text.117: Hurry, my friend, move with haste In order for our rich lager to taste More like beer and less like stew, Hops are needed to make the brew.
text.7065: In the depths of Maraudon lives a creature of chaos and evil, <name>. Princess Theradras is an elemental force of earth related somehow to the Old Gods. Ages ago, she was sought out by Zaetar, first son of Cenarius. The offspring of their... relationship are the creatures known as centaur. Ever-thankful creatures, the centaur killed Zaetar, and now Theradras keeps his remains. My quest here is to find those powerful enough to slay Theradras so we may recover Zaetar's remains before returning to Stonetalon.
text.91741: <One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it. Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>
text.1048: Whilst the Dark Lady tends to the pressing issue of the Lich King's advance to the north, I am seeing to it that matters closer to home are being taken care of accordingly. No doubt, the human pests who call themselves the Scarlet Crusade are proving to be the sharpest thorn in our side domestically. Tirisfal Glades is literally crawling with the little red ants. Travel to the Monastery, {class}, and lay waste to High Inquisitor Whitemane and her top lieutenants.
text.98326: Do ye know how hard it is to fish on a frozen lake? My poor husband, Paxton, has been out in the middle of it for days and we barely have a single sack to show fer it. Well, we DID have a sack to show fer it. Until the thrice-damned wendigo attacked me and made off with our haul. It'll take us weeks to fish all that back up! If that loudmouth Frosthowl didn't scare 'em all off, anyway. Do us a favor and get it back, aye? Drooling brute is hiding somewhere deep in the Grizzled Den to the southeast.
text.8781: The Ironforge Brigade has been a worthy ally in our fight in Silithus. Unfortunately, many of their supplies were lost on their way here. Procure a batch of weapons and deliver them to Janela Stouthammer near Hive'Zora.
text.8074: Augurs know the mojo of the elements, mon. They use it as a means to guide the tribe to glory. In the dark days after the Gurubashi Empire ripped itself up, our augurs led us to our safe haven in the South Seas. They've also led us back here to the Vale, right back to the heart of evil brewin' in Zul'Gurub. Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. Do it and I'll give ya a belt that our augurs use - one with powerful mojo inside it!
text.9082: If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials. Enter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. Bring those back along with the materials to put everything together and you'll have your Bonescythe. Oh, and you'll need to pay me for my troubles... I'll supply the bones.
text.96393: Gather some allies and head down into the caverns beneath Old Ironforge. Enter the Hall of Thanes there and push to the lower vaults. My Dark Iron is a bit rusty, but I can make out a name--one Durgen Dirgehammer. It's likely that he's the commander. Take his head and deliver it to King Magni Bronzebeard. Oh, and when you do, tell him his old friend Farsen sends his regards!
text.98322: Spelunking dark caves is adventurer business. My job's just to make reports and send them over to Ironforge. Trouble is, one of my reports hasn't... well, reported back. I asked a few mountaineers to learn more about the wendigo problem we have out here, but I haven't heard from them. If you're already going to be out and about, what say you check in with Mountaineer Gretchen just west of town. I'm late enough as it is!
text.4883: While I do possess much knowledge about the owlbeasts you defeated in Winterspring, I am not very learned on the subject of the magics they wield. But I do believe I know of one that would be able to examine the necklace and most likely tell you what it is. Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff is an expert in this field; see her. Good luck, <name>.
text.96303: <name>, the ancestral spirits called to Hyjal during the great battle weren't all lost. Some linger still, drawn to Nordrassil after the great sacrifice. These wisps have stayed within the root canopy that hangs over the well, trapped in a state of purgatory between this world and the next. Use this enchanted branch to bring peace to these wisps, joining their memories with eternity. You need not release them all yourself. Recover the will of five and return the branch to us.
text.99007: The ruin known as Dire Maul is a solemn tomb. Countless kaldorei souls have died to pay the balance of a grim bargain struck with an unthinking, uncaring evil. All in the name of maintaining the splendor and immortality of a privileged few. Go there and slay the beast known as Immol'thar that lies at the center of the western wing of the city. Bring me a phial of its cursed blood and break the cycle of death in that haunted place. Then I will cleanse the artifact you carry.
text.1560: I am so lost! My wife, Torta, sent me out to fetch dinner and I must have taken a wrong turn somewhere. Would you be so kind as to lead me back to Torta? She's waiting for me just south of Steamwheedle Port.
text.8737: The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus. With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside. Find a way to summon and destroy an Azure Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.
text.97130: Lan'dalock and I have been discussing a recent development in the south seas involving an ancient Gurubashi ruin that has suddenly appeared off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale. Such a site has significant archeological value. We'd be highly interested in obtaining one of the idols that certain witch doctors amongst the ancient Gurubashi would use as a ritual focus for their blood magic. Enter this "Drowned City" and recover one of these idols for us.
text.1261: Cursed muckshell! You can't kill Marg! Ah, but I am dead. So it must have slain me... But my mission! My mission! You, <name>, must complete it. While near Theramore, I spied a group of Alliance soldiers camped on the beach. And one soldier wore a pendant... a pendant laden with more gems than any soldier could afford! That night I snuck into their camp and stole the pendant, but on my return to base a muckshell crab-man killed me! <name>, you must find that muckshell and recover the pendant!
text.95599: <The key is covered in a thick layer of rust, suggesting that the key has been underwater for a significant amount of time. There must be a matching lock somewhere nearby to use it on but you'll have to search for it. Perhaps the pool of water to the southwest of this camp might be a good place to start?>
text.93746: The High Order has been warned of the consequences of meddling with the Windshaper's affairs. I think we need to make an example out of Belathaan and send him back to the High Order with a few bruises and a healthy respect for the boundaries we set. Belathaan was seen leaving town, traveling north towards the Shrine of Akir. I don't know why he was going there, but confronting him alone on the road is the safest option. Find him, and put a bit of fear into his heart.
text.9014: A truly amazing story, <name>! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past. As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
text.86965: A sudden and oppressive darkness begins to fall over you as you kneel down. You notice that all nearby light seems to darken and fade as the darkness seems to reach out to you. These are no natural shadows. A quick glance over to the entrance to the crypt nearby tells you without doubt that this malign darkness is coming from the crypt itself, with inky black tendrils seeking more light to snuff out. You shudder as hairs on the back of your neck stand up.
text.3462: Speak with my envoy, Squire Maltrake. He will further instruct you as to the use of the Torch of Retribution.
text.8159: <name>, the League of Arathor has a standing mission for you to reenter Arathi Basin, procure more resource crates and bring them to me.
text.93165: The Al'Aketh have visited great tragedy upon our enclave, and blood must be repaid with blood. I have an offer for you, stranger. Should you find conflict with these accursed cultists, bring me the ears of those you kill. I will reward you for each that you return with in both coin and, in time, access to the Nightclaw's secrets should you prove yourself to be a true friend.
text.96821: We see fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill these days. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I hear there are spiders making their nest along the road. If your travels take you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
text.8961: In order to summon Lord Valthalak we're first going to need to gather the other two-thirds of the amulet. To do that we need to get a brazier and some special coals to burn in it. There are three nobles of fire, Lord Incedius in Blackrock Depths, Pyroguard Emberseer in Blackrock Spire and Executor Asharell in the Steppes, with what we need. Collect from each a piece of their remains, and then return to me with a Hallowed Brazier, which can be purchased from the Argent Dawn if you are honored by them.
text.93167: I've had a bit of a think since you brought me back this old gadget. I may have had a change of heart about getting my memories back...
text.3377: Will you assist me, mortal? Hear my tale.
text.8184: Zanza can create the ancient troll enchantments with the right components. The first is a primal Hakkari idol that must be taken from the most powerful of the Hakkari lieutenants: Jin'do and the Bloodlord. The second is a punctured voodoo doll. These can be found in the piles of refuse that litter this foul place. Look inside the jinxed hoodoo piles. Bring me these things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
text.547: High Executor Darthalia sent me to keep watch of Dun Garok from a distance. I had set up camp just out of sight. But when morning came and I had to boil water, I left to gather firewood. When I returned to camp, I discovered my gear was missing. Apparently some dwarven scouts from Dun Garok had passed by and made off with it. I need my sword! If you can get it back for me I would be so grateful. So many dwarves there...it will be quite difficult to find the dirty little thief who stole it.
text.6603: There's trouble in Winterspring! Why, sure, I spend some time out in the wilds and know about these things... I'm always mighty proud to say it. I consider the hours I spend out there in the hills to be golden. Help you cultivate quick reflexes, a cool head and a keen eye... It takes judgement, brains and maturity to appreciate the wilderness in the way that I do. Now, what was I talking about? Ah yes, trouble. See Donova Snowden at the hot springs and she can tell you more.
text.2878: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a songflower plant. A pungent, unhealthy odor emanates from the plant. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
text.94927: When you're ready, I'll unlock my shackles, and we'll commence the escape. We'll take the quickest route, right through the center of camp. Be prepared for a fight. Once we're out, I'll return to Farholde for medical treatment. As a final favor, I ask that you update Cornelius on my whereabouts. Frankly, the last thing I want after all this is to get an earful from that man.
text.6861: I'm as anxious as you are to try out my portable shredder unit, {race}, but before I can make the kit, I'm going to need materials - lots of materials! To be exact, I'm going to need a mountain of thorium, mithril, and iron. I will also need one steamsaw per unit. You'll have to get those at the lumber mill. When I was nosing around in here (before my capture) I noticed a pile of steamsaws at the Stormpike lumber camp.
text.96622: I would ask one last favor while I have you here, friend. Could you deliver the poultice I have made to two of my companions here in camp? Enho is in our infirmary to the left. He is very weak but I yet hope he will be able to overcome the infection. I have been spoon-feeding him broth to try to help him regain his strength. The other is Maruke. <Ortak hangs his head in silence for a moment.> You will find her north of here, where we keep the few mounts we have left.
text.2992: Give me room while I perform a ritual of divination. I will find the connection between the feather you brought me and its owner, and follow that connection to Sharpbeak himself. That is... I will if all goes according to plan. If it does not, then... you better close your eyes.
text.8805: The mounted division of the Cenarion Hold guard is in short supply of ornate mithril boots. Procure a batch and deliver them immediately to Captain Vish Kozus in Cenarion Hold.
text.5402: A Minion's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge rank and file. These are sometimes found on the weaker of their troops positioned in the Plaguelands, though the term "weaker" is certainly to be considered in context. The Scourge, no matter where they are, should never be underestimated. The Argent Dawn currently offers a valor token in exchange for twenty of these insignia - an exchange I'm happy to do, provided you have earned enough scourgestones!
text.4972: I need you to reach into the world beyond this room, <name>. Allow me to explain. You see the difference in this room compared to the rest of Andorhal. My dragonflight works in many different ways and in many different timelines. To mend Andorhal's damage, I now act from a different timeline as not to overly contaminate it. To continue this though I need time trinkets, ones trapped from when the plague hit. Find them in lockboxes found in the ruined buildings that make up this once proud city.
text.86620: Though we have a good line of gryphons here, there are always a few egg clutches in the wild that are in danger of not making it. A gryphon parent can lose a fight against a wolf, or fall sick. Without help, the fledglings will never survive. Fortunately, we have the means to raise and protect lost young ones like this. If you find lost eggs in the wild, bring them to me.
text.292: Opening the chest reveals a blackened orb, pulsing with an eerie light. It is the treasure of which Fitzsimmons spoke: a Cursed Eye of Paleth. Take the Cursed Eye of Paleth to the dwarven priest Glorin Steelbrow, in Menethil Harbor. Ask him how to remove the Eye's curse.
text.95999: Wanted! Incinerator Gar'im, Leader of an orc incursion in Render's Valley. Purported to be working with the Blackrock of Stonewatch Keep. Beware of Incinerator Gar'im. He and his Shadowcasters are extremely dangerous. A handsome reward will be given to any brave soul that can deliver proof of Incinerator Gar'im's demise to Magistrate Solomon.
text.1252: A glint of light on the ground catches your eye from underneath the rubble. Brushing away debris and ash caked onto the object reveals the insignia of a gold anchor on white enameled on the surface: the sign of Theramore. Underneath the anchor is embossed the name "Lieutenant Paval Reethe".
text.92065: Will you aid us in our final battle, {race}, and be a savior to the Blackmaw? Varrox Bleakhoof, bane of the Blackmaw: a demon whose appetite for destruction will never be satisfied. His corruption consumes all that it touches. Even now, he and his underlings continue to lay waste to our burrows. We've come far in our fight against the Legashi, but for the Blackmaw to ever have a future, Varrox must fall. Find him in Blackmaw Hold, and strike him down. Only then can the Blackmaw finally be at peace.
text.1054: Directly to the north of Astranaar are the Thistlefur furbolg. My scouts report that their numbers have grown greatly over the past few months. If they grow too great, they may find the courage to attack Astranaar directly. Kill as many of their kind as you can, but bring me their chieftain's skull as proof that their efforts have been stifled... for now. I shall remain here in Astranaar and await word from you. Elune be with you.
text.716: I know how cheap Lotwil can be, <name>, so let me make you something for all your troubles. Maybe it'll even help protect you from the coming atrocity that is Lotwil's newest invention. I've been working with all the extra stones you collected for him, and I can make some nice bracers that you might want to use. They're enchanted, of course. I'll just need patterned bronze bracers crafted by a blacksmith so I can complete the bracers I'm making for you.
text.7725: I know you've gathered residue for me already... but should you find yourself for want of an encore performance to a fun-time activity, I can always use more residue. While I can't offer nearly as much in the way of compensation again, I'll be more than happy to spread the good word of your service to all my goblin friends with ears. Believe me sir when I say that these goblins have quite large ears.
text.92517: There's a cave not far to the north, hidden behind a waterfall. It's well known to me that there's a group of bandits that are operating out of that cave. They were a problem for us before the cult arrived, but now they are a real terror. I can't spare the people to go and clear them out, unfortunately. I need you to go there and take care of them for me. Kill as many as you can, and if possible, take out their leader, the one they call "Badwind" Bennic. That cave is dangerous, so be careful.
text.4023: You seek out the Flight? Present to me proof of your worth, mortal.
text.94969: Don't ask. You wouldn't believe me if I told you. Let's just focus on getting me out of here! Oh, and you as well, of course.
text.99014: The ruin known as Dire Maul is a solemn tomb. Countless kaldorei souls have died to pay the balance of a grim bargain struck with an unthinking, uncaring evil. All in the name of maintaining the splendor and immortality of a privileged few. Go there and slay the beast known as Immol'thar that lies at the center of the western wing of the city. Bring me a phial of its cursed blood and break the cycle of death in that haunted place. Then I will cleanse the artifact you carry.
text.96773: There is a servant of the Lich King that makes his home deep in the quilboar lair known as Razorfen Downs. It is known to us that he makes use of a scrying orb known as "The Coldbringer's Eye" to direct the movements of his lesser minions elsewhere. Go into Razorfen Downs and retrieve the Coldbringer's Eye on our behalf, {class}. The Kirin Tor would pay handsomely to obtain this artifact so that we may study it and understand its inner workings.
text.96616: Could this be? Travelers have returned to Hyjal! I can hardly believe it! Perhaps with your aid we will finally be freed of this place. With the Scourge remnants to the east we have been subject to constant raids and many have fallen victim to their corruption. Please, {class}. I would ask a favor of you. In the valley north of here grows an herb with blue flowers that can alleviate the pains of the infection. Gather some and bring it to me so I may help the wounded.
text.844: Your first prey will be easy. The plainstriders to the east have been harassing our food supplies and have become a nuisance. Put down the plainstriders and return to me with their beaks.
text.6028: I am looking for a responsible individual to aid me in a small but nonetheless important matter. I'm here as a representative of the Argent Dawn's interests to the local governance of Everlook. I need to get a progress report to Argent Officer Pureheart at Chillwind Camp; it's a ways from here, located along the southern fringe of the Western Plaguelands. If I may be so bold - this would be a perfect means to introduce yourself to my superior and perhaps earn some work from her!
text.4243: Unfortunately, something's happened to one of my greatest inventions. You've seen mechanical squirrels, yes? Well, to get closer to the apes of Un'Goro Crater, I created a mechanical ape to blend in with their kind--I call her A-Me 01. She has scrying gems for eyes so I could see everything she saw. She made it to Fungal Rock--the apes' lair--just east of here, and that's when I lost contact. The last thing I saw was one of their alpha males rushing up to say hello to her! Can you help me find her?
text.96666: Barkskin speak more good on you, friend, but there is yet more for you to do. Raise your hand to our foes. Honor our ways. We watch close, and then we will have more to say to you.
text.6862: I'm as anxious as you are to try out my portable shredder unit, {race}, but before I can make the kit, I'm going to need materials - lots of materials! To be exact, I'm going to need a mountain of thorium, mithril, and iron. I will also need one steamsaw per unit. You'll have to get those at the lumber mill. When I was nosing around in here (before my capture) I noticed a pile of steamsaws at the Frostwolf lumber camp.
text.359: I need a fresh report from our Deathguard waystation to the east. I must know if more Scourge forces have slipped past The Bulwark and into Tirisfal. Our vigilance on the border to the Plaguelands must be maintained - we can't let the Scourge get a stronger foothold here! Travel south along the road, then east at the fork to the waystation. Speak with Deathguard Linnea. She has the information I need.
text.7281: Tragic... My brother faces me on the field of battle: A commander for the Stormpike. Of the four Stormpike Commanders, he is undoubtedly the most dangerous. Perhaps if he is slain, the Banshee Queen could turn him as she did me - show him the error of his ways... Deep within enemy territory you will find my brother. Slay him and return to me. I trust that you are capable of completing this mission, soldier. And soldier, do not go alone.
text.94237: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Crafted Solid Shot, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.95775: What I am about to ask you is no small feat, {class}, and will likely require strong allies to accomplish. I want to know more about the ruins on the other side of the cavern the naga are guarding. If my suspicions prove correct, it could indeed be the lost city of I'lalai. The amount of lost historical knowledge at our fingertips could be unrivaled, but I am too old to venture myself. Enter the ruins and gather etchings of any tablets you find there, then return to me.
text.5212: The Forsaken apothecaries are not the only beings in this world schooled in the sciences. I have been studying the plague for years, {race}. We had previously thought that the potency of the plague was dwindling, but what I have discovered here in the Plaguelands is startling. The plague seems to be growing in strength! I need to run more tests! The most potent source of the plague is from the tainted flesh of the most recently infected. Travel to Stratholme and bring me samples, <name>.
text.2159: Greetings, young {class}. Can you offer me aid? I have a package of herbs that I must deliver to the town of Dolanaar. But I still have business with the druids of Shadowglen and cannot yet leave. Can you deliver this package for me? It must be sent to Innkeeper Keldamyr, at the Dolanaar inn. It lies along the road, to the south.
text.8320: The Twilight's Hammer, an insane cult bent on destruction, set up camps in Silithus and perform rituals day and night. We do not yet know their plans, but we do think they are somehow linked to the pulsing red crystals spread across the desert. Although their mystery may one day be solved, we must first deal with their immediate threat. Go to their camps to the west and seek out Twilight geolords. They are the heads of these serpents; that is where we must strike!
text.642: My name is Myzrael. I am a princess of the earth, and my captors, the giants, have trapped me deep beneath the Arathi Highlands. These crystal shards are the only way I can speak with the surface world. Please help me. Allies of the giants, the Drywhisker Kobolds, have a shard like this one in their Drywhisker Gorge, to the east. To power the cluster, you must gather Motes of Myzrael from the kobolds and apply them to it. I beg you, <name>, aid me!
text.89341: Your assistance has been invaluable. The citizens and soldiers of New Avalon can count on a hot meal tonight, and for many nights that follow. You have my gratitude, truly. However, as you apparently read yourself, I have one last task to tend to before I can finally put my feet up. I can handle most of this myself, but if you're willing to do me one more favor, I will teach you my most famous recipes. You will be eating like a Highlord every night.
text.93738: Brightwish, eh? So the High Order wanted to remove these components for some reason. But why though? The High Order has always been meddlesome, constantly wanting to experiment with the wind spirits' magic. They are too bold by a mile, and we've strictly forbidden them from meddling with knowledge under Windshaper purview, but lately they've been testing our patience. I think you should report what you've learned back to Ayessa Dawnsinger. She can instruct you further on what to do.
text.94488: The reason for cultists' presence here still baffles me, but I smell a familiar scent over the bloodshed. One of our circle druids, Haalien, disappeared months back. It appears he's thrown his sorry hide in with the cultists. Show him what happens when he spills the blood of his kin! Take his head and return it to me.
text.4601: This contraption stands out amongst the gnomes holding out against the madness outside the room. A small plaque on the device reads "The Sparklematic 5200", followed by some text: "Grime and residue ruining your sparklies? The Sparklematic 5200 puts the shine back in shine-tastic! Insert the item you wish to clean and deposit three silver coins in the coin slot. Give the Sparklematic 5200 a moment for operation, and voila! Your valuables will emerge clean and shiny!"
text.8782: The latest influx of volunteers has caused a shortage of uniforms. Procure a batch of uniform materials and bring them to Windcaller Proudhorn.
text.8397: The war against the Horde is quickly depleting our supplies, <name>. It is vital to maintain control of Arathi Basin to keep the stream of resources flowing! Have you lent a hand in Arathi yet?
text.361: This is a letter written by Thurman, the eldest son of Gregor Agamand. It is addressed to an Yvette Farthing, though it does not appear to have reached her...
text.8189: Zanza can create the ancient troll enchantments with the right components. The first is a primal Hakkari idol that must be taken from the most powerful of the Hakkari lieutenants: Jin'do and the Bloodlord. The second is a punctured voodoo doll. These can be found in the piles of refuse that litter this foul place. Look inside the jinxed hoodoo piles. Bring me these things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
text.228: From what my scouts tell me, Mor'Ladim wanders throughout Duskwood, following a strange and meandering path through the cemetery. We buried him out past the house on the hill, you know where that is? There isn't anything I can do to help you, but I wish you good luck.
text.97329: You! Yes, you! Come here, keep your voice down! I screwed up big time. I managed to secure a sweet deal for Booty Bay to use their zeppelin tower for expedited deliveries and on our very first route I saw a huge bird--err, got SHOT DOWN just to the east of here! I survived the crash, unfortunately, but before I woke up, I was already being dragged by my ears! Now I'm surrounded by bloodthirsty trolls and locked in a cage! Look, I just need the key, okay? I can escape on my own.
text.430: Here is the potion to aid in Quinn Yorick's recovery. Now if you will excuse me, I have very important work to continue...
text.173: Darkness seems drawn inexorably to Duskwood. Master Carevin's quest is the expulsion of evil and heresy. Through our efforts are the people of Darkshire kept safe. You believe yourself worthy to join us? I once thought as you. Disillusioned by the complacency of the Watch, I joined Master Carevin. If you wish to prove yourself, it will not be through words. Test your skills against the Nightbane Shadow Weaver worgen in Brightwood Grove--bright, hah!--and the Rotting Orchard.
text.82081: This prestine scapula is all too recognizable -- Hakkar was summoned into the physical world and defeated. The trolls on Yojamba Island will want to hear more about what happened inside of Sunken Temple.
text.6545: So you're here with my orders? Always good to see a new recruit with an exuberant nature and a strong will. You'd best learn fast if you expect to keep up here. The threat of the naga grows, <name>. I have observed and have taken up defenses against several attacks on this outpost since I arrived here. But if you'd like to pitch in with that effort, speak with one of the others here at the outpost.
text.2877: We Wildhammers remember the past, more than our brothers in Ironforge. If you want to make friends here, then you get your hands dirty for us! The Horde abandoned their positions in the Hinterlands around Skulk Rock; it's now overrun with nasty sludges and oozes. We've got plans on that area, but first we need a clean-up crew to make a hole for us. That's where you come in, Sunshine! Head down there and take out ten green sludges and ten jade oozes, then report back to me here. Move out!
text.84170: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux. I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin. Bring me the belt and set of gauntlets that you wish to upgrade. I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
text.2980: Now that you have proven that you are a true fighter, I trust that you possess the courage to continue with the task at hand. Travel to the High Wilderness, southwest of here. There lie some abandoned and destroyed structures, on land that once belonged to the night elves. Look for these ruins, and when you see the withered trees and desecrated terrain, you will find the Gordunni. Push them back. These ogres are much stronger than the ones you faced previously, <name>. Be aware.
text.820: Truly a spirit of strength resides in your body--or maybe it was only luck, yes? That is what the young rely on these days: luck... and the generosity of those more powerful than they. Not many take the time to find their own path. It's always begging for help... always the reward, and never the quest. I'm sure you'll be the same. But there is hope. I need one other thing for my potion, <name>: 8 shimmerweed herbs. They can be found in Thunder Ridge to the northwest of Razor Hill.
text.98319: It's bad enough havin' a troll problem, but the mountains are filled tae the brim with wendigos! They normally keep to their own caves, but they seem tae be spreadin' like bunnies. Now they've filled the Grizzled Den north of here. If we want Whitebeard's report, we're gonna need to find my partner Cornelius. The blockhead got a little too excited and charged in head first. Brave, but stupid. Head into the cave and see where he is. And feel free to take out some of the beasts while yer at it.
text.165: There was an old man who used to come into town to buy supplies rather frequently, but I haven't seen him for quite some time now. He lives out in a shack overlooking Raven Hill cemetery, if I remember correctly. Perhaps you should go see if something is amiss.
text.5519: Need another suit, do ya? Well, I'm not going anywhere soon it seems - bring me the same things I asked for from before, and I'll make you another ogre suit.
text.8954: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us. The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for. I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
text.4123: For years I have sought a certain gem. It is called the Heart of the Mountain and it's the size of your fist! The Dark Iron dwarves have it locked in their vault and, try as I may, they won't let me purchase it. So I must resort to force. Fight your way to the Lower Vault of Blackrock Depths, breach its secret safe and gain the Heart. To do that, you must defeat Watchman Doomgrip, and he won't appear until you've opened every relic coffer in the vault! Good luck.
text.8965: {class}, listen closely. Now that we have the brazier, and the means to light it, we still need another component to suffuse it with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to entice the spirit of my deceased, former comrade. An ogre necromancer that traveled with us, Kormok, delighted in summoning forth the souls of the banished dead of Purgation Isle, off the south coast of the Hillsbrad Foothills. Go there and retrieve some Soul Ashes of the Banished from their remains.
text.96321: I... don't have much time, mortal. You must take this staff, a branch of the world tree... corrupted... wrong. I carried it here... The Wild Gods... they must know. Take it to her. The... crow... <The dying Wild God grows still and his eyes stare blankly ahead. What little is left of his corporeal form seems to break apart and drift away. There is a faintly glowing branch on the ground, with a sickly green crystal affixed to its head.>
text.93341: As the garden's caretaker, it was my responsibility to ensure it thrived. I knew there would come a day when I could no longer maintain it, so I enchanted a necklace gifted from my daughter to transform a new generation of saplings into treants, so they could watch over the garden in my stead. I placed it on an enchanted pedestal, sheltered within a small shrine. The garden was in great hands. I must know what happened.
text.99233: There must be more to the Maul than this! Perhaps the loud Spectator who oversees the event at Dire Maul will know!
text.95495: These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me. Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
text.79991: We are in desperate need of additional resources and reinforcements to support our objectives in Arathi Basin. Appropriate lumber has been particularly difficult to obtain and we've been forced to look as far as Stranglethorn Vale to source what we need. Bring me a Shipment of Stranglethorn Lumber and your support will not be overlooked.
text.98191: King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this Alliance at all. The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall. It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathedral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
text.2976: What?! Ah, so I did mention a bounty, didn't I? Well, that'll teach me to open my mouth, won't it? You did the work, so I suppose it is only right you reap the greatest reward from it. Take the horns, I'll have them put in a crate for you. Find Belgrom Rockmaul in the Valley of Honor, he'll want to know what you saw and he'll reward you for your hard work. Be well, {class}, and thank you again for everything you've done.
text.388: Bitterness flows through my veins like a cold river. My grandson, Mac, was such a good boy. A mere 14 years old. When the army was sent off to the front, Mac took up arms to defend the city. He was a guard in The Stockade, where the Defias gang is locked up. Mac reprimanded some of the prisoners for tearing their wool blankets to make scarves, a symbol of their gang. For that Mac was stabbed in the back. I want revenge. Bring me 10 of their precious Wool Bandanas. They are the color of blood.
text.4265: The pod splits opens some when you touch it, revealing a night elven male who is surprisingly still alive. He seems to be in good health, though deeply stunned. As you help him down from the pod, he stirs to life. "Thank Elune - you've saved me, friend! I... I'm Raschal, and I awoke paralyzed inside this pod after these bugs overwhelmed me. Were you sent by the Stronghold?" It would seem that you've found the missing courier!
text.1203: I have cutting to do. I can't tell you what I'm going to cut, but... I need myself a blade. A certain blade... Some people call it a moonsteel broadsword. I call it a swing blade. You help me? Maybe you find it in town, maybe you talk to a blacksmith and he'll make it special. But don't sleep on this. What I'm cutting won't keep forever...
text.98251: Gaaah! I'm so angry. They said Ashenvale was easy to follow. Easy for who? The beasts? The birds? One moment I was gathering an herb, the next I'm trapped in this ravine. Do I truly have to circle half the forest to reach where I stood just moments ago? When I'm like this, my spells grow volatile and behave... differently. Could you thin the wildlife nearby? Even their stupid hooves grate on me. I despise this cursed forest.
text.3042: The Sandfury trolls of Zul'Farrak make a tempering agent from sandstones, and I can use that to temper the goods I craft, yes I can! It is highly prized by connoisseurs, so if you bring me a good supply of the temper, then I'll reward you well. Zul'Farrak is northwest of Gadgetzan. Good luck.
text.620: This fine sash has the letters "HS" embroidered along its hem.
text.8577: If I am to translate anything, I will need my scrying goggles. Unfortunately, those were stolen quite some time ago by my ex-best friend forever, Stewvul. He broke my heart in five places and then left me here to rot. With the help of my trusty crystal ball, I've isolated his whereabouts to either the Greymane Wall in Silverpine or what appears to be a portal world in the Outland that is currently being overrun by the Burning Legion. You're going to have to track him down and get my goggles back, <name>!
text.95312: I don't have Friz's money. Well, I had her money, but I bet it all on ol' Slugjaw here in Fizbuz's arena in Gadgetzan. Don't gimme that look. It was a sound investment. I won big! I just haven't had a chance to collect my winnin's yet. If you're Friz's new errand boy, why don't you go get it for me? I got a bad back, you know. Hey, you don't want to go back to your boss empty handed, do ya? Gadgetzan is just west of here. You can't miss it.
text.7834: As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low. Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others. A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community! If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
text.94946: I had intended to be the first of us to step foot onto Azeroth, but recent events with the cult have changed my plans. As a result, I will be remaining here in Valanaar for a time. Fret not though, we have several mages awaiting our people's arrival in Dalaran. I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we set our affairs in order here. We will call upon agents such as yourself when you are needed. When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there.
text.79624: The recipe appears to be for some sort of meat dish. It is written in a language you don't understand. Ogre is your best guess, given the source and subject matter. Ogres aren't usually culinary types but, if you knew one with such an inclination, they could translate the recipe for you.
text.94973: <The moulding appears to be for a key.>
text.84190: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us. The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for. I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
text.93733: Introduce yourself to the others here so they won't be surprised to see a stranger helping out with some of the labor. <PH>
text.5508: A Corruptor's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge's overlords. A powerful being that holds a position of authority over the Scourge will always possess one. To slay such a malevolent creature would surely advance the cause of the Argent Dawn, and all good causes! On behalf of the Argent Dawn, I will give you a valor token in exchange for just a single one of these insignia. Use caution in acquiring one, <name> - such powerful beings are not to be trifled with.
text.1115: Now that we've done a service for the gnomes, it's time to do the goblins a favor! I hear that the goblin racer pilot, Nazz Steamboil, didn't always use that name. I wonder why he changed it. I wonder if it's a secret, and... I wonder if he values that secret. If anyone knows the truth, then it's Krazek of Booty Bay, on the southern tip of Stranglethorn. Speak with Krazek and ask him about our goblin pilot. If you can get useful information from him, then we might just turn a profit from it.
text.96025: Thank you for your help, <name>. A dear friend of mine awaits your arrival at the summit. You can find her up the road to the east.
text.7122: The mines in Alterac Valley hold more than just minerals. Both the Frostwolf and Stormpike have cached excess supplies in the Irondeep and Coldtooth mines... that's not a bad idea, if we could only maintain control of them! Capture a mine, then return to me. To capture a mine, enter one that we do not control and kill its leader. When you do that, the mine will be ours, and we'll send troops to protect it!
text.1453: There's work to be done in Desolace, <name>. It's an atrocious place, befouled by centaur and other nasties. But if you're looking for a good week's honest work, then head there, meet with Kreldig Ungor, and tell him I sentcha. You can find him holed up at Nijel's Point--it's a little cozy camp hidden in the mountains of northern Desolace. Just head east if you enter from the Stonetalon Mountains. It's easy to miss, so be on the lookout.
text.2721: As one chapter of your adventure closes, another one begins, <name>. One of my men is still unaccounted for, lost somewhere in the Blasted Lands. I am talking about Lieutenant Kirith, of course. As I had mentioned earlier, we were both imprisoned and tortured by Allistarj, but poor Kirith, his strength of will faltered. I could hear the experiments from my cage; the tortured screams rang through the halls of the cave. That was the last I saw or heard of Kirith.
text.863: I suppose I'll learn as we go... Couldn't be too hard. Just some buttons here, and a lever or two... Well, are you ready to go?
text.81776: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in Forest Song. Retrieve a Dream-Touched Dragonegg and deliver it to me.
text.5047: You'll find Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook, {class}. Tell him that 'Pip is A-OK' and that the suit works perfectly. Then hand him this: <Pip hands you a glowing piece of flesh.> I snatched it from the beast's innards during my 'vacation.' I bet Malyfous could give you a fairly accurate assessment of what he can do with parts from a monster like this! Oh, I suppose you don't know where Everlook is, do you? To Winterspring, fella!
text.93160: I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch! So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
text.219: At last, friends of the Alliance! Help... please... The last thing I remember these foul Orcs overpowered our regiment. Most the men were killed. I took a strong blow to the head and everything went black. Now I am held captive in this cave. Help me, I am hurt badly. I'll need help getting back to town... please... you're my last hope...
text.4981: Never trust a goblin. That's what it comes down to, <name>. Bijou is her name - one of our slipperiest operatives. I found out she was working for some shady exotic pet dealer out of the Burning Steppes named Kibler, in essence, two timing us. Worse yet, she was using Horde funds to finance her operations. I want her brought back here alive. She was last seen entering Blackrock Spire. Find her and bring her back. And <name>, do not let her sweet talk you.
text.88730: You fancy yourself a hero of the Dawn, eh? I've seen our greatest soldiers get rolled over by Kel'Thuzad's plebes! How well could someone so clueless possibly fare in Naxxramas? <Wilhelm sighs.> Bah, what choice do I got? You're the best I can do; I may as well help you. Omarion left me with one recipe. It's the only song I know... I can make a few variations of these pants; you just gotta supply the materials.
text.299: Just before the invasion I uncovered a large tablet called the Goaz Stone. The translated text breaks off in 4 places. The text speaks of a "divine plan" and a "doomed prophecy." I fear we are running out of time. I am too old to go down and brave those beasts. But you are strong. Scour the excavation site and uncover the 4 missing tablet fragments: Ados, Modr, Golm and Neru. Search for them in ancient artifacts or where the soil is loose. Bring them to me so I can begin unlocking the mystery!
text.2862: The gnolls... they are more than a nuisance. They are a constant threat to the existence of this very camp! It is irrelevant whether they are indigenous to Feralas or not; if we do not strengthen our resolve against them, we will find ourselves driven out of the entire region. The gnoll attacks against the camp have become more fevered as of late. We need your aid in thinning their numbers; bring to me ten of their manes, and I will reward you handsomely for your effort. Go!
text.98477: Any experienced shaman who attempts to scry the elemental plane can tell you that there is a blip of sorts, a distortion that you feel as you cross over to the other realms of existence. We have need of adventurers like yourself to help us better understand this disturbance. Take this Elemental Attractor. You will be able to extract motes of unstable magic with it from the most skilled spellcasters and other powerful entities you may encounter. Bring me these motes so that we may study them.
text.98065: You must bring this to Tyrande at once! I will transfer it to a more ceremonial container for you. Do not be afraid. The High Priestess of Elune is firm, but kind. She protects all who enter Darnassus, and carries our goddess' light to all. She will be glad to receive this sacred water. You will find her directly above us.
text.6563: Within the beginning tunnels of Blackfathom Deeps, large sapphire clusters can be found along the cave walls. Recently it was noted that the naga were harvesting the crystals. Until it can be discerned why, I sense we should stop the naga from succeeding. The crystals have great elemental power and if used inappropriately, could make for a powerful arcane component. Will you help me, <name>? Blackfathom Deeps can be found along Zoram Strand to the north of our outpost.
text.95810: You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.' Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.
text.932: I must warn you, <name>, this matter must stay between us. The satyr are enough of an embarrassment to us already, and this one is much too close to home. He is called Lord Melenas. He resides in the nearby cave of Fel Rock where he has gathered a large group of grell warriors. His heart is black as night, and he plots something most foul. You must find him within his nearby cave just to the north of here, and bring me his head.
text.97447: Well met, {class}. I've something that might interest you. I have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor. The blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment. Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. You shall find the effort worth your while.
text.96126: I'm not sure how you got in here, but please, listen to me. As you know, I serve as a watchman for Farholde Keep. While on patrol, I was ambushed by a band of these brutes and taken prisoner. Now, I am forced to fight in the ring for their amusement. I haven't much strength left. If I'm to escape, it's now or never. My captor is an ogre they call "Gronok the Butcher". He has the key to my shackles. Will you bring me that key and help me out of here?
text.94733: Alright, so you won a few battles. I think you might have what it takes to make it here after all. Before I convince our next combatant to jump into the ring with you there's something I need from you first--food for Chub'chob's pet boar, Snufflesnout. I promised I'd look after it, and, well, this gig here's keepin' me quite busy. Trust me, this'll benefit the both of us. Mosey on over to the east of Clugfist's clubhouse. You're lookin' for a shy fella who goes by the name Gobam.
text.509: Another day, another elixir to be made. If it were up to me, I'd just let the pathetic humans and Scourge fight it out. They seem bent on killing each other as is. Alas, our Dark Lady wants to help speed up the process a tad so why not pass these morbid days by spreading a little death and disease across the land? Here's the plan, <name>: you go out to Nethander Stead, south of Tarren Mill and east of the river and Southshore. Collect for me 6 Mudsnout Blossoms from the field for my next elixir.
text.97236: A fresh specimen from a beast of this size is quite a find. Perhaps someone in Aldrassil familiar with the study of spiders would be interested in the fang.
text.1475: According to legend, The Temple of Atal'Hakkar is a holy shrine dedicated to the ancient god, Hakkar the Soulflayer. Maintained by a vicious tribe of trolls named the Atal'ai, the temple is rumored to be impenetrable. Now sunk beneath the Pool of Tears, retrieving artifacts from the temple is even more difficult. But that's what I need you to do, <name>. Aid me by gathering the intact Atal'ai Tablets. Bring them to me and I will return to the Explorers' Guild a hero. Together we will share the glory.
text.97007: I've stamped the pertinent pages for Abigail's records and updated our own documents. Abigail will have to send a follow-up to the Royal Census when she intends to transport any of the property into Forsaken territories. You may return her ledger and bring with it a reminder: Her contractual obligations to the War Quarter's commissary are not yet fulfilled, so she would be prudent to wait before attempting to act on any of these pre-war ownership claims.
text.95663: The Dragonmaw are a formidable clan. They're known for binding magic strong enough to make dragons serve, and rumor claims they're preparing some display of it in the Wetlands. Whether truth or bluster, the Deathstalkers can't act on half-formed whispers. Broken symbols carried only that much to me. A deathstalker agent needs a hand in the hills above the Dragonmaw encampment. Meet her there. She'll reveal the next steps.
text.94982: Our scouts mentioned a network of caves to the northwest along the mountains, hidden by natural surroundings. Most who sought information from deep within have yet to return. I fear they may be lost. Those watching from a distance mentioned a Twilight presence moving in and out of the caves, often in darkness. Locate this stronghold. If it is what I think it is we must deliver a deathly blow to their leader. Only then may we continue our efforts to remove them from these lands.
text.95350: It's a big world down here, and our new allies are the key to our survival. The Earthen Ring is a member of the "Horde", a proud collection of like-minded peoples. The nearby city of Thunder Bluff is a part of the Horde, and further to the east lies the capital of Orgrimmar. Seek out the flight master in the center of Thunder Bluff. They will fly you to Orgrimmar where you will make contact with the Horde warchief--Thrall, on behalf of the Windshapers. Winds guide you, <name>.
text.92465: The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent. Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove. Will you lend me your aid, {class}?
text.90865: Just north of here lies the ruins of battles past. A dwindling scourge presence remains. Though the mindless undead are a threat themselves, the watchers maintain a vigilant eye on those entering the area, making removal of the scourge threat even more difficult. Remove the threat by taking from these watchers that which they value most.
text.8288: There is no time to waste! A hero must be found! The task I give will require an army to complete but only one may rise from the throng of would be champions to take on the burden and responsibility of an ally of the Brood. Within the lair of the Lord of Blackrock is a most cruel beast. The Broodlord Lashlayer guards the Halls of Strife, blocking the way into Nefarian's inner sanctum. Slay the foul aberration and return his head to me. Do this and you may begin the next step of your journey.
text.4801: In Winterspring, you will fight great cats called frostsabers. These beasts possess incredible speed an' cunning. If you wish ta gain the speed a' da frostsaber, bring me da E'ko you find from dem. Rememba, you must have the Cache of Mau'ari in your inventory if you want ta hunt for E'ko.
text.8806: The Cenarion Hold guard is in short supply of grinding stones. Procure a batch and deliver them immediately to Captain Vish Kozus in Cenarion Hold.
text.99204: You have returned. Good. It's time to take your next steps. Ogunaro will provide you with a free mount once you have completed your final leg of training with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like, as before. Speak to me when you have enough gold, and I will finish your training.
text.449: Although Quinn's wounds are mending, I want to get our report to High Executor Hadrec as quickly as possible. It has information that is vital to the Forsaken's occupation of Silverpine.
text.269: Go to the city of Stormwind and speak with Bishop Farthing in the Cathedral of Light. Give him Jitters' journal and tell him you mean to face Morbent Fel. Although Stormwind has forsaken Darkshire, Farthing is a kind soul and very wise. He may help you on your quest to save us. Your mission is perilous, but hurry, <name>. With each passing hour, the shadows of Duskwood grow ever darker.
text.81977: You find a small smooth purple stone. It has many irregular facets, the largest of which seems to house a cloudy mineral formation that you notice seems to shimmer and swirl slightly in the light. As you concentrate harder on that movement however, you feel an increasing sense of unease. You are about to discard it when you have a sudden feeling, almost an urge to keep it with you for now.
text.95432: When Crag'rog hear {race}-ling free ogres, Crag'og want free ogres too. With tiny {class} here, we smash Twilight together. Break them bones. Make them scream. Free ogres! Then be home in time for stew.
text.850: The centaurs have plagued the Tauren for years. And recently, the Kolkar centaurs of the Barrens have grown into a real threat. Normally they were disorganized in these lands, but new leaders have risen among them. Rallying them. To preserve our holdings here, these centaur leaders must be destroyed. Bring me the head of Barak Kodobane. He camps near the Forgotten Pools to the north. Defeat him, then return to me.
text.6582: We are Deathwing's children, whelp. Our dominance over the lesser Aspects must be enforced. If you are truly worthy of ascension, the lesser dragonflight will wilt in your presence. Find their champions and lay waste to them in the name of our Father! Travel to Winterspring and track down the mighty blue drake, Scryer. Crush him and any of the Blue Flight that stand in your path. Tear out his skull and return it to me.
text.81860: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Ruins of Ravenwind. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Anadelle there and return to me.
text.1264: The beginning of every month the Kul Tiras Marines all get paid and usually leave Theramore for somewhere else. A lot of them come here to womanize, carouse, and just have a good time. One of those groups I'd consider regulars here at the tavern, and I believe this Hendel is among them. Commander Samaul in Theramore would be able to help you find him if Hendel's still stationed there. He's completely loyal to Proudmoore, but if you drop Elling's name, he should help you out... discretely.
text.87295: You may have seen the Redstone basilisks wandering the wastes outside while you were on your way to Nethergarde Keep. They're tough creatures, well adapted to survival in the Blasted Lands. One of their key qualities is their sturdy scales, which reflect heat, protect against sand and wind, and even deflect weapon blows! They're a perfect material for making shields, and if you can bring me a bundle, I'll compensate you well. Only bring ones in good condition!
text.802: So you want to brave the perils of Lordaeron? You've come to the right place, <name>. Say the word and I'll take you directly to the Undercity! <<Note: Our crack team of artists, programmers and aviation engineers are currently hard at work preparing the "real" zeppelin for your flying pleasure. In the meantime, please enjoy this free teleport instead. -- Thanks, --WoW Team>>
text.120: These are trying times, {class}. The township is under constant siege. Without reinforcements, we will certainly face defeat. The message I now entrust to you is of utmost importance. Get this report to General Marcus Jonathan of Stormwind immediately. Once your delivery is made, return to me at once with any news, be it good or bad. Now make haste!
text.8053: You are a heathen. Heathens have a place in the tribe. Heathens are freethinkers of Zandalar. Freethinkers do not fear oppression. Freethinkers die for what they believe in. We know you would die for what you believe in. This earns our acknowledgement. This earns you a chance to prove yourself further. We must have the Paragons of Power. Go to Zul'Gurub. Kill the minions of Hakkar. Return when you have what I seek. Claim the first battle gear of a Zandalar freethinker. Go.
text.20: The Blackrock orcs have travelled from the Burning Steppes and claimed Stonewatch Keep to the north. From there they maraud the areas north of Lakeshire and keep its citizens in town, penned like cattle. Help rid Lakeshire of this menace. Kill these Blackrock orcs and bring me ten of their Battleworn Axes as proof. And although Blackrocks threaten us from the north, we've received reports of more in the southeastern pocket of Redridge. If you find any there, then they too should be hunted.
text.92009: There's something you should know about this order. There's a few inverted mana cells padded as well as I could at the bottom of the box. The cells have a tendency to discharge when they get bumped, and when not stabilized in time. It takes about two hours for the contents to fizzle. Kaylaena will know what to do when she receives them, but I suggest going slow if you're going to ride saddled up Mount Hyjal. If you need a refill, come back and I'll top off the canisters. Be careful, you know?
text.2841: Gnome technology - two years ago its most common use was as a punch line. Times certainly have changed. Now they've got a new rig built that's better than all our shredder models combined. I need the blueprints, <name>! Unfortunately, the plans are locked away in a safe near Mekgineer Thermaplugg. To make matters worse, the combination to the safe is only known by Mekgineer Thermaplugg. Do whatever you have to do to get that combination, <name>. Then crack open that safe and bring back those blueprints!
text.94411: Be warned, members of the High Order have been seen in the vicinity of the standing stones north of the village. We have warned them time and again to not meddle at our sacred sites, but they are growing more bold in pushing us. Prove your resolve to us by going to the standing stones and dispersing them. I am loathe to condone outright bloodshed, but do what you must to drive them off. Return to me when it's done.
text.5536: The satyr, a disfigured, evil aspect of the night elves, now infect the sacred lands once traveled by Cenarius. I cannot speak for the night elves when it comes to all the atrocities those demonic creatures have committed, but I have sworn an oath to the Earthmother to aid the elves in ridding the land of such a nuisance. I am sure you would prove yourself if you aided me in purging them. Northeast of here, you can find the Haldarr clan. Return to me after you've tested yourself against their power.
text.3366: The shard is a brilliant green, and although solid, what looks like smoke swirls just below the surface. You can't help staring into the depths of the crystal; at the same time, you know there is something very disturbing about it. Maybe you should see if anyone in Ratchet can tell you more about this strange shard.
text.79099: Greetings {class}. I've heard the most curious stories from the locals of a great corrupted water elemental named Baron Aquanis that stands vigil near the entrance to the Night Elf ruins known as Blackfathom Deeps. I'm here looking to hire adventurers brave enough to retrieve the core of Baron Aquanis, a globe of corrupted water. In exchange, I'd be willing to give you access to a portal directly to the Zoram Strand that I've been using to study the environs around the ruins... from a safe distance, of course.
text.6285: The gryphon master in Westfall is Thor. If you've spoken to him before, then you can take one of my gryphons to him. That's a good lesson to know: gryphons are always trained to fly to their capital city, but they'll only take you to a remote gryphon master after you've already been there. You've already been to Thor, so just speak with me again when you're ready to take a gryphon to Westfall. Once there, you can deliver Osric's Crate to Quartermaster Lewis.
text.8741: The keeper awaits your return, <name>. Take the green scepter shard to Anachronos at the Caverns of Time.
text.92016: The roots of Nordrassil stretch far and deep, thicker than riverbanks and older than memory. Such great size carries a great hunger. In healthy times, they drink of decay and renewal alike, drawing strength from the endless turning of the natural cycle. But Hyjal has been wounded, its soil fouled by demonic venom. Descend into the deepest depths of the Well of Eternity. Study the roots there closely. We must know whether they have drawn in too much corruption... or if the World Tree may yet endure.
text.543: The Perenolde Tiara is an old heirloom of the Perenolde "nobles" - the ruling family of Alterac before that kingdom fell to ruin. It is said to have been crafted by master jewelers in Ironforge, and fitted with the finest of emeralds. When Alterac was destroyed the Tiara was lost, but there are rumors that an Ogre Mage, Grel'borg the Miser, found the tiara and now wanders the Ruins of Alterac searching for more treasures. We would have you acquire the tiara for us.
text.592: I have reshaped the Mind's Eye into a Soul Gem. Its purpose is twofold: you must use it to stun Yenniku, and once stunned place it upon his head to entrap his soul. Then, bring the gem to Nimboya. Yenniku dwells with Zanzil the Outcast, at the Ruins of Aboraz, along the Crystal Shore on the distant Cape of Stranglethorn.
text.9038: During your battles with the Scourge in Naxxramas, should you come across desecrated battlements and wartorn plate scraps, return them to me and I shall craft for you a piece of armor worn by heroes.
text.513: Just when I thought another day was going to pass devoid of any joy, you brought me those marvelous Mudsnout Blossoms. First I will mix them down into a fine composite. We'll then need Master Apothecary Faranell in the Undercity to apply his colloid of decay to it and then we'll be ready for some good fun indeed! Here, take this Mudsnout Composite and run it off to Master Faranell at once, <name>.
text.95568: You have arrived on Mount Hyjal at a time of changes, stranger. You may have seen that the landscape is scarred by the old war and tainted by fel energies. For Hyjal to survive, nature must bloom again. If you are willing to help me gather seeds from some of the untainted plants, I would be grateful. Many flowers grow in the wild lands east of here. Look for small red or yellow flowers.
text.84171: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, <name>. As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance. For now I will exchange your belt and gloves. If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
text.5157: Deep within Jaedenar lies Shadow Hold--the main fortress of their corruption and evil. The Shadow Council has protective spells surrounding their lair in the form of braziers. If I am to find out any more information about our enemy through scrying, then those braziers must be extinguished. By doing so, I should be able to spy on the Council and find out who leads them. If you can, take this canteen and fill it at the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar. Return to me afterwards.
text.713: Let me tell you something about Frost Oil: nothing can keep an engine or gears from overheating quite like it. Its cooling properties are extraordinary, and its longevity as a lubricant without equal. That's not all: it also aids in retaining enchantments on magical items. I need a vial of it to increase the magical capacity of my shackles and make them powerful enough to stop our summoned friend from killing us all. Bro'kin, a goblin friend of mine, can teach you to make it. He's in Alterac.
text.94313: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa White Bandit Mask, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.96874: Have you seen the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge? I keep thinking the spines on their backs would be perfect for crafting the head of a mighty axe. Saru laughed when I told him... but what does he know!? As part of your smithing lessons, you can help me out! Bring me some of those spines, along with grinding stones to sharpen them.
text.93786: Does your blade thirst for human blood, <name>? Some years ago, the human defectors laid claim to a small farm to the southwest across the river. With the area rich in lumber and stone, it was only a matter of time before they expanded their reach to the keep along the eastern shore known as Farholde. Our first skirmishes would have ended in our favor if we'd had the numbers. It's time to remind them of our presence. Disrupt their farming efforts. Take no prisoners. Send them a clear message.
text.90518: It is good to see you again. I have had no troubles keeping the kitchen stocked since you have been away, but I did notice this morning that I am just shy enough apples to make a pie. I thought it was time to give myself a little treat. If you can spare a few minutes, could you stop by the orchard and grab a few? Unfortunately I still haven't made Johnny's pie yet either, but I can't make a pie without apples and I won't waste apples on Johnny's pie! I will, of course, share a slice with you.
text.94276: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Wicked Mithril Blade, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.6566: It is good to see you again, <name>. The wind carries with it news from the Eastern Kingdom. Sit, listen.
text.4285: What could they be for? I can't get the thought out of my head! It's driving me crazy -- that the rumors I have heard about the crystal pylons are all true. Call me gullible, but I'll usually believe anything people tell me. Anyway, I have heard that there is one of the crystal pylons fairly close. Somewhere in the north... Please locate it, <name>. I just know they exist.
text.8432: The battle in Warsong Gulch rages on, <name>. Do your part to drive the Silverwing Sentinels out of our lands!
text.6221: There is a camp of Deadwood furbolgs directly to our southwest. Corruption permeates the camp, and I wish to put an end to it before they become a problem. The Deadwood tribe is evil, but it is the effects of the fel that pollutes their minds. Their hostility is not truly an innate quality, yet they cannot be helped. For this reason, I am deeply saddened by having to fight my own brethren. Please, <name>, do what must be done, and do not mention the details; they upset me far too much.
