If you wouldn't mind, I'd like to know what they're talking about. I'm sure it's nothing to worry about, but you can never tell with demons, right?
text.3912: This elixir will allow you to speak with one that you would not normally even see... Take the Videre elixir, along with Linken's sword, to the graveyard just outside Gadgetzan in Tanaris. Once there, drink the potion. You may be quite surprised at the results, but do not be alarmed. In your "other" form, head due north until you reach the mountains. You'll find the one you need to speak with in one of the rocky crevices. His name is Gaeriyan. Remember, he will only speak to you in that form...
text.91531: Return to Belgrom in Orgrimmar. He will want to see her head for himself! Ah, this is indeed a good day. Thank you for your help, <name>.
text.8163: Although the Defilers have done well in breaking the supply lines of the League of Arathor, Alliance has proven quite stubborn in its want of Arathi Basin. We must continue to send our own troops into the basin and come out with more of their resource crates.
text.91608: There are few luxuries out here on the frontier. A barrel of good drink would surely boost the camp's morale. In my younger days, I took a recipe for a delicious brew off the corpse of a dwarf I killed. All I need is some honey. Fortunately, the wasp nests to the west are overflowing with it. Take my pellet gun. This will allow you to knock the nests out of the trees. Be warned, however, it will do little against the wasps themselves.
text.23: <The paw of the mighty bear Ursangous is your trophy for this part of the Ashenvale Hunt. On the paw is a small quarter-crescent emblem; the significance of the emblem remains a mystery. The paw should be brought to Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post to prove that you have bested the mighty creature and completed this portion of the hunt.>
text.8731: Greetings, <name>. Before I assign you to more involved tasks in the war, you'll need to do your share of field duty. You will find Captain Skullsplit's Orgrimmar Legion outside Hive'Regal. Report to him and come back to me with proof of your field service. I shall have a more advanced assignment ready for you. Oh, please do your best to stay away from the Ironforge Brigade. Tensions are high among our Alliance and Horde volunteers.
text.1001: A tiny voice crackles from deep within the machine. "Wizbang here! The next Buzzbox is north of Auberdine, on the beach So, that Buzzbox is number 411 and it needs 3 Thresher Eyes for its repairs. They're just off the coast! The darkshore threshers... *Hic*... Sorry about that... Just like last time, when you give the Buzzbox the goods, it'll spit out your reward. *Hic*... What? No, I'm fine!"
text.95991: It's dangerous enough transportin' horses 'round the glades without talk of some mysterious phantom crocolisk snappin' up my prized ponies! They say this one must be at least three times as big as a regular croc. And twice as mean! I ain't a gamblin' man. I ain't takin' no chances with my horses till someone puts this good-fer-nothin' monster down. If anyone finds this varmint along the rivers, bring me its tooth so's I know it's safe to travel again. Till then, I'm stayin' put! -- Wheatley
text.134: A few weeks ago I was picking herbs far from my house, and a band of ogres attacked me! I ran, and I was forced to leave behind a crate of precious tools and herbs. After they chased me off, the ogres swaggered back to the ogre mound in southern Duskwood. I'm sure my crate is somewhere near the mound. Please, <name>, retrieve this crate for me for I miss it sorely.
text.8498: Our scouts have reported new battle orders being issued by the Twilight's Hammer leaders. The orders are being distributed by Twilight Prophets under heavy escort. Intercept the orders and bring them to Commander Mar'alith.
text.8856: With the arrival of fresh recruits to Cenarion Hold comes the problem of keeping them alive in the desert. Dehydration as well as numerous poisonous creatures present a serious threat to inexperienced volunteers. Gather the supplies necessary for a desert survival kit and bring them to Calandrath in Cenarion Hold.
text.3442: You have made the right decision, <name>. We must strike where we will do the most damage: the four sentry towers. With the four towers in flames, we can initiate an offensive before they have time to react. You will need the proper tool to set the towers ablaze. To make the tool requires some materials. Bring me four hearts of flame and four golem oil and I shall craft the torch of flawless flame. The golems and elementals in these lands should be your first target.
text.5248: <name>, I weep for what has happened in the past. Like this crystal, the elves, as a race, have been shattered. I do not know if the pieces will ever again be reunited into one, but my sorrow has been eased by being able to help you with this one small task. We must not forget the past, <name>... Please take the Crystal of Zin-Malor back to Lake Kel'Theril. You must find a highborne spirit that realizes the error of what was done so long ago. Show the spirit that we have made things right again.
text.94282: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Craftsman's Monocle, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.409: You say you are not bound by the will of the Lich King, and the enchantment Bethor placed upon my book corroborates this. But before I believe you I must have proof that you are enemy to the Scourge. There is an old, bloody altar just off the southern coast of this island. it is used by a powerful Scourge agent, Lillith Nefara. Take a Candle of Beckoning from this crate here. Light it on the altar and Lillith will awake. Destroy Lillith, and I will believe you are the Lich King's foe.
text.1028: Here is the completed rod, <name>. Reconstructing it was simple... it's finding the shrine that has the power to recharge it that will be the hard part. With some focus and effort it shouldn't be too hard for someone like you, who's already accomplished so much. Head southeast of here--there are very few paths, so be careful--and keep your eyes to the north. The shrine is hidden within the mountains that surround this glade. Once there, place the rod within the shrine... the rest is magic. Hehe.
text.7423: You do a good thing for these humans, <name>. Continue spreading your healing touch to those races less fortunate than ours. Each human bone chip is another potential soul that is saved from living out a bleak existence as one of the filthy and downtrodden masses.
text.96108: Arrows are always essential, but sometimes you need something more potent to take down your prey. This is where poison coatings come into play. They ruin the meat, but if you need something dead, they do the job. Poisons can either be brewed or, if you are brave, gathered. You strike me as the latter. The vipers by the pools to the south produce a powerful venom. If I have estimated you correctly, I think you could collect some of it.
text.88715: Bring me any doomed souls that cross your path, <name>. Let me rephrase that - you MUST bring them to me. MY duty is to stay and guide the souls of the lost. YOUR duty is to bring them to me. A word of advice, never handle more than one soul at a time. Trust me, your soul can only handle so much, and your mind... well... it can handle even less. This burden is now yours. Because you can, you must. Consider this a moral obligation.
text.5068: It is said that only one Breastplate of Bloodthirst has ever been created and that it was made for the legendary assassin, Garona. Whether this world will ever see another is doubtful. Regardless! Our master crafters can reproduce the item given the necessary components: *The pristine hide of the Beast. *Frayed abomination stitchings. *Arcanite bars. *The skin of shadow. BEHOLD!
text.147: If the "Collector" is taking gold from our mines then he's stealing from the kingdom! Bring the Collector to justice, and bring me the ring mentioned in the pickup schedule you gave me. It may tell us whom the Collector is working for... That Pickup Schedule says the Collector is hiding out at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch. You should search for him there.
text.8735: You must travel to the four dream portals of Azeroth. From each you must draw a fragment of the Nightmare's corruption. The dragonkin that inhabit these areas will hold such fragments. Return to me when you have gathered these fragments.
text.96085: The impurities in this sample look organic in nature. Not quite waste, but certainly something toxic. I am no expert on wildlife, but I would guess that there is something upstream causing the water contamination. Some kind of animal, or at least a creature. Follow the rivers as far north as you can, and see if you can find what is responsible for this. If it is an animal, it must be put down. It is for the safety of all here in Farholde.
text.66293: You open the aged and weathered tome and discover text detailing a necromantic ritual. Perhaps Archmage Tarsis would be interested in having this information.
text.7222: A {class}? Good! We are glad to see you in Alterac, <name>. Interloping dwarves and their allies invade our valley, and we welcome all in the Horde to join us in righteous slaughter! Speak with Voggah Deathgrip. He is looking for agents for an important mission into the Alliance's stronghold in Alterac Valley! You will find Voggah in Frostwolf Keep.
text.89257: Staying on top of your trade is crucial for maintaining a high standard of quality. Our soldiers entrust their lives to unnamed craftsmen, and to me for ensuring the quality of every piece of armor. My task for you is simple. If you are well practiced in Tailoring, Leatherworking, or Blacksmithing, then craft a chestpiece, purely for your own benefit. You are free to keep the result. If you lack the skill, commission and donate any piece of the crusade's uniform instead.
text.7490: You have accomplished the impossible. The brood mother of the Black Dragonflight lies dead at your feet. Take her head and present it to your Warchief.
text.8663: You seek to prove your worth to my kind, mortal? Very well, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance. The ancient sandworm, Ouro, is a being of legendary power. He is rumored to have been created by the Old God himself as a mockery of life. His skin is unnatural... thick, nearly impregnable, yet it's flexible and allows him to move with the speed and grace of a much smaller creature. Bring me a sample of his skin along with other minor components and I shall craft you leggings of great power.
text.78922: Strength has left me. Your help is needed! Long ago this site was a great temple of Elune. But misfortune led to ruin when the corruption of an Old God seeped up from beneath the earth and tainted the sacred Moon Well. Aku'Mai, servant of the Old God, rose from the waters. The Twilight's Hammer cultists have allied with the naga to occupy these grounds. The cultists, led by Kelris, sacrifice innocents to Aku'Mai for power. Slay Kelris and bring his head to Bashana in Thunder Bluff, <name>, please.
text.96998: The skeleton still clutching a throwing spear has the telltale signs of a troll headhunter. In one of its bony clutches is a wrap of leather adorned with troll characters and smudges of face tints in Darkspear colors. This must have been a makeup pouch used to apply war paint. Darkspear tribe members may recognize the writing on the sacred skins.
text.4803: In Winterspring, you will find large bears wit extremely thick hides. These Shardtooth bears gain much protection from what dey can withstand. If you wish ta gain the resistance against fire, bring me da E'ko you find from da Shardtooth. Rememba, you must have the Cache of Mau'ari in your inventory if you want ta hunt for E'ko.
text.487: The road to Darnassus must be kept safe. Travelers heading from Dolanaar to Darnassus have been reporting ruthless attacks by corrupted furbolgs from the Gnarlpine tribe. Important news and commerce travels to and from Darnassus by way of this road daily. We cannot afford to have a rogue band of heathens terrorizing people. Take up arms in the name of the sacred forest, {class}. Their den lies somewhere below this vantage point. Slay 6 of these Gnarlpine ambushers and report back to me.
text.92840: Fillion was sent to the Overlook Standing Stones with a special device used to measure and study the elemental energy there. Take this--an Index Esoteria--and use it to extract data from the massive windstone formations that form there. Be on your guard however, as the Windshapers are likely to be jealously guarding this site now. Should any attempt to obstruct you, well... do what you need to do. I have no more patience for their interference.
text.8485: Your deeds go beyond the tale of a simple hero, <name>. If you are a representative of your people, then your people are ones we would work to make peace with. Please - take this offering to the orcish warchief that resides in the lands of Durotar; I believe you call this city Orgrimmar. In times past, he had tried to make contact with us on behalf of his Horde. It is now only fitting to acknowledge you as the key in your Horde's efforts in brokering peace.
text.97235: <name>, a moment of your time, please? I have heard the others speak praise of your deeds within the Barrow Deeps. Conveniently, I was recently commissioned to create rings to empower our ranks. I would like to give you the opportunity to pick the first among those I craft. I have the gemstones necessary, but without enchanted metals they will fail to be of any use. Enchanted Thorium Bars will satisfy this need. I, and the Watchers, would be grateful if you could procure some for us.
text.88968: Seek out High Overlord Saurfang in the Valley of Strength.
text.98156: <name>, you have been so helpful to me I hate to ask for yet another favor. It will be some time until I am able to return home to Stormwind. I was wondering if you would mind delivering these pelts to my sisters in my stead? I am sure you are more likely to return there before I am able to. Please deliver these pelts to my sisters Kelly and Kimberly in Stormwind. They can usually be found in the Park.
text.97413: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us. The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for. I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
text.94892: It's too late for me, stranger. I'm not going to be making it out of this one. Take my crest to the Knight Commander. Warn him... <Ryan's eyes begin to glaze over as he mumbles to himself.> I'm sorry. I should have come home. Abigail...
text.97252: It is finished. With this we can enter the Vord'anaar prisons and put an end to our fallen sisters. Take no pity on them, <name>. They were dead the moment the corruption took hold of their hearts. Ashal thera'das!
text.48: In the land to the south where vines twist and creep Lies a hidden well where the water runs deep Pure as the Light's sacred Daughter Bring to me now some Holy Spring Water.
text.1486: As Naralex descended deeper into his nightmare, a strange breed of beasts arose from beneath the Barrens into the Wailing Caverns. These deviate creatures have strange, otherworldly properties. While evil in nature, it is my opinion that some good can come from their existence here in Kalimdor. I believe their hides will be of particular use in the ways of leatherworking. If you feel up to the task, venture into the caves below and retrieve some deviate hides.
text.95425: Klunk once Clugfist's greatest champion. Him strong. Me give Klunk mighty weapon. But Clugfist wrong. Klunk weak like others. He leave Bolder'ok. Return to Twilight's Hammer. Take ogres with him to cave east to water. Take mighty weapon with him! That Clugfist weapon! Bash Klunk's skull and take back Skullbasher. He nobody's champion!
text.91882: Years ago, the Horde and the Alliance put aside their differences to fight a greater threat--the Legion. On Mount Hyjal, the Grand Alliance forces battled Archimonde and his minions to a halt. The retreat from the mountain was perilous, however, and some brave fighters were left behind. Now that the way up the great mountain is again open, perhaps some of these heroes remain alive in the wilds? Go to Mount Hyjal and brave its dangers. Find what became of our forces there.
text.4861: Hey there, lad! I was chased from my camp in southern Winterspring by some bloodthirsty wildkin! Well, I suppose I got too close to something the wildkin were guarding. I barely managed to get away safely; I fear a buddy of mine wasn't as lucky. Would you mind braving the wildkin and heading to the camp? I really need my supplies, and I'd also like to get back the amulet I unearthed yesterday at the dig site.
text.1268: Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.
text.95769: Every day be a challenge when you living rough like we do! Takes a toll on your tools, your clothes, your whole life. Good thing it can't take our spirit! We be really hurting from our clothes and blankets wearing out. You do some tailoring, right? So maybe you can bring me some Bolts of Runecloth and I can fix a few holes?
text.1099: What did I tell you! There's no way we goblins are going to lose in a race like this to a bunch of scrapheap, junkyard gnomes. Now, if you've got a valid ticket, hand it over here.
text.1426: I have no love for the sea, nor any creature I've seen come from its depths. It is a powerful but blind mistress; callous and brutal. It would bring me great pleasure to slay the fish men by the hundreds if it were within my power. But I garner some pleasure from watching their deaths at the hands of any who do the Horde's will. Which brings us to you, {class}. How many can you slay? Would you test yourself against their most powerful kind?
text.2801: Before we may continue, you must hear my story.
text.184: This is the deed to an expanse of farmlands within Westfall. It is signed by a Theodore Furlbrow and cosigned by his wife, Verna. And on the back of the deed are hastily scrawled words: "We leaned on Furlbrow and got his deed. Thought it might be handy if you wanted to forge one of these for your own place. The Furlbrows won't give us trouble. Last I saw them they were on their way out of Westfall, stuck with a broken wagon." You think the Furlbrows might want their deed back...
text.95697: Zamja tells me we need more homestyle cooking. If we start selling raptor, she thinks it'll draw in customers who don't usually visit Borstan's Firepit. Her idea is not so bad. But I want something that rises above the smells of our birth villages. We're in Orgrimmar! Borstan should serve a grand take on their familiar favorites. A hunter recently came back from the Wetlands with a giant talon from the thicket raptors in the Excavation Sites. Up for a job?
text.81872: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Oneiros. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Mellias Earthtender there and escort him to safety. Then return to me.
text.95611: One cannot take without giving in return. This is the cycle of life. You have done well, <name>. Thanks to your efforts, the wildlife on the mountain will continue to thrive. Now, it is time we show our respect for these lands by offering the unused remains back to the ground. Take this bundle and visit the shrine to the west. You shall recognize it as a simple pair of standing stones. Return to me once the ritual is complete.
text.938: The sabercat's fur is a distinctive gray color, blending into the surrounding forest. As she lays there, you observe that she is badly wounded, with deep lacerations across her back and stomach. She raises her head and gazes at you, bright intelligence shining in blue eyes. She seems to wish to follow you.
text.95219: Got another job for ya, kiddo. How do you feel about traveling the world? This here is some of the finest port you ever laid eyes on. Trouble is, it's gotta go quite the distance to one of my customers all the way over to Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas. When you've reached trees taller than you've ever seen before, you know you've reached the spot. One of my guys packed it airtight but there's no telling what might set it off, so handle with care, okay bub?
text.6606: We can always use a little luck, eh? A small advantage is all it takes to turn things in your favor... I happened to make the acquaintance of a rather eccentric witch doctor some time back. She made me a lucky charm... for a price. Believe me, though, it was well worth it! Maybe you'd be interested in one of your own? Find Witch Doctor Mau'ari in Everlook. I'm not giving mine up!
text.4765: I have packaged Doomriggers Clasp into a crate, suitable for shipment to Stormwind. <name>, you have been extremely helpful -- can I ask you for one last favor? Deliver the crate to Count Remington Ridgewell. You will find him in the Keep of Stormwind. I am sure he'll be very pleased to see what you have for him.
text.19: Blackrock Outrunners and Renegades are running ambushes between here and Stonewatch Keep. The leader of the Outrunners is an orc named Tharil'zun--we want this orc. Bring me the head of Tharil'zun!
text.4132: You have done an exemplary job, <name>. It is now time to send you on your last mission. General Angerforge, the Dark Iron responsible for coordinating the attacks on the 109th division of the K.E.F. and the mass slaughter of our forces must be brought to justice. This will undoubtedly be your most grueling mission, but should you succeed, you will be richly rewarded.
text.461: I know of a hidden niche within the keep that holds an item dear to Thule, and his old colleagues. It also holds something you might find useful. Take me there! The alcove is in the southwestern tower of the keep, behind a dusty shelf. Take my body, but leave my boots. They never fit me anyway...
text.84151: Well met, {class}. I've something that might interest you. I have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor. The blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment. Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. You shall find the effort worth your while.
text.82017: The dread aura you experienced emanates not from a place, but from a creature. A particularly deadly creature of darkness, a twisted shadow reflection of the worst aspects of our world, coalesced into an amalgamation of pure nightmare. I can't explain how I know this but I... dreamt of it. Or rather, it was shown to me. It's difficult to explain. Please, go to Moonglade and speak with the druid Loganaar. There may still be time to stop it before it gets even more powerful.
text.7604: The undersigned hereby declares that the Sulfuron ingot they are delivering to the Thorium Brotherhood (TB Ltd.) is genuine and not a facsimile thereof. The undersigned also acknowledges that any harm that should come to him as a result of attempting to build, forge, find, create, sell, or eat Sulfuras, is not the responsibility or fault of TB Ltd. By signing this contract, you are agreeing to all terms listed herein. _________________ Signature
text.8310: I think I can formulate an elixir that will allow us to more readily decipher the glyphs and language of the silithid and Qiraji! What do I need? Glad you asked! I need brains! More specifically, a brain from each silithid type that inhabit the hives. Bring me brains and Rutgar's work might not be for naught.
text.91500: <Seeing how the energies of the crystals are attuned to the seals, you reason that destroying a seal, thereby releasing its energy all at once, could cause its crystal to do the same. The explosive results would certainly draw Rimtori's ire. It would also present the perfect opportunity to attack her while she's flustered.>
text.81780: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in Forest Song. Defeat the dragon Larsera there and return to me.
text.47: The Kobolds in these parts sometimes carry Gold Dust on them. I could really use the stuff - bring me a load of it and I'll give you the best price in town...best price in town! You can find kobolds in the Fargodeep Mine to the south, and around the Jasperlode Mine to the northeast.
text.94923: <Robbie leans in to talk to you, as if sharing a grave secret.> Psst! Hey mister, I need your help! My sister got me a hat for my birthday but I lost it playing in the river. I'm not allowed to be down there because of the murlocs so I can't ask Dad or Ellie for help because then they'll know where I was! It's a good hat. I bet one of those murlocs found it and kept it for himself!
text.99213: Greetings, <name>! I am so glad to see you've returned to us. It would seem you have enough experience to ride our fastest and fiercest steeds. You won't find a more steadfast companion for your journeys. Choosing one may be difficult as they are all excellent and trained to be steady even when in danger. Some may even recognize you from the last time you were here. Go and examine the armored horses and return to me when you have made your choice.
text.84180: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us. The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for. I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
text.95194: Greetings, <name>. There's a matter that SI:7 could use your help with. Our man on Theramore Isle tells us that Jaina Proudmoore's marines just brought in a man found washed up on the shore. Normally this wouldn't be of much interest to us but it seems that this man told the marines that he was none other than the king of Stormwind, Varian Wrynn. Go to Theramore and meet a dwarf named Sully at the inn. He's expecting you and will give you instructions when you arrive. Find out what's going on.
text.93948: Since you are going to Valanaar anyway, please deliver the signet ring you recovered from the tower to Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar. He will want this back, and more importantly, he will want to learn the fate of his nephew. Talaanis is the High Elder of Zephras Isle and more importantly, he is a good man who is well loved by the people, despite our current hardships. It pains me to think of how he will react to this news. Please express my condolences for his loss.
text.8539: Reinforcements have been called on to join the assault on Hive'Zora. You have been selected to target Hive'Zora hive sisters. Report back to Commander Mar'alith after completing your task.
text.94316: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Potion of Demonslaying, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.8323: Now that I have the Twilight Lexicon in my possession, there is a small favor I'd like to ask of you. My former organization has a secret encoded bulletin they circulate on a monthly basis. If they make any progress searching for me or if they call off the search, word will be published on the True Believer. Although this information is obviously valuable to me, the publication contains other useful information that I can share. Bring me any encoded texts you find on Twilight's Hammer members.
text.8950: I can place the enchantment you require on the banner quite easily, <name>. Unfortunately I don't have the materials I need as it is very rarely that someone asks for this sort of charm. I will require the essence of one of the Eldreth ghosts that haunt these halls, a handful of Scholomance dark runes and some large brilliant shards. Bring me these reagents and I shall perform this task for you.
text.36: I never thought the day would come when I'd leave the farm. But the fields are overrun with thieves and it's far too dangerous for us here now. As soon as Farmer Furlbrow gets the wagon fixed, we'll be on our way. Maybe you could do me a favor? Let me scribble down my recipe for Westfall stew. Please take it to Salma Saldean over on the farm yonder. The Saldean's farm is just beyond the fork in the road.
text.332: If you talk to anyone about wine, then you know we Gallinas sell the best wine in Stormwind. And we're not far, still in the Trade District along the city's lovely canals. Here, take this pamphlet. Bring it to my sister Suzetta at our shop for a complimentary bottle of our famous pinot noir. You won't regret it!
text.95928: Ah, it is good you have come here, {class}. I have been studying crystals of late and word has reached me about a peculiar set of crystals said to be from Un'Goro Crater. I have samples of the most basic ones, but I have heard tell of larger more potent crystals seen in a place called Shaper's Terrace. I do not know much of this place aside from it containing these crystals that supposedly have the very elements within them. If you find yourself there, please bring me a sample of each color.
text.8079: The vindicator's symbol of power is the breastplate. It is forged with powerful mojo. It is trusted only to those we revere. It is the Zandalar symbol of vengeance. To become a vindicator is to become vengeance. Take the Paragons of Power we need from Zul'Gurub. Bring them to us. We will take the mojo stolen from us. We will make the minions of Hakkar pay. We will reward you with the vindicator's breastplate. Go. Be our vengeance, <name>.
text.7801: Greetings once again, <name>! Our need for runecloth is constant, and we can always use additional resources if you are willing to part with them. For an additional stack of twenty runecloth, I will make sure that you are recognized for your continuing efforts on behalf of Darnassus. Whenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it.
text.5517: Brother <name> - your deeds on behalf of the Argent Dawn are far too numerous to be recounted easily. As a fitting tribute, I'll part with one of our special Chromatic Mantles of the Dawn - a version that protects the wearer from all forms of resistible magic simultaneously. Chromatic Mantles of the Dawn are reserved for only the mightiest of the Dawn's heroes! Bring to me twenty-five valor tokens as a sign of tribute, and I'll give you the finest of all our mantles.
text.92015: You say you want to help? Alright, I've got a task for ya. Ever been skunked on a hot day? Nothing worse, I tell you. Bloody things cover everything within spittin' distance in the most vile lingering stench! A family of skunks have started making their home behind my equipment crates. Help me gently expel them from our perimeter and I'll think about sharing some of this gear, once we can get to it... I can't stress this enough: don't attack them - they WILL spray you!
text.1090: You know, I was once the second most important person here at this site. That all changed when Gerenzo took over. Fired my boss, Ziz Fizziks, and sent me down to work in the mines. Ziz told me to stay here and gather information, though. His new boss will pay us well if we can find out what Gerenzo's plans are. Anyways, what I do know is that Gerenzo has ordered large amounts of this gold-green ore to be mined. I can get you a sample to bring to Ziz, but you'll have to watch for patrols while I get it.
text.8147: Even from here I can hear the sound of your volleys laying waste to our enemies. Their cries echo in agony. You have made quite a name for yourself among the trolls of Zandalar, <name>. We are grateful for all that you have done. Hand me your talisman so that I may add another weave.
text.96983: You're capable, fast, fearless. Fire will draw the demons from their hiding places, and with them, their warlords. They will come seeking dominance. Instead, they will find vengeance waiting. This is the moment where the will of the mountain speaks through us. Come, let us carve a path through these hellspawn and end their reign. My blade yearns to cleave through their ranks.
text.3908: You see, I have no idea how I ended up here. No one really knows -- it's a secret to everybody! I just can't seem to remember anything... These items you brought to me, though... I am remembering something. My sword. I am supposed to strengthen it somehow, but I'm really not sure why. Sorry I can't tell you more, but I just don't remember! Anyhoo, I do know where you can take it -- Donova Snowden in Winterspring. You'll find her by the hot springs. She can temper the sword by the pools there.
text.121: While I wait for a response from the King I want you to carry this letter to Magistrate Solomon. Dismissed, {class}!
text.99144: Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect! <Bareth Dawnstone steadies himself.> I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
text.183: Nothing like a day of boar hunting, eh? Though, here in Coldridge Valley, there are so many boars it almost takes the fun out of it. No need to get them charging. They're all angry and ready without any help. In fact, recently, there've been so many boars in the area, it's become dangerous for me to do my daily hunting. Long story short, if you could help me kill some of the boars, I would appreciate it.
text.95384: <The strange symbols on the magical scroll confound you. Though you do not speak the language recorded, you don't sense any particularly volatile forces within. Perhaps a collector of odd magics would find some use for the scroll.>
text.475: A troubling breeze blows through the forest. Gaerolas Talvethren serves as Great Warden to the hibernating Druids of the Talon in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. His duty as the chosen protector of the Sleeping is to ensure their safety so that their pact with Ysera remains fulfilled. But word from Gaerolas is now delayed and I grow nervous. Travel east to Starbreeze Village and bring back a report from Gaerolas so that I can put my worries to rest, knowing my dreaming brethren slumber safely.
text.99162: Even mountaineers from Ironforge have to keep their wits about them when traversing through the peaks of Dun Morogh. Falling snow and ice often spells the end of some more novice members' lives. After a slide, I usually try to find any sign of survivors or victims--while praying to the Light that there's nothing to be found. But with the elements acting up, I've held off wandering too far. If you could look for some lost mountaineers and bring me their rifles, I will return them to Ironforge.
text.93394: I suspect your curiosity is luring you toward the grand structure now, yes? Good! The Shen'dralar there are unlikely to welcome you with open arms, but so long as you tread respectfully, I do not think you will run into any trouble. With any luck, my old friend Kirandis might be easy to find. Of everyone, he is the most likely to be amicable to your presence.
text.442: Now is the time to assault the Scourge's place of strength in Silverpine: Fenris Isle. You must again go to the Isle and destroy Thule Ravenclaw. I want his head! This mission is as dangerous as it is vital, <name>. You must not fail.
text.5214: Terrible thing... what happened to Ezra. You see, the town was sacked and Ezra didn't want to leave his precious goods behind. The last thing I remember him saying was, 'I'll burn every last leaf before they get their damned, dirty hands on them!' I may love a good stogie but I'm no fool. I left Ezra and his delightful store that day. I assume he went down in flames but if there's a chance that even one box of his famous tobacco is still intact... What do you say, <name>? Find a box for ol' Smokey?
text.99195: Greetings again, <name>! Our need for runecloth is constant, and we can always use additional resources if you are willing to part with them. For an additional stack of twenty runecloth, I will make sure that you are recognized for your continued support of the High Order. Whenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it.
text.1067: Here is the toxin. If you use it against the Venture Company it should produce favorable, perhaps even contagious, results. I must say, it is quite exciting to see my work applied in the field! But before using it, take it to Apothecary Zamah. She must create a delivery method for the toxin to maximize its effect.
text.3541: I have a fence in Orgrimmar. He resides in The Drag. He's difficult to nail down if you don't know where to look, but if you go looking in one of the highest buildings there you should have no problem finding him. Do me a favor though, don't go shouting to all of Kalimdor that he's there and what his business is--it'd be bad for both of us. He'll give us more than a fair price for the Tablet of Jin'yael. I'm not sure why, but you should have seen how excited he was to hear about its whereabouts.
text.98906: The battle at the Darkspear Islands be locked in a stalemate, {class}. Show those Alliance fools who the superior force is. Carry your head high in service of the Darkspear and claim victory in battle. The Loa will surely be givin' you their blessing, {class}!
text.8300: Although the Defilers have done well in breaking the supply lines of the League of Arathor, Alliance has proven quite stubborn in its want of Arathi Basin. We must continue to send our own troops into the basin and come out with more of their resource crates.
text.653: <Myzrael speaks.> Free! I AM FREE! I am free to gather strength, hidden from my captors. For if they faced me now they would surely overpower and again imprison me. But in time I will confront the giants, and they will regret their wardship of me! You are a noble ally, <name>. I will need your help again in time. When I am ready, I will need you to summon me to the surface. Speak with Gerrig Bonegrip. He is in Ironforge, in a shop of the Forlorn Cavern. He knows how I can be summoned.
text.5524: Brother <name> - your deeds on behalf of the Argent Dawn are far too numerous to be recounted easily. As a fitting tribute, I'll part with one of our special Chromatic Mantles of the Dawn - a version that protects the wearer from all forms of resistible magic simultaneously. Chromatic Mantles of the Dawn are reserved for only the mightiest of the Dawn's heroes! Bring to me twenty-five valor tokens as a sign of tribute, and I'll give you the finest of all our mantles.
text.12: The People's Militia has but one goal: To defend the lands of Westfall and return peace to our surroundings. Unfortunately, the price of peace is often blood. One of my scouts has brought word of a band of Defias Trappers wreaking havoc nearby. I have reports of Defias Trapper sightings near the Jangolode Mine to the Northwest as well as at the Molsen Farm and Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm. If you seek to join our ranks, slay 15 Defias Trappers and 15 Defias Smugglers then return to me.
text.66291: You open the aged and weathered tome and discover text detailing a necromantic ritual. Perhaps Archmage Tarsis would be interested in having this information.
text.98903: Go forth and represent the Theramore Expeditionary Force in battle at Darkspear Islands, <name>! Achieve victory and show these Horde dogs the might of the Alliance!
text.644: The final of the sigils needed to unlock the tomb of Thoras Trollbane is held by his son personally. He resides deep within Stromgarde, in a chapel in the militia-held districts. Prince Galen is well protected and no slouch of a warrior himself, so this task could prove most difficult.
text.8703: The rings worn by the Qiraji lieutenants are rumored to grant them formidable abilities. The corrupted gems that adorn them could, in theory, be swapped out with more pure materials to create uncorrupted versions of the rings. The gems that adorn Qiraji idols would work quite well, as their quality is superior. Bring me the ring and idols and I'll create a powerful ring for you, {class}.
text.97617: Hullo there, you look like the helpful sort. The name's Dorgaron, and I'm with the Explorers' League. We've not had the best of luck with diggin' in the Badlands, but I know darn well there's artifacts to find and collect! Before I can convince the boss to let us send another crew out here, I need to prove that the dig sites are safe AND haven't been picked clean. If you find yourself down south, gather a few reasonably intact artifacts and some leftover equipment that hasn't been smashed yet.
text.97536: The Matter Transporter required experimentation to get right. Many tests were conducted on all sorts of materials... with various outcomes! Some of the results are no longer with us. Others have become dangerously charged! These subjected objects emit an energy that burns if you stay near for too long. Almost like they've been charged with a year's worth of the desert sun's power. Take this Crate of Radioactive Refuse and empty the contents in the sand a safe distance from town and other trash.
text.8987: {class}, listen closely. Now that we have the location of the last amulet piece, we still need another component to suffuse the brazier with; something that will provide a focus strong enough to summon the remains of my deceased, former comrades. The siblings, Jarien and Sothos, were believers in the way of the Scarlet Crusade. They aspired to knighthood within that vile organization. Go to Tyr's Hand in Eastern Plaguelands and retrieve a Brilliant Sword of Zealotry from the praetorians there.
text.84557: Take the unfired ancient blade to the lair of Onyxia and engage her in battle. Some trickery must be utilized for the heating of the blade. While in combat, she will surely try to incinerate you with her fiery breath. You must plant the unfired ancient blade nearby and hope that the fiery breath heats the blade. If you live beyond this, pick up the now heated ancient blade and finish off the dragon. Plunge the heated ancient blade into her smoldering corpse to fashion the treated ancient blade.
text.79976: "So, I've decided to take my work back underground. To stop it falling into the wrong hands." <The paper is torn just large enough to fit the message. You aren't sure if these are the last words you'll read from the author, or if they're a clue to the next hideout. An inadequately secured sleeping bag is unrolling itself onto your feet...>
text.604: Crazz speaks highly of your dedication to the Blackwater Raiders. I am going to trust you with a mission of extreme importance to the fleet. Infiltrate the so-called southern command post the Bloodsail Buccaneers have established on the Wild Shore. Raid the encampment. Bring me their charts along with their written orders. We shall see exactly what those scum are up to.
text.78916: The dread beast Aku'mai lies dead. Hidden amongst the viscera and gore of its swollen corpse is an enormous iridescent pearl teeming with raw Void energy.
text.99082: Your bravery defending your people demands recognition. Journey to Thunder Bluff to the northwest, our mighty city whose shadow grants us shade in the warmer months, and seek audience with my father. It was he who led the charge with the young Warchief Thrall to reclaim these plains and drive the centaur away for good. As High Chieftain, he will reward you generously for your part in ensuring his own bravery is honored. You must take a lift to reach the High Chieftain, who sits on the central rise.
text.95925: {class}, we've made the discovery of a lifetime! I can't believe it; the ruins in Un'Goro are open! We've already sent a team but they have encountered... trouble. If you're headed in there anyway would ya be able to finish this map? It sounds like there's an Achromatic Crystal in there and an unearthed watcher somewhere near a giant Western Gate that sounds interesting. The other landmarks that would be helpful are the Pillar of Assimilation, the Western Gate and the Regrowth Vestibule.
text.92473: The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village. We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
text.60: Hello, good sir! Do you have a moment? My brother and I run an apothecary in Stormwind, and I'm here to gather large candles for their wax. Can you help me? You can get large candles from kobolds, and I hear rumors that kobolds are infesting the Elwynn mines ... the Fargodeep mine to the south and Jasperlode Mine to the east. I suggest looking for candles in one of those places.
text.6023: My real mission was to weaken the Scarlet Crusade's outlying forces and then infiltrate Hearthglen to gauge their numbers. I'm still in no shape to do it on my own, so perhaps I could ask you to aid me again, <name>? From what information I gathered before being discovered, the Crusade has two important members that are the backbone of their forces outside the town: Huntsman Radley and Cavalier Durgen. Kill them, and we're making progress. They should be along Hearthglen Pass outside the town proper.
text.2040: Gnomeregan has fallen under the control of those dastardly troggs! The situation is grave but perhaps you can help, <name>. Deep in the Deadmines is a functional goblin shredder. Find that shredder and bring back the intact power supply. With the shredder's power supply, we can give our gyrodrillmatic excavationators the power they need to break through the rocky underground borders of Gnomeregan, opening the way for a gnomish assault!
text.86443: We must use restraint against Eranikus. We are to redeem him not destroy him. Tyrande is already en route to assist us in this task. We must weather the dragon's blows and save Nighthaven from certain destruction. Be on guard! You and your allies are our only hope.
text.8578: <You hear a sigh of relief escape the crate.> You just want his scrying goggles? Great! That will be no problem... Just give me a minute to... Hey! Where the... Dagnabbit! Well, there's some bad news and some worse news. The bad news is that I lost the goggles. The worse news is that I lost them when I was nosing around in the Molten Core last month. Yep, the Molten Core... I guess that concludes our business! Bye!
text.5521: Brother <name> - your deeds on behalf of the Argent Dawn are far too numerous to be recounted easily. As a fitting tribute, I'll part with one of our special Chromatic Mantles of the Dawn - a version that protects the wearer from all forms of resistible magic simultaneously. Chromatic Mantles of the Dawn are reserved for only the mightiest of the Dawn's heroes! Bring to me twenty-five valor tokens as a sign of tribute, and I'll give you the finest of all our mantles.
text.733: It's going to be tough going here if I can't manage to scrounge up some materials to construct some defenses and other necessities. I've noticed that the ogres in the area seem to be well equipped with scrap metal. Maybe the stories of siege engines in the Badlands weren't so far off after all... Anyways, the Prospector's been getting worried about the state of our little camp, so I'd like to get working soon if I can. The main ogre camp is at Dustbelch Grotto, a good trek to the west of here.
text.1150: I'm pleased to see your courage remains steadfast in light of what you've already done. Since your faith is intact, the time has come to test your body. First is a test of endurance. Go with friends to the Roguefeather Den west of Freewind Post. Make your way to the depths of their lair and destroy their foodstuffs. By then you should have provoked their fury, and if you are able to survive long enough, Grenka Bloodscreech herself will come for you--kill her and bring me her claw to complete your test.
text.1165: I need indurium ore for my engine! A skilled miner can extract indurium from within Uldaman, in the Badlands of Azeroth. If you can get some indurium ore and give it to me, then I'll use it to make modifications to our rocket car and it'll go go go!.
text.8696: I'm glad to hear you're aiding us in our attack on Ahn'Qiraj, <name>. I can make you a protective item that'll be of assistance in the fight against our enemy, {class}. I shall need a Qiraji drape, which I'll resize for you of course. I'll also need idols and scarabs which I'll use to create a suitable clasp. I promise you won't be disappointed.
text.2927: You don't think I was always bald, do you? No sir! It was the radiation leak in Gnomeregan that caused this tragic hair loss. Before that day, I had the only gnomefro in all of Azeroth. <Gnoarn shakes his fist in the air.> Damn those damned dirty troggs - damn them all!! Perhaps it's not too late, <name>. We may still be able to save it - the city I mean! Speak to Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos. He and his partner Razzle are working on a solution.
text.93567: This mountain cliff to the southeast... the remains of the tower. Seared into my mind, their harrowing screams still echo forever in memories. Allow me to unburden myself and tell you of my defeat.
text.93799: This was once a helm of sorts, though it is difficult to tell it now in its twisted form. We can restore it, however. Like all things, there is a cost to this. Go to the bastion of Blackrock Spire and claim the left eye of the false warchief, Rend Blackhand. From there, reach the pinnacle of the stronghold and claim the right eye of General Drakkisath, chief agent of the Lord of Blackrock. Do this and you will remove two great evils from the world. Then I will cleanse the artifact you hold.
text.7301: We got them held prisoner, {race}. I'm talking about their Wing Commanders. It was a furious battle in the skies but they finally fell! Unfortunately, our best pilots were shot down in a counterattack against Frostwolf Keep. You gotta find out what happened to them. Search Tower Point West and Frostwolf Keep. These were their last known locations. Search these areas thoroughly.
text.6523: Thank you for rescuing me! We must leave quickly before they discover that I am free. Please escort me to Camp Aparaje. From there, I know my way. My father, Makaba Flathoof, will be desperate to know that I am safe.
text.96003: As suspected, the vessels fused into something new--something powerful. I suppose if the vessels capture stored energy, there must be a way to use that power to our advantage. Fel artifacts are rarely safe or easy to come by, but we might as well do something with it, hmm? Time for a field test. Take the crystal and use it against Bethra'zel and Mazzogore--two of their most powerful demons. Their presence alone has ensured the camp is well protected. Let's see if we can change that.
text.7887: You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. Continue to aid the cause and bring me more talismans of merit. Do this, and you will earn even more of our trust.
text.97074: Hello, {class}! It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a saber, for a fee of course. Lelanai will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts ye would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each. Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you all I know about riding sabers.
text.725: <name>, run and find Advisor Belgrum as quickly as you can. Tell him what you've witnessed and ask him how he wants us to proceed. This note will explain more to him. In the meantime, I will take the time to speak to Hammertoe's spirit. Maybe he knows something that will help us put a stop to those Shadowforge cretins' activities in the Badlands. We can only pray.
text.84176: You've proven to be a very reliable individual, <name>. As much as I trust that you'll help me through this predicament, it would be wise of me to reward you according to your performance. For now I will exchange your belt and gauntlets. If we both see this through I shall make the rest of the pieces available to you.
text.5863: Just recently, a large bank of nomadic ogres arrived in Tanaris. South of here, they have taken over a large area of the desert and formed a compound. Several smaller bands are currently wandering the desert, some of which have invaded the old troll ruins. The Dunemaul Compound must be destroyed! We cannot allow these ogres to build up a force. The leader of this band is named Gor'marok the Ravager; I believe that putting an end to his leadership will be the beginning of the end for the ogres.
text.95417: Clubtoe see friends go. Some no come back. Some come back purple. Dat weird. Purple ones no act like friends no more. Where others go? Why they no come back? Make Clubtoe think. You hit hard. Maybe you go find friends in cave? Maybe you turn purple. Dat weird too.
text.97977: The Gnarlpine furbolg would not turn on their ancient allies so readily. We must learn more of their plight. Search their abandoned homes for totems. If any survived the chaos of their departure, their engravings may tell us more of what happened here. You'll find their camps along the western edge of the glen, though the grell and grellkin may have scattered them beyond.
text.7908: There must be more to being a master of the arena than this! Perhaps the Pirate who runs the event at Gurubashi will know!
text.80: I have had my eye on that creep, Stalvan, for quite sometime. But if this page was written by the same hand it proves his guilt beyond a shadow of a doubt. In all his days keeping the Town Registry, Clerk Daltry has become an expert at identifying handwriting. Show him this page and see if the writing matches that of the registry signature.
text.85626: Warlocks tread dangerous ground in dealing with demons, but our demoniacs take this one step further. Through an ancient and arcane ritual, they allow a demon to enter their being. Rather than let it possess them though, they enslave the demon from the inside, absorbing the power of the beast for their own command. It is a feat few are ever able to master. For you to learn of the power of the demoniac, I must have Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub. Go there and retrieve that which we seek.
text.99052: One of my scouts has reported a sea giant followed those naga down here. Not sure if they brought him intentionally or what, but he's dangerous in any case. It's a young one, but it could still rip an orc in half in a heartbeat if they were caught off guard. I need him gone. But I'd suggest you find some help to deal with it.
text.1360: I had myself a fine job as a digger at the Uldaman excavation site in the Badlands... that is until those blasted troggs showed up. I escaped with my hide barely intact, and nothing else. In the chaos, I left my most treasured possession. It's safe from the troggs in my chest, sure, but it's right in the thick of 'em. I'd be in your debt, both in honor and coin, if you could fetch it for me! A chest with my name on it is at the end of the North Common Hall. That's the one you need to get in.
text.94280: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Mechanical Dragonling, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.95330: My husband and I have a farm north of here. I come to Farholde after each harvest to sell what we grow. In good seasons, I like to set aside whatever we don't sell to give to folks who need a little pick-me-up. Gotta take care of your neighbors, I say. There's a logging camp north of our farm, right on the river. I'm sure those boys could use some fruits and vegetables to give 'em some variety in their diet. If you're heading that way, could you give this to the foreman there? Name's Halligan Turner.
text.8146: Ah, <name>, it is good to smell you again. <Falthir grins.> You'll have to excuse my sense of humor. It can be most foul at times. I sense that you have caused great anguish to our enemies. The forces of Hakkar cry out your name in anger. This is most excellent. You have earned another weave on your talisman. Hand it to me.
text.4484: Do not waste my time, {race}. Give me what I require. Thirty gold and the components.
text.6: Garrick Padfoot - a cutthroat who's plagued our farmers and merchants for weeks - was seen at a shack near the vineyards, which lies east of the Abbey and across the bridge. Bring me the villain's head, and earn his bounty! But be wary, <name>. Garrick has gathered a gang of thugs around him. He will not be an easy man to reach.
text.1019: Attention, heroes! The Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of Kalimdor! A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of Tanaris and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead. All interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. Speak with the Arch Druid in Darnassus, Fandral Staghelm, for more information!
text.8052: If only we had ten-thousand more like you, <name>. The armies of Hakkar would be scattered to the wind in the blink of an eye. <Al'tabim sighs.> Alas, the Eye is ready to realize its full potential. Give it to me.
text.848: The oases of the Barrens hide a mystery. Life energy flows from their waters, invigorating the plants and beasts that drink it. Invigorating, and altering. There is a mushroom that grows near these oases. Its spores hold properties that we, the apothecaries of Lordaeron, find useful. Bring me these spores and you will earn our gratitude.
text.231: Here, take this and lay it on his grave. Maybe... somehow, he'll know that I'm okay, and that none of us hold him responsible for what happened. <There are tears in her eyes now, as she slides a ring from her right hand, and presses it into your hands.> And... thank you, <name>.
text.753: I have traveled many paths through life and these old legs lack the vigor they once had. I can still perform my duties to the tribe. Sometimes it just takes an old woman a little longer to do the task. But you look like an eager {class}. Let's put some of that youthful vitality to the test. Take a water pitcher from the well and bring it to my son, the Chief, in Camp Narache. Remember that even the most humble task can gain the recognition of elders.
text.94360: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Soul Pouch, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.481: Take the pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver, perhaps he can shed some light on the wizards' plans.
text.80182: Not only was your sample insufficient in quantity, it was also impure. What we require is more green glow. The troggs are obviously not irradiated sufficiently to fulfill our needs. You will have to go into Gnomeregan and bring back some radioactive fallout, straight from the tap. I am speaking of the irradiated slimes, lurkers and horrors. Be warned, the containment of this type of fallout is difficult. You may need to make several attempts with the phial until a suitable sampling is recovered.
text.8196: The extremely potent essence mango grows across many of the islands in the South Seas. A single mango will refresh those who eat it, both physically and mentally. If you've never had one, you do yourself a disservice! We have enough of a supply here on the isle to offer you a handful in exchange for a Zandalar Honor Token. Speak with Vinchaxa if you need to learn how to get tokens; otherwise, let's get to the business at hand!
text.92100: <A spirit materializes before you, recovering from a full-body yawn.> You have no ranks with you... and you are not dressed as a soldier. We repelled Archimonde then? It's been so long. I had almost forgotten what I once was, but you... you must be one of the first to walk these craters in years. <The veteran glances at his surroundings.> Let us continue our conversation at an overlook with a view I remember vividly, just west of here. Long ago, I left my scabbard to rest there.
text.489: The Council of the Forest has news that you aided Zenn Foulhoof. The satyr is an enemy of the forest. As a {race}, you should know better than to defile the forest by killing Nature's creatures. You must redeem yourself in the eyes of the Council if you wish to remain a friend of Teldrassil. Teach Foulhoof a lesson and you shall be redeemed. Fel Cones are corrupted seeds that fall from the trees. They billow with green smoke. Give some to Foulhoof. He'll think you have brought him a harmless snack.
text.85605: The augurs of our tribe are revered for their gifts of the divine sight, ya mon. They ain't a witch doctor; they spend their time castin' bones or readin' the leaves for insight - not hexin' people. As a shaman, you already know somethin' about the power of augury; we Zandalar prize the insight they give to the tribe. Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub and prove your worth to us. Do this for us, and I'll give ya some bracers that our augurs prize above all others!
text.6643: Woe unto those that tempt fate inside the Molten Core. Death comes swiftly - the punishment dealt without mercy. Many of the Brotherhood have been lost in their search for Fiery Cores. Offer 1 Fiery Core and you shall be granted favor amongst the Brotherhood.
text.8773: Reinforcements have been called on to join the assault on Hive'Zora. You have been selected to target Hive'Zora reavers. Report back to Commander Mar'alith after completing your task.
text.94568: The turncoat clearly was afraid of what the cult had planned, enough so to defect and seek our aid. It's truly unfortunate that he is dead and took his secrets to the grave with him. We must discuss this further to determine our next steps.
text.9107: I make no pretenses, maggot. The darkness Plagueheart items hold could very well destroy the both of us. That is why the price is so high. If I'm going to die, it's going to be as a rich man. And I don't give an ounce of gnoll spit how you die, only that you do as I ask. Bring me what I require and we will both benefit - or die; but I've already explained this...
text.92014: Every time I take my attention off the supplies I've lugged up here for more than a few minutes, one of nature's finest thieves is pilfering and rummaging through it. The damned foxes seem to have made a burrow beneath the boulders nearby. Apparently, me digging out this hole gave them an idea of their own. I'm working on a solution. Tell you what, bring back some of their fox tails. That'll teach them a lesson, and I'll hang the tails around the perimeter to scare the others off!
text.85601: Zanza can create the ancient troll enchantments with the right components. The first is a primal Hakkari idol that must be taken from the most powerful of the Hakkari lieutenants: Jin'do and the Bloodlord. The second is a punctured voodoo doll. These can be found in the piles of refuse that litter this foul place. Look inside the jinxed hoodoo piles. Bring me these things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
text.243: You will be headed to the Tanaris desert, testing the tissue consistency of the basilisks, scorpids, and hyena native there. Obtain tissue samples and use them with the testing kit in tow; expect a chunk of the samples to fail. I need eight acceptable samples of each creature type. In addition, the goblins of Gadgetzan have a power source that must be used with this kind of modified kit. Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle and acquire one for the kit. Return to me only when you are successful.
text.8535: The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus. With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside. Find a way to summon and destroy a Hoary Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.
text.9236: Thanks to you and Omarion (May he rest in peace), I am now able to create an Icebane breastplate. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
text.9129: Truth be told, I use the cores to create Frostfire armor. It is the armor used by the mages battling in Naxxramas. Without you and others like you, we would most definitely be losing this war. With that said, bring me more cores and I shall grant you more insignias.
text.405: Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful mage in the Undercity to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge. You, <name>, will be that agent. Present these orders to Bethor. He will then instruct you on your mission. I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich. And it will be dangerous. So ready yourself, {class}. You must not fail. You may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
text.3788: Excuse me, friend... A colleague of mine would like to speak with you about the research you are doing in conjunction with the Cenarion Circle. He is a druid by the name of Quintis Jonespyre, and he resides here in Feathermoon Stronghold. He would like to confer with you about morrowgrain... and he very much would like for you to keep our discussion from the ears of the Arch Druid. If you're interested, speak with him; no doubt, all will be revealed once you do.
text.4621: Listen close, sea dawg... the powers of Booty Bay is what keeps us Bloodsail from sailing wheres we like and taking whats we want as rights o' plunder. Were ye to put a knife to Fleet Master Seahorn, we'd ne'er run afoul of a Booty Bay's vessel. Were ye to put a knife to Baron Revilgaz, we'd ne'er face the law on their terms. If ye are to be an honorary admiral amongst us - yes, ADMIRAL, you'll puts a knife to both of 'em as I've says. Go now lad, and return to me once ye does the deeds.
text.6024: Kill me. Before it's too late. I am Hameya. While traveling to Zul'Mashar, my brethren and I ate some bad meat... and we changed. We are infected. I can feel the lich's words now, urging me to reach Zul'Mashar and infect more of my people. I cannot resist, and so I wrote this scroll before my will left me. I buried a chest in dirt next to a wagon behind this crypt, but only my key will open it. I have the key. If you want my treasure, then find me. Kill me. Before it's too late.
text.91734: <The Forsaken sways unsteadily> 'ey! <hic> Do me a favor ... would ya? Go to uh ... Azshara 'n ... tell <hic> Jediga ... Expectin' a ... 'mportant deliv'ry <hic>
text.1242: Take this here note to Elling Trias. Don't say nothin' else to him. Just be polite and wait for him to respond. And don't worry, he will. I'm gonna only impress this on ya once more, <name>: treat this matter seriously, and keep your yapper shut. Ya can find Trias at his cheese shop, Trias' Cheese, in the Trade District. Good luck.
text.2161: Excuse me? Can you help me? I have a load of food here. I walked along the road and braved scorpids and spiders and worse! I brought the food to the Valley of Trials because I thought they needed it and I like to help out. But they don't need any food! Now I have to take it back to Razor Hill and I'm afraid of all the beasts along the way... Can you take it for me? I'm just a peon, but you're a hero. You fear nothing! Take it to Innkeeper Grosk at the Razor Hill inn. Thank you!
text.96559: Every Gnomish test pilot knows that one must be prepared for the worst-case scenario when taking to our great skies! That's why we never leave the hangar without our pilot survival kits. They have a self-activating beacon attached that will radio our position home as soon as you open it. Not to mention being stuffed full of other useful supplies. If you can find that pack wherever it fell, by all means open it immediately and help yourself to the contents. You'll still be doing me a favor!
text.9010: A truly amazing story, <name>! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past. As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
text.366: Long ago Gunther and I, along with the now Scourge Necromancer Thule Ravenclaw, were friends and students within the Kirin Tor - a society of mages in Dalaran. Gunther and I both fell to the Plague, but I thought he either remained dead, or was raised into the ranks of the Lich King. It is good to know he is free. We must have him. I have placed a spell on his book that, when he sees it, will show him that I too am free of the Lich King. After knowing this, it is my hope that he will join us.
text.7422: It would seem as if the High Tinkerer has gotten wind of our involvement in Alterac Valley. He has tasked his own people with the de-hoofing of tauren as revenge. These gnomes are more devious than I had previously suspected. More studies must be done! We will need more tufts of hair.
text.68: You find a Dusty Unsent Letter in the old footlocker.
text.833: Only the most valiant tauren are laid to rest at Red Rocks, our sacred burial ground. It is an honor bestowed upon the great warriors who helped found and defend Thunder Bluff and those who have given their lives for the greater good of their tribes and chieftains. But it appears a foul menace has made its way onto our holy land. A band of Bristleback Interlopers is ravaging the grave site and I am too old and past my prime to drive them away. They must be driven off with force, <name>.
text.1433: The Burning Blade have many agendas, but know that they are evil to their core, their spirits corrupted, and their destruction is the only way to thwart their objectives. Keldran sent Maurin with me because of his knowledge of the Blade and their warlock ways. He has control of our plots against the Blade while I deal with the other demonic threats here in Desolace. Speak to him, and he will guide you in his designs.
text.5097: Through the use of a magical device known as a beacon torch, we can mark targets of our choosing for future actions by our troops. To that end, we think the Scourge are using Andorhal's watchtowers as a means to control their troop movements. Your mission: breach Andorhal's defenses to plant beacons at all four watchtowers. You'll need to be in the doorway of each tower to plant the beacon; it will then proceed to mark the tower. There are only five charges on the beacon torch, so use them wisely!
text.94369: Ansirem has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir now that the wards that have hidden Zephras are down. If the Windlord chooses to attack us, we stand no chance to defend ourselves while we are here in his domain. High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
text.213: He's done it this time! Bad enough that Gelriz's muscling out the moguls who were appointed by the trade princes, now he tries to cut in on the most notorious pirate! Revilgaz won't have it, and he's told me to take care of the problem in my own way. My way? Theft. The Venture Co. geologists near Lake Nazferiti are deeply interested in those strange blue crystals they have been finding in the mines. Bring me samples of the stone from their geologists, I don't care what you have to do to get them.
text.8069: The tribe acknowledges station and power through what we wear. Our vestments are made from the finest of materials, and interwoven with the mojo we use to make us powerful. Illusionists are no exception; their robes are said to embody the essence of illusion in their look. Legend states that their ancient robes never looked the same twice. I will give you an illusionist's robe, <name>... but earn your place of reverence among the tribe first! Bring me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub!
text.576: Avast! Who goes there? Argh, I am but useless without me special enchanted eye. Bad enough to have lost me eyes in battle in the first place! But by some stroke o' luck we docked in Menethil and a traveling wizard enchanted a special glass eye that let me see again. Last night I ended up gettin' jumped by some Bloodsail Buccaneers on me way out. Took me eye, they did! Seems those blokes have found their way to Booty Bay. Help an old sea dog out by gettin' me eye back?
text.4384: The Pylon table allows you to combine red power crystals with blue power crystals. According to J.D.'s manual, this combination can be used to weaken an enemy's defenses.
text.95120: Sailors and swimmers beware! An especially aggressive murloc, nicknamed "Old Rot-Chum" by local fishermen, has been seen attacking rowboats and other small vessels in the waters to the south, near a collection of murloc-infested islands. A reward is being offered by Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz in exchange for proof of the creature's demise.
text.6133: The high elves of the Quel'Lithien lodge possesses something that belongs to me, {class}: A document detailing my life as a mortal. Before you ask; no, you most certainly are not privy to such information. Just do as I tell you, worm: Recover the registry. And imbecile, be sure to leave as much strife and grief as possible in your wake. Leave them suffering...
text.1069: Spider egg omelettes are a new fad in Booty Bay! The problem is... Booty Bay's got no eggs. I smell an opportunity! In Windshear Crag and Sishir Canyon, in the Stonetalon Mountains to the northwest, lives the deepmoss spider. Bring me its eggs and I'll pay a bundle! In Windshear Crag, the eggs will be clustered under what trees remain. In Sishir Canyon... well, if you have a weak stomach then maybe you should just collect the eggs at Windshear Crag...
text.3801: Greetings, <name>. I am Franclorn Forgewright. Yes, the Franclorn Forgewright responsible for the stonewrought method of architecture. You have undoubtedly passed through or stood upon one of my creations in your adventures across our war torn world. You are probably wondering why I am here and what it is that I want from you - both valid questions. I need your assistance, of course. In exchange for your assistance, I shall grant you the key to the depths of my accursed city.
text.1013: <name>, Shadowfang Keep holds a book, the Book of Ur, which would be much prized in my collection. Ur was a great mage of Dalaran before the coming of the Scourge, his studies in other worlds are of much value to ... certain parties among the Forsaken. Enter Shadowfang Keep and find the book. Bring it to me, and I will report your service to our Dark Lady...
text.8687: Reinforcements have been called on to join the assault on Hive'Zora. You have been selected to target Hive'Zora tunnelers. Report back to Commander Mar'alith after completing your task.
text.2993: Sharpbeak is held in a cage, high on a cliff at the top of Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands. The key to this cage is possessed by the high priestess of the Vilebranch trolls, Vile Priestess Hexx. There. I have done my part. I bid you fortune on your quest, <name>.
text.79008: <The faint radiance of the embers darkening, you stumble across the remnants of a recent fire. Amidst the scattered provisions, you discover a blistered note.> "Not all that burns is lost. Find the twin land, find the place."
text.8466: While you have proven yourself to me, you may need to continue to work toward proving yourself to the suspicious brethren of my tribe. To that end, I may be able to continue assisting you. Some of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers. Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.
text.8064: We Zandalar know not of druidic ways; nature is to be shaped by our need, not the other way around. Still, a haruspex is the one of us most in tune with nature, and rightly so. To give up the ghost of a beastie is to know what it is to be one of them. That is the real power of nature. Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub, proving yourself to us. Do this, and I'll give ya a powerful item - a belt used by many of the Zandalar's haruspices. Strong mojo, ya mon!
text.7794: Mageweave is running low, and we could use your help to replenish our stocks! By counting on the community as a whole, we would only need a donation of 60 pieces of mageweave cloth from you to enable us to reach our goal. Such generosity would not go unnoticed by Stormwind, I assure you! If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
text.671: I have felt a strangeness in the air... a feeling that simmers in my blood. I had my suspicions. I set off to find the source of my unease and discovered to the west, at Northfold Manor, the residual traces of demonic summoning. As I got close, my blood began to boil and the rage within me grew. On the ground I spied an amulet of bloodstone, used to assist in demonic summoning. The one I found was depleted, however. I'll need another to examine, but I dare not return to the manor. Can you bring me some?
text.89255: Staying on top of your trade is crucial for maintaining a high standard of quality. Our soldiers entrust their lives to unnamed craftsmen, and to me for ensuring the quality of every piece of armor. My task for you is simple. If you are well practiced in Tailoring, Leatherworking, or Blacksmithing, then craft a piece of headgear, purely for your own benefit. You are free to keep the result. If you lack the skill, commission and donate any piece of the crusade's uniform instead.
text.3361: We drove the troggs out of Gnomeregan, but then it all went so horribly wrong! Now our home is completely irradiated, and we gnomes have been scattered all over Dun Morogh.
