text.84191: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us. The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for. I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
text.1151: During the time of the Old Gods, elementals inhabited much of this world. They worshipped the Old Gods, and the Gods, through their power, kept the elementals bound to this world. When the Old Gods were banished, the elementals faded from our world and now only return at the bidding of powerful mages. There are exceptions though. Some elementals were powerful enough to remain here on their own. One such elemental is Rok'Alim. To test your strength, find Rok'Alim in Thousand Needles and slay him.
text.95682: Dragonmaw. <She lets out a dry, amused scoff.> The remnants of the dragon-wrangling clan think they've found something that could lead to them rising to their former power. In the eyes of whom... their false warchief? Clear out their ragtag clan within the Excavation Sites so our Deathstalkers can move in undetected. If the Dragonmaw carry anything of note upon them, return it to me--this information must stay between us and our royal command.
text.701: With some additional objects, I will be able to create an item that will imbue Gor'mul with the guile of the raptor! With the power of the raptor flowing through him, Gor'mul will know our new power and rediscover the warrior that lies dormant! I will require raptor hearts to fashion the item and spell.
text.4341: You have been to the smoldering ruins of Thaurissan? Did you happen to run into a pitiful lout named Kharan Mighthammer? The dwarf that was supposedly watching over my baby girl! <The King sobs.> And now she's gone, <name>! I have had my men turn the Steppes upside down. The only clue they have as to the whereabouts of my daughter is that she may be inside the Depths. For all I know, she could be dead! Kharan is supposedly being held prisoner there... find him! I want answers!
text.2438: I was once given an emerald dreamcatcher from Gaerolas Talvethen, the warden of the druids in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. This powerful amulet is able to siphon energy from the Emerald Dream, bestowing luck upon those who carry it. Sadly, I have not been able to retrieve it from my dresser in Starbreeze Village... Although Starbreeze was once a tranquil place, it has now succumbed to the corruption of the furbolg that reside there. Perhaps you would be willing to recover my dreamcatcher, {class}?
text.92525: <Faladiel regains his composure after a moment.> Listen to me carefully. None of this ever happened. It's critical that you tell no one of this and if anyone asks, you don't know me or anything about a letter to Valanaar. I'm going to get on the next caravan out of town and then book the fastest ship to Shen'dramar. I suggest you do the same. Trust me, the people who did this are not to be trifled with.
text.700: Ah, such fine stone comes from Lordaeron. Such a shame the land is in such shambles. But the Memorial came out quite well! I should think the King will be most pleased with it. Now if you will, please send word to His Majesty that the Memorial is complete as requested.
text.448: Before you launch an assault on Fenris Isle, report to High Executor Hadrec. He may have additional information or equipment you'll need.
text.4281: This parcel of goods you found in the Woodpaw gnoll camps was supposed to be delivered to the small way-station of Thalanaar in southeastern Feralas. Regardless of the missing courier's fate, the task of delivering the parcel remains unfinished. Examining the parcel in detail reveals a hand written name of "Falfindel Waywarder" on the outside of the packaging. Perhaps this is the parcel's ultimate recipient.
text.82094: For de most powerful adventurer, I offer de most powerful trades. I have somethin' that enhances your shoulder items, power from de Atal'ai themselves! <name>, if you have mojo found by the strongest of dere Atal'ai in da temple, I will make it worth your while. Let's not be too hasty now, I offer da fairest deals...
text.1175: After the big crash with the goblins' Red Thunder racer and a basilisk, Kronkrider hired me on to take care of the track. I don't know what all the animals out on the flats are feeding on to grow so big, but we have to be careful to thin them out so they won't wander onto the track when a race is going on. Tell you what. If you want to go out and make a little profit, go out and remove the basilisks from the area.
text.92515: As if bandits and mad cultists weren't enough, the hills are thick with prideclaws as well right now. They are starting to encroach on the village borders and growing bolder by the day. It's only a matter of time before someone's pet or child is taken. It would be a mercy for us to cull their numbers now rather than after some tragedy occurs. Bring me a dozen or so of their pelts. I can turn them into all sorts of goods that will be of aid to the village.
text.996: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a windblossom plant. The berries that hang from the plant appear rotten and poisonous. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
text.942: This fossil bears a striking resemblance to one I once saw in Ironforge. An archaeologist by the name of Flagongut brought it to our annual Explorers' League conference. He believed the fossil had a power which could be unlocked somehow. Last I heard Flagongut had holed up in the Deepwater Tavern in Menethil Harbor, awaiting escort to the Whelgar Excavation Site. Seek him out and show him Remtravel's fossil. Perhaps he can reveal the secrets of the past. The ship to Menethil departs from Auberdine.
text.8001: Now that you're level 60, you can turn these things in to get faction intead of experience.
text.4081: By order of Warlord Goretooth, commander of the Kargath Expeditionary Force: Any and all of General Angerforge's forces within Blackrock Depths must be annihilated. Angerforge's men are ruthless killers, responsible for the mass murder of the 109th division of the Kargath Expeditionary Force. Heroes are warned to exercise extreme caution when confronting these brutes. Any person who destroys the first line of General Angerforge's forces in Blackrock Depths shall receive a tribute.
text.1170: Stonemaul Village was invaded by the brood of Onyxia. But why would the daughter of the black dragonlord, Deathwing, descend upon our lands? This is most troubling. Surely, Onyxia was driven here for a purpose beyond laying siege to a small band of ogres. Notify Mok'Morokk at once! Action must be taken.
text.89470: <With Saria's true intentions revealed, and a bag of powerful artifacts in hand, perhaps now would be a good time give Commander Truesong her report.>
text.7496: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes, <name>. He will be expecting you...
text.92189: Och, we had to make this village from scratch with what we could scrounge up after the war. All of the fighting has taken a toll on our weapons, not to mention the need for tools! I can always tell another blacksmith. Think you could spare the time and materials to make me some Dense Sharpening and Dense Grinding Stones? We could really use 'em!
text.2041: Perhaps... Perhaps you can help us in the battle for Gnomeregan. In Stormwind you will find the commander of our underground assault crew, Shoni the Shilent. Shoni needs assistance with her gyrodrillmatic excavationators. You will probably find her amongst the dwarves in Stormwind. Good luck, <name>.
text.93615: Oh, a tasty morsel... Fear not, I jest. Though I could snap your spine like a dry branch. I am a demigod of the wilds, after all. If you would gain my favor and avoid my appetite, perhaps I could burden you with a task? My litter of young have wandered off to entertain themselves. Little on this mountain could threaten them directly, but there are dark things afoot near the summit, and I'd leave nothing to chance. Would you check on them? In return for my not eating you, of course.
text.975: Now, before I give ya dis charm, I better explain how ta use it. If you carry da charm with ya, you'll find dat certain items will drop from creatures ya fight. If you don't have da charm with you, you won't find them. Understand? You'll know these special items by the name -- they be called E'ko. If you find any of these items, just bring dem to ol' Mau'ari, and she help ya out. Wait here while I fix your charm.
text.676: Weaklings... all of them. You, {class}, what are you looking at? Think you're something special, huh? Why not prove it? The Hammerfall outpost in Arathi's under attack. Unless we send them help soon, their demise is imminent. But before you go rushing off, you may want to test your skills first. Northeast of Stromgarde in Arathi is an ogre mound inhabited by the Boulderfist tribe. When you can handle the ogres and enforcers there, then report to Drum Fel in Hammerfall.
text.4443: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a whipper root plant. The visible roots of the plant appear tough and leathery, and a slimy film hangs from the plant. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
text.535: Urrgh... Injured and dying and confronted with the enemy. No doubt you'll kill me anyway, but if you bring me some Southshore stout--your kind does drink, don't they?--I'll tell you what you want to know.
text.89001: Greetings traveller! If yer lookin' for a place to hang yer hat, look no further than Berdun's travel lodge! The tent's in a bit o' disrepair right now, but that can be remedied. Tell ye what. If ye get me what I need to fix the tent, I'll let ye stay here for free. How's that sound? I'll need some mosshoof hides. The easiest to hunt mosshooves are just north o' here, but the hide of any mooshoof will do.
text.202: You have proven yourself time and again, and your resourcefulness seems to rival even that of Kurzen himself. You may be the salvation of our band of rebels...if you can pit yourself against Kurzen and prevail! He commands his men from deep within the Stockpile. You must enter that cave, brave through his defenders, and face Kurzen and his leaders. Farewell, <name>. My hope, and the fate of my men, go with you.
text.8774: As the war effort mounts, the silithid presence in the area presents an ever increasing threat to our operations. You've been selected to partake on an assault on Hive'Regal where your primary target will consist of the Hive'Regal ambushers. Report back to Commander Mar'alith after your task is completed.
text.93958: Valennia's forces just breached the inner sanctum. The fighting was thick in there at first, but it's grown... unsettlingly quiet. Go in there and do your best to link up with Valennia and her forces... if any of them are left. I'll stay here and watch your back.
text.1094: This envelope has all the information I was able to snatch as they booted me out the door... Venture Company internal documents, some manuals, technical things... Oh, and of course the Super Reaper 6000 blueprints. Sputtervalve has taken up residence at Ratchet in the Barrens. Shouldn't have much trouble finding him, he's a little green fellow.
text.4322: We need to get out of here, <name>. Help me get my gear back from the supply area and free my friends. If we make it out of here, you are to proceed to Morgan's Vigil and speak with Marshal Maxwell. He will give you further instruction.
text.95148: As much as I'd like to deliver the blood-soaked message to the knight commander himself, I'd also like to keep my post. I've cleaned it up a bit so it's less... well, bloody. Given the recent gnoll uprisings, I'm afraid the task of delivering the news falls upon you.
text.81851: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Seradane, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at Shol'watha. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Serlina Starbright there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.
text.8732: Field duty papers? What manner of nonsense is this, <name>?
text.97272: I could smell the stink of demonic corruption on this glaive from the start. The demon that influenced it must be powerful, indeed. Particularly if the Shen'dralar--of all elves--want nothing to do with it. Pouring the level of corruption that would be needed to taint a deeply magical artifact such as one of the storied "Chromatic Blades" would leave a connection. If you have the will, you can exploit that connection. I will explain what is needed.
text.8343: <name>, Aurel Goldleaf thinks she's found a way to summon and defeat a ruling member of the Abyssal Council! Such a task will be dangerous, but you have earned great respect amongst the Cenarion Circle. We know that if anyone can do it, you can. May fortune go with you, <name>. Speak with Aurel when you are ready.
text.607: Here, take this pouch and give it to Sea Wolf. And tell him I meant to pay him back! I swear!! I just got a little drunk and lost my way, and...you know how things are. He'll understand - you don't have to get rough!
text.302: If Ironband still needs blastpowder, then by Magni he'll have it! I sent the approval on ahead with a messenger to Jern Hornhelm in Thelsamar. He'll prepare the powder and other supplies to take to Ironband. And one more thing: I want you to personally see that the shipment of powder reaches its destination. The last one didn't, so keep your mind sharp and your eyes open.
text.508: The pendant? Of course you can have it... Take it! I want no memory of him... just please, please leave in peace...
text.1023: As you rummage through Teronis' belongings, you find a journal that is still in good condition. You take the journal and leave Teronis' corpse as is. The only thing left to do is find the gem Teronis was seeking. Raene mentioned it being in the area. Perhaps the murlocs have it...
text.1370: When we are not at war, we hunt for meat. Meat gives us strength, and full bellies fight harder than empty ones. It is the same with the Magram. They store extra meat so they may fight longer between hunts. If you raid their village to the east and take their stores of meat, then their strength will fail.
text.232: The Royal Apothecary Society needs your assistance. Listen closely, and both of us may profit from my plan. Apothecary Keever in the next room may be... touched... but his research does potentially bear fruit if it were pursued by a clever researcher. Fortunately, I am such a researcher. I want you to take this purchase order to Alessandro Luca, the proprietor of Blue Moon Odds and Ends; he'll give you a testing kit. When you have it, bring it back to me and I'll outline your task in detail.
text.96255: <Something wriggles ominously within the bone pile as green ooze seeps out from under the freshly added bones.>
text.407: Harmless pumpkins, right? Or so it would seem. If we are to defeat Arthas's advances from the North and the Human infestation from the South we need to start realizing the full potential of our gift of undeath. With a little ingenuity a simple pumpkin becomes an agent for our Dark Lady. This pumpkin, laced with my latest formula, will prove to be quite a treat. Yet another Scarlet Zealot has been captured and is being kept in the cellar of the Gallow's End Tavern. Take this pumpkin to the fool.
text.5002: I'm a goblin of my word, {race}. Now listen closely: These orcs are used primarily as beasts of burden and cannon fodder for the black dragonflight! Their true leader is none other than Nefarian, brood of Deathwing. I've also discovered the location of Nefarian's subordinates in this part of the citadel. Take this map to Marshal Maxwell in the Burning Steppes. It has the location of these fiends marked for easy identification.
text.879: Three of my tribe came out of the Kraul to lead the raids against the Horde, {race}. <snort> They are ruthless and cunning, and if you defeat them, then your Crossroads and even most of the Barrens will learn peace... <snort> at least from the Razormane tribe. <snort> Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are the ones you seek. They are far to the south of the Barrens. One is a spell caster, another a tracker, and their leader, the one called Orcbane, <snort> a warrior. Kill them, {race}, like they have killed me.
text.1323: Oh, I think I might have dropped too much acid onto the shield. Let me just rub a little... Hm, kind of hard to read, but it looks like the name Mosarn. Never heard of him. Maybe Krog knows. Krog knows many people.
text.8365: You're the help the Cartel sent? I suppose you'll do. Listen carefully {class}. As you know, I am a procurer of fashionable apparel for the elite of Azerothian society. Kings and Queens, Warchiefs and, well whatever the Horde calls their queens, all wear what I choose is in style. And they pay through the nose for it, which is the best part. So here's what's going to happen. You head down to Lost Rigger Cove and acquire a lot of pirate hats by whatever means. Do you think you can handle that?
text.94744: You did well slowing the Twilight's Hammer. Their foothold in Sunnyglade has weakened and you've turned their ogre warriors against them. Now we take the fight to them. My brother, Dag'rosh, has already gone ahead with a scouting party. I would have preferred he waited for you, but he is impulsive and overeager--like a true warrior. I'd be honored if you joined him in battle at their stronghold to the west.
text.85596: Zanza can create the ancient troll enchantments with the right components. The first is a primal Hakkari idol that must be taken from the most powerful of the Hakkari lieutenants: Jin'do and the Bloodlord. The second is a punctured voodoo doll. These can be found in the piles of refuse that litter this foul place. Look inside the jinxed hoodoo piles. Bring me these things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
text.226: Sven and I have dangerous days ahead of us, what with the Necromancer to the east and all. And out here alone as we are, we have to hunt for our own food. It seems every time I'm heading back to camp with some meat on me, starving or rabid dire wolves come out of the forest wanting a bite. It goes without saying, living out here is dangerous work! But if you can rid us of some of those wolves, we'd have an easier time of it. They mostly prowl north and east of here, near the river.
text.95926: You there! I have a job for someone of your... skills. I have gotten word from my sources of a crystal found in Shaper's Terrace that can seemingly drain the elements around it. Or perhaps it can drain life essence itself. It is unclear from this report. I must have a fragment of this crystal! Just think of the applications of such a powerful artifact. Go to Shaper's Terrace and bring me back a sample of this colorless Achromatic Crystal, and I will reward you for your efforts.
text.922: <name>, can you take one of the seeds you brought me to my friend, Rellian Greenspyre? He is a druid in Darnassus, and when last we spoke he revealed his interest in my work with the Timberlings. He had some ideas himself, and he will appreciate a specimen seed to work with. Thank you, <name>. You have been a great help to me. I hope that, some day, you will see the fruit of my labors. You will usually find Rellian walking the pathways of the Cenarion Enclave in Darnassus.
text.376: My duties include tending to our wounded warriors, tailoring armor and clothes, and assisting Shadow Priest Sarvis with whatever else he might need. From the look of it, you'll be enlisted in his service also... hunting the Mindless Ones, if I know his mind. Well, if you'd like to stay in one piece--and I've no doubt you do--perhaps I can help. I'm running out of paws and wings, and if you bring me some, I'll find some armor for you. You'll find a good number of wolves and bats to the south.
text.159: Here's your Zombie Juice... ...and be careful with this stuff. It's strong enough to raise the dead!
text.1080: Plan Beta's just like Plan Alpha, <name>. We cause a distraction and then steal their precious letters. The key is to get their letters... remember that. The pages I gave you already will tell you where to plant the explosives. Just get back here alive and with those letters....
text.79626: This contraption seems to be receiving power, but just barely. A small plaque on the device reads "The Salvagematic 9000", followed by a bit of text that is indecipherable due to the thick layer of caked-on filth. The machine has a very large intake receptacle as well as a slot for coins to be inserted.
text.8342: <name>, if you plan to go after the Abysall High Council again, then you'll need another Twilight ring of lordship. Bring me more shards and signets and I'll make one for you.
text.6761: I have relegated my second, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, to deal with Moonglade's call for aid. Speak to him on this matter - NOT me. Let me give you some... friendly... advice. It is I who led us out of the darkness - NOT the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade - when all was lost for our race. Teldrassil gives us all new life! They would have you believe otherwise, and to believe their propaganda would be a fool's task. I'll leave it to you to decide whether or not you're a fool.
text.7070: I've recently begun testing various crystals and their arcane properties. Lady Proudmoore has given me leave to ask travelers heading into Desolace to seek out a place called Maraudon. Within the ruined temple are great elementals composed of purplish stones I've named shadowshards. If you decide to head that direction and find some of the crystals, I would be very thankful. I could even fashion you a trinket from them if you so desired.
text.1288: You've done some good work, <name>, best I've seen from an amateur. Lady Proudmoore asked that I keep her apprised of this delicate situation, and I haven't spoken to her for some time now. I was going to deliver my report to her later, but it seems more fitting that you should be the one to speak with her about it. You can probably answer her questions better than I could.
text.4505: Some may say that I am exceptionally cruel... But truly, it is only a strong desire to see the Horde gain an advantage against the Alliance, in any way possible. My newest interest is a moonwell at the Ruins of Constellas, south of here, tended by the Jadefire satyrs. The moonwell, once a symbol of renewal for the insufferable night elves, is now corrupted, and used to bring forth more satyrs. I have an idea, <name>, and I'd like a sample of the water... for my little feline friend here.
text.6941: The elite Frostwolf units that guard the lines must be dealt with, soldier! I'm tasking you with thinning out that herd of savages. Return to me with medals from their lieutenants and legionnaires. When I feel that enough of the riff-raff has been dealt with, I'll deploy the air strike.
text.5403: An Invader's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge's elite troops. These are sometimes found on the stronger of the troops positioned in the Plaguelands. Slaying such a creature is indeed a challenge, but one that should be relished with a commission to vanquish evil. The Argent Dawn currently offers a valor token in exchange for ten of these insignia. Bring them to me here, and I will make sure you receive your just reward.
text.1384: The Kolkar centaurs think their magic is strong. They do not know magic! They would not know magic if it bit them! You will show them their magic is weak. Go to the Kolkar to the northeast and kill them. Take their charms. Bring me the charms and I will throw them in the fire and laugh!
text.82210: You've done it already, but we will continue to accept any troll tribal necklaces you find and are willing to turn in. By turning them in to me, you'll continue to improve your standing amongst the Wildhammers; if you're willing to fight for us, then we'll be willing to fight for you! I need five troll tribal necklaces for them to count, <name>.
text.1113: Why do I need a rare type of guano, you might ask. Well, for this experiment I want to see what effect two diametrically opposed chemical substances can have on each other, especially when both are combined with an ever-toxic agent to ensure the most... ghastly results. In the northeastern peaks of Tirisfal Glades lies the Scarlet Monastery. There the crazed disciples of the Scarlet Crusade congregate. Slay them and bring me their zealous hearts. Our concoction will be most wicked!
text.81732: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Yorgen Farmstead. Defeat dragonkin there and return to me.
text.891: Yet another ship from my fleet has been lost to those overzealous humans at Northwatch Hold! Those bastards must be dealt with. Their paranoia has them in a state of frenzy. Trigger happy, reckless louts are shooting at anything in their sights. Travel south along the Merchant Coast to the Hold and lay siege to their forces. Bring me the medals of their soldiers as proof. And for the love of my fleet, slay Captain Fairmount and her overzealous cannoneers!
text.95601: <This dead ogre must be one of the friends Clubtoe was looking for. The Twilight's Hammer seem to be conducting rituals on their members, empowering some and killing more. These ritualists and their monstrosities must be stopped before they spread.>
text.6661: Avast ye scallywag. Arrrr... Arrrr ye looking fer work? We gots a serious rat problem down here an' not enough hands on the poop deck. What do ye say? All ye needs to do is take this here rat catchin' flute and play the melody around the vermin. They'll follow ye to the ends of the world! Just capture five of the little buggers and bring em back here. We needs em alive. Arrrrr...
text.78919: The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us. If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good. <name>, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water. In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity. If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!
text.949: The Twilight's Hammer's purpose at the Master's Glaive is not known. But it must be dark. Search through their camp at the Glaive... Search for some thing that may teach us their intentions. For we must learn their intentions before a plan is made.
text.431: In this crate lie a collection of Candles of Beckoning, one of which will be needed to summon Lillith Nefara. Will you take one of the candles?
text.8394: Winning a war is about more than just outsmarting and outfighting your opponent. Victory often comes down to simply producing more than your enemy. What we have in Arathi Basin is a sizeable supply of resources for whichever side manages to claim it first. If the Alliance comes out victorious, it'll mean more swords and pikes for our troops. If the Horde were to win, those swords and pikes would still get made, they'd just be pointed at us! Now is the time to help the Alliance in Arathi Basin, <name>.
text.473: <name>. The Dragonmaw orc clan is showing its strength in more than just Algaz. Captain Stoutfist has asked to speak with those willing to offer aid against these orcs. He is inside the keep, in the war room.
text.2138: As I had feared, the cure does not work. It saddens me greatly to order the death of any of nature's beasts, but the sick and tainted thistle bears must be put down. Return to the forest and destroy 20 rabid thistle bears, <name>. It will most certainly not put a stop to the plague but it will slow down the damage the animals are doing to our forest and its inhabitants for a short time.
text.218: My journal! They took it away to the cave. The one that had it... It was a big brute with some odd markings on his skin and face. I didn't get a much better look than that. You've had some luck with the trolls, maybe you could go get it back for me?
text.2139: The survival of our people and lands comes at unfortunate costs, <name>. You have spilled the blood of nature's servants; many sick animals you have felled. The people of Auberdine are indebted to you, for the forest's pain is eased--even if only for a moment. I have one final task for you, but be warned, you will have to kill again. It is my hope that this will be the last time I call upon you, <name>. In a cave to the northeast, near Bashal'Aran, resides the Den Mother. Slay her.
text.957: It was the craft of one of the most powerful of the Highborne that created the seal that formed my prison. In Ameth'Aran, the ruins to the south that are twin to these, persists even today an ancient flame, blue in color. In this flame this seal could be destroyed. Be wary in the ruins, <name>...
text.92702: <Fenwick struggles to rock back and forth and gain some swaying motion.> Hey! Hey you! Grab a stick and see if you can reach me, please? I've been stuck here so long my suspenders are chafing! I've got good things--GREAT things--to share with you! Fenwick Togglespring never gives false promises! It's my rusty brother back at the launch pad who clearly miscalculated a few things in our rocket launch capabilities! He's mister false promises! <Fenwick fails to grab an object out of reach.>
text.89444: <Sifting through the ruins of the battle with Baelin Caldoran, you find the emblem from the shattered blade of the Ashbringer. As you hold the skull-shaped icon in your hand, you can swear you hear a slight, murmuring whisper. You look around, searching for a source for the voice, but you see no obvious source of the sound. You shake your head and stow the emblem in your pack.> Seek out Lord Maxwell Tyrosus once you make your return to Light's Hope Chapel. He will be interested in this artifact.
text.1130: <name>, Melor Stonehoof has heard of your deeds, and has set a path before you. If you wish to take it, then go to Thunder Bluff and speak with Melor. You will find him on Hunter's Rise.
text.94004: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Elixir of Ogre's Strength, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.8297: War must be fought with soldiers, any soldier will tell you. They'll also say that a battle fought with poor gear or on an empty stomach is lost before it starts! That is why Arathi Basin is important. There are key areas in the basin that hold essential resources. Metals, weapons, food, lumber - all are needed, and all can be gained there. That is what I want from you, <name>. Enter Arathi Basin, win the battle by holding more bases than the enemy, and return to me with a crate of resources.
text.4002: You bring excellent information, <name>. As Warchief, it is my duty to do what is best for the Horde. To ensure that the generations that come after us are not forced into a hopeless existence. The opportunity to shape our future alliances has fallen into our collective laps. A move to help the dwarves could greatly strengthen our relationships in the Eastern Kingdoms. This, then, is why you must not fail! Are you prepared?
text.95260: The hide is painted with broad strokes of fish guts and squid ink. It appears to depict some kind of sea monster, rising up from the waves, with a long neck. What could this beast be? The nearest port is Powderfuse Port. If this monster is real, and lurks these waters, a sailor there has surely seen it.
text.96897: The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
text.95913: <Tessa rocks her baby, trying to help her sleep.> If she isn't hungry, maybe she's just tired. To be honest, Emma here was a delightful surprise, but that means we were a little unprepared. My husband built her this lovely bassinet, but I worry these blankets are too old. She deserves the best, after all. If you're still willing to help, I would be forever grateful if you could find some pelts for me to line her bed with. If this stops her crying, I think everyone in Farholde would be grateful.
text.9042: During your battles with the Scourge in Naxxramas, should you come across desecrated battlements and wartorn plate scraps, return them to me and I shall craft for you a piece of armor worn by heroes.
text.8519: As you regain your composure and focus your gaze, you notice that something stirs within the crystal. Upon closer inspection, you realize that you are looking into the past... a memory... long forgotten.
text.251: Take the note you gave me to Sirra Von'Indi. He's very learned in languages and ancient arts - if anyone here can translate this message, it's he.
text.936: Excuse me {class}, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible. The Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research. Please - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff proper.
text.93678: I've prepared a transcription of Gimashi's notes on draenethyst. It appears the shards possess some degree of energy, but a pure sphere of the stuff is vastly more powerful. That seems to be what the Burning Blade was after. Many of Gimashi's notes allude to portals and demonic summoning rituals. Portals to where, or to summon which demons, I cannot say for sure. While my answers are not definitive, please take these notes back to the swamp with you. I hope you'll understand if I don't come along.
text.373: Searching Edwin VanCleef's person, you discover, among other things, an unsent letter. It is addressed to Baros Alexston, the City Architect of Stormwind, City Hall, Cathedral Square. It appears to be recently written and sealed.
text.3363: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a songflower plant. A pungent, unhealthy odor emanates from the plant. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
text.8070: Shortly after the fall of the Gurubashi, we Zandalar almost succumbed to a final defeat from evil within our own tribe. It was then that the confessors amongst us arose, preserving the tribe by banishing out those who would destroy their own kind. They not only keep us in tune with the spirits, but they also preserve the flesh. Go forth into Zul'Gurub and witness first hand the depravity of Hakkar and the Gurubashi. Wrest the Paragons of Power that we seek from them; success will be rewarded!
text.2938: The venom you gathered from the Witherbark's spider god is quite a find! I've been able to kill nearly two dozen rabbits with just a drop of the stuff. Granted, some of those rabbits were very young and small enough to fit in the palm of one's hand so I'm certain their resistance to toxins was low, but it can't be denied that this poison is powerful! I'd like a sample sent to my superior, Apothecary Faranell in the Apothecarium of the Undercity. I am positive he would want to test this himself.
text.91697: Thank you for helping gather bear berries. Small steps build trust! With the aroma of berry resin on you, the Elders should be more welcoming of you. Go and speak with Elder Mistpaw and Elder Pinespeaker.
text.95431: As I've shadowed our enemy's movements, I have discovered a weakness among their ranks. Ogre dissidents have begun to rebel, seeking the same freedom as their Bolder'ok kin. Word of your deeds has spread. We must exploit this. I spied a Bolder'ok warrior heading to the caves west of here in search of his brothers and sisters. Find him, and join his efforts to rally his people.
text.2098: A pirate's life ain't an easy one, landlubber. It ain't all about plunderin' and booze! Alas, me ship be sunk just off shore thanks to them pesky Threshadons. What I be needin' is me first mate back in workin' order! When I washed up'n shore, the key for me first mate broke on the rocks and was pilfered by the beasties of Darkshore. Out of the corner of me eyes I saw some of them Ragin' Crawlers, Ferocious Foreststrider, and murloc rummaging through the wreckage....
text.1087: You cannot imagine the hatred I possess for this wretched land. The ilk of Cenarius and the kaldorei druids at the peak employ their pathetic powers to stifle the flow of magic, even so far south of their pathetic holdings... their beloved forests. Would that I could return to Jaedenar and exult in the flow of magic, but my master will not allow me to return until my work is done. I have no doubt you love the night elves and their allies as little as I. Aid me, and both our ends might be satisfied.
text.8112: How be that talisman, mon? It look like it be time to add a little more magic and mojo to its leaves. It need a little bloom in its wilt. Give it here and Maywiki fix it right up.
text.93318: By order of Constable Aonda of the Peacekeepers, a bounty is hereby placed upon the scourge of the highlands, Vulgara the Insatiable. Last spotted on a hilltop rise just southwest of Shen'dar Village, the winged vuldren terror is highly dangerous and should be approached with caution. Deliver the beast's head to Danarii Bellowveil to receive your reward.
text.1366: Now that you scared the centaur clans, it's time to bleed them. When traveling Desolace, hunt centaur. I don't care which clan you hunt. Just gather ears. A hoard of ears. By weakening their numbers you will weaken their resolve, and stamp out any thoughts of expansion. Good hunting, <name>.
text.99022: There's power in a creature's heart. It's the core of one's life, and without it, the living cease to live. I sometimes miss the beating of my own heart, though I acknowledge that requiring a pulse to live is... strictly a liability. Travel to the Shaper's Terrace overlooking Un'goro Crater and retrieve the still-beating heart of the great Direhorn Matriarch there, as well as the hardened heart of the watcher, Nanaya. Do this and I will cleanse the armor piece you carry.
text.94274: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Golden Scale Coif, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.1070: Hello, <name>. You seem to be full of wanderlust by the looks of you. Have you been to the Stonetalon Mountains? It is a land plagued by the Venture Co. and other enemies of the night elves. Recently, Sentinel Wolfrunner sent my friend Kaela Shadowspear there to investigate what's happening to the land, but I have yet to hear word back from her. I'm even more concerned because the Alliance sent a gnome mage along with her... a sign of trouble for sure. Would you find her and report back to me?
text.92701: For now it seems the pylon and the village are safe, so I'd like you to deliver this report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar, at the southeastern edge of the island. Valennia is the leader of the peacekeepers on the island and she needs to know what happened here. The cult is expanding rapidly and the peacekeepers have avoided direct conflict until now, but those days are over. Valanaar will need to be ready for a fight. At any rate, thank you. You'll always have friends in Shen'dar, <name>.
text.3825: Just one last thing you must do, soldier. I've taken the liberty of putting Gor'tesh's head on a pike. Now all you have to do is take this head to the top of Dreadmaul Rock and stick it into the ground. Once you do that, watch as those cowardly ogres run for their lives! After you've had your fun, come back to me and I'll reward you for all of your hard work. <Oralius seems to be losing touch with reality.>
text.944: It is strange that the naga are here, in Darkshore. But stranger still...are the Twilight's Hammer. That cult worships the old, old lords of the earth. Lords defeated long ago. The Master's Glaive, to the south, is a place where such an old lord fell. Go there and look for more Twilight's Hammer cultists. Take this phial of scrying. Use it to create a scrying bowl after searching the Master's Glaive. Then speak to me through the bowl.
text.5094: Heroes of the realm, hear me - the Horde calls upon you for swift action! A call to arms has been issued for all able bodied individuals to take up arms against the Scourge! Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the Eastern Kingdoms. They loom to the east of the Undercity, in the northern reaches of the lands now known as the Plaguelands! Heroes of the realm - seek out High Executor Derrington, who has set up his base camp at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade!
text.94304: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Mageweave Bag, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.7849: Like many in our village, I too have lost a loved one to the wilds. Alas, it was my twin brother Malkhor - taken in the same raid as Torntusk's mate by the Vilebranch. Sadly, he was not fated to live and was given a swift, brutal execution; his remains fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch. It is too late to save his life but not too late to save his soul. Recover his remains, <name>.
text.96125: Now that the lion hides have been collected, and the orcish poachers culled, I can finally get a break. At least, that's what I would say, if the man who was supposed to relieve me of my watch wasn't missing. Dunston Willis, explorer extraordinaire, went to investigate the ogre settlement to the north a few days ago. He said he'd take over my post upon his return. Find him. If he's alive, bring him back here. If he's hanging up on meat hooks, bring me proof so Demar can send me someone else.
text.96876: The pack has the name "Ukor" crudely stitched along the flap.
text.5023: You pick up the package, wiping off a small layer of dust and grime that had settled on it. It is addressed in a hurried hand to a Jeremiah Felstone of Lordaeron; the delivery of the package is dated for well over four years ago. Though it is unclear if Jeremiah Felstone is even alive, it is widely known that the Undercity, formerly known as Lordaeron, keeps records on the populace of the city. This is handled through the Royal Overseers of the Undercity Census.
text.94247: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Lesser Wizard's Robe, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.3261: Your time with me is over, <name>. To learn more, you must go to Camp Taurajo to the south and speak with Jorn Skyseer. He will continue your guidance.
text.94489: I have finished the poultices. Quickly, take them to the druids in the cave, north just across the clearing. I know my brethren are in much more dire condition than I. They are likely too injured to heal their own wounds. There are so few of us shen'dorei druids that every life is precious. Before you go, I have a selfish request. My mate, Jorel Windsinger was in dire condition when I left. Please, see to his wounds if he still lives.
text.5022: You pick up the package, wiping off a small layer of dust and grime that had settled on it. It is addressed in a hurried hand to an Emma Felstone of Stormwind; the delivery of the package is dated for well over four years ago. Though it is unclear if Emma Felstone is even alive, it is widely known that the Stormwind City Hall keep records on the populace of the city. This is handled through the Royal Factors of the Stormwind Census.
text.88716: Bring me any doomed souls that cross your path, <name>. Let me rephrase that - you MUST bring them to me. MY duty is to stay and guide the souls of the lost. YOUR duty is to bring them to me. A word of advice, never handle more than one soul at a time. Trust me, your soul can only handle so much, and your mind... well... it can handle even less. This burden is now yours. Because you can, you must. Consider this a moral obligation.
text.96258: I'm a dwarf of my word... here's a copy of my book. I even signed it for you, hah! Tell Mazu'kon I've still not forgotten our last encounter, and if I ever see him in the field again, I'll make sure he loses more than a few toes in our next encounter. Now go, beat it. I don't want to see your face in my library again.
text.92345: You may have noticed the furbolg and satyr north of here fighting over a burrow. The conflict does not interest me as much as what could be inside. That burrow seems to lead beneath Nordrassil. I don't think I need to tell you how this could be of interest to the Kaldorei. We have our hands full here as it is, but the druids of Darnassus should be informed. Find Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave. He can decide if this is something worth pursuing.
text.796: Hail, <name>. So you'd like to travel to the fine town of Booty Bay, located in Stranglethorn Vale? Well, you've come to the right place! Hang on to your hat and enjoy the ride! <<Note: Our crack team of artists, programmers and shipwrights are currently hard at work preparing the "real" boat for your sailing pleasure. In the meantime, please enjoy this free teleport instead. -- Thanks, --WoW Team>>
text.95560: <The mysterious scroll is written in a flowing script not unlike that of Darnassian. Unlike true elvish text, however, you notice something slightly... off about the flow of the words. You think you catch a faint sensation of magical energy, but it's gone before you can be sure. You feel a small tug in your mind, nudging you towards the north end of Felwood. You don't know how you know it, but someone there needs aid.>
text.94348: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Chimeric Vest, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.8536: The Twilight's Hammer and the elemental nobles they worship present a formidable threat to our operations in Silithus. With the new enemies we're facing inside Ahn'Qiraj, we cannot afford to lower our guard to our enemies outside. Find a way to summon and destroy an Earthen Templar and report to Bor Wildmane.
text.1367: To beat the centaur, we must use their hatred against them. We will ally with one of the clans and through them, we will learn how to defeat all the clans. If you choose to ally with the Magram then slay their foes, the Gelkis. This will earn you respect among the Magram. When you earn enough, then meet with the Magram spokesman Warug, on the outskirts of the Magram Village, in southeast Desolace.
text.158: I need a bottle of a certain liquor - Zombie Juice. Tavernkeep Smitts at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire should have some. And please hurry, <name>. These nights get cold, and I need that drink to put fire in my veins again!
text.96494: With the perimeter scouted, you've proven useful and trustworthy enough to bring into the fold. I'm here representing SI:7's efforts to gain crucial information important to the Alliance. Not just anyone is privy to this knowledge. Mind your discretion. A druidic cult known as the Blackthorne Pact has taken root nearby, operating in service to something they call the Wild King. Find the domain of this "Wild King" and mark it. Then we can report back to Stormwind with certainty.
text.94929: I know I said that was it, but I promise, I wouldn't ask this if it weren't important. It's a shipment of utmost urgency. An old acquaintance resides in a keep within the Riverglades. To get there, travel northeast through the bogs avoiding the deadly creatures within. Along the northeastern hillside sits an old path. Travel its road all the way through the hills and when you hit the fork in the road stay north, then east. You should see Farholde along the eastern shore. I thank you for your aid.
text.89563: I could not help but overhear your conversation with Leonid about Inquisitor Caldoran. The scant details Leonid provided to you are the barest sliver of the history they share and the suffering Caldoran has inflicted on him. I was there when Leonid was at his lowest point and I helped him find the strength to pick himself back up. I fear what our continued cooperation with the Scarlet Crusade will do to Leonid, particularly if it brings him closer to that man.
text.96957: Listen, mortal. Though it may not appear a glorious job, those that are under my wing help keep the natural balance. We return many essential nutrients to the soil, allowing for new life. These undead have disrupted the cycle here and have driven off those that seek shelter under my wings. While you are out there being the little murderous creature you are, would you collect some bones for me? I would like to rebuild the nests of my children and followers so we may feast when this blight has ended.
text.81731: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in the Twilight Grove, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Vul'gol Ogre Mound. Defeat ogres there and return to me.
text.216: The Thistlefur furbolgs are threatening our expansion! Thistlefur Village to our east blocks the way between us here and the Splintertree Post. It's a path that would circumvent the village of Astranaar; without it, we give the Alliance an extra expansion path. <name>, we must not allow... an expansion path gap! Proceed to Thistlefur Village and thin out the furbolgs. You will be given compensation for this task, but more importantly you will be doing your duty for the Horde!
text.7302: Our air support is in shambles, <name>. The Wing Commanders were shot down over enemy territory. You must find out what became of them so that we can attempt a rescue! Guse was last seen flying over the Icewing Bunker. Jeztor's War Rider was spotted near the Stormpike lumber mill. Mulverick... that reckless fool was seen crashing near the Dun'Baldar North Bunker. That's all the information I have. Move out! Search through the areas thoroughly.
text.3702: Would you like to hear a brief history of the Dark Iron dwarves?
text.99129: Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do. He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.
text.1077: Here you are, <name>. This should do nicely. Please give my regards to Gaxim when next you see him. I look forward to hearing about this adventure when it sees its completion. Fare well.
text.9020: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us. The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for. I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
text.99215: Lok-tar, <name>. It is good to see you again. As you know, there is no stronger bond than that of an orc and their wolf, and now you have enough experience to handle and ride our fiercest and fastest wolves. Many of these fine wolves remember you from the last time you were here and have grown since you first met. They are stronger, faster and braver than before, much like yourself. Go and find which armored wolf speaks to you. Return to me when you have your answer.
text.8775: As the war effort mounts, the silithid presence in the area presents an ever increasing threat to our operations. You've been selected to partake on an assault on Hive'Regal where your primary target will consist of the airborne Hive'Regal spitfires. Report back to Commander Mar'alith after your task is completed.
text.84204: A truly amazing story, <name>! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past. As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
text.7850: The Vilebranch fight with supernatural ferocity. This is due to the foul magical weavings of the Vile Priestess Hexx. Throughout Jintha'alor you will find dark vessels of tainted blood. The vessels radiate the foul magic of the faceless blood God, empowering the Vilebranch and also driving them to madness. Steal those vessels and return them to me so that I may remove the taint and ultimately loosen the grip of the blood God.
text.931: The fronds on this plant shimmer in the forest light, giving it a twisting, pulsing aura. You believe that Denalan would want a specimen of this.
text.3130: At this point, I am going to direct you to my second, Latronicus. He's been keeping a close eye on the naga forces to date. I'll assess the general situation here in regards to the naga; as much as I want to commit a full force to move against them, leaving the stronghold open to direct attack from the Horde - or worse - seems less than optimal. Anyway, Latronicus awaits. Good work thus far, <name>. Keep it up. You're dismissed.
text.93188: You have done enough on the front lines. We can handle ourselves. Tell Orgrul that you have served your purpose. The Magram Front is stronger now, and we have our sights set on the outcast encampment as our next settlement when another fleet of fighters joins the fray. Well? Get going!
text.7923: You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. Continue to rage against the Silverwing Sentinels! Bring me more marks of honor!
text.8369: Listen up, <name>. No matter what you might have heard about the battle raging in Alterac Valley, one thing remains true: the Stormpike Expedition invaded Frostwolf Territory. The day we allow the Alliance to invade Horde lands without a forceful response is the day I hang up my axe and live the rest of my life in shame. Go forth and expel the invaders!
text.95349: The recent events with the cult have delayed my plans to travel to Azeroth and I must remain here in Valanaar for a time. You and a handful of other Windshapers will be our vanguard instead. Alaana Stormwalker will be waiting to receive our Windshapers upon arrival in Mulgore, and I'd encourage you to explore Azeroth while we finish our business here. We will join you soon. When you are ready, please proceed to the dock just outside this lodge and board the skycutter ship there. Banu-Alah, <name>.
text.991: <name>, a longtime friend of mine is also aiding the Sentinels here in Ashenvale, but he has yet to return. He had leads on finding an item that he thought could slow the furbolg attacks on our people--a rod created by a now-dead, evil wizard. Before he left here, he mentioned seeking out a gem for the rod. He mentioned the gem possibly being hidden at the shrine in Lake Falathim at the base of the mountain to the west. The gem was being held there before it was overrun. Find my friend, <name>, please.
text.86326: The deep and dark tunnels to ancient places of the world are ill suited for your travel.
text.97985: Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation. I have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one! I hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in Thousand Needles. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart! Oh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.
text.8809: Vargus, Cenarion Hold's blacksmith, has requested enchanted materials to be used in the crafting of powerful weapons for our forces. Obtain these and bring them directly to Vargus so that Cenarion Hold's troops may continue to be well equipped.
text.9034: During your battles with the Scourge in Naxxramas, should you come across desecrated battlements and wartorn plate scraps, return them to me and I shall craft for you a piece of armor worn by heroes.
text.5102: We battle against these beasts on two fronts: From our capital of Stormwind we fight them from the inside out and here, in the Burning Steppes, we take the battle to their doorstep. We must be vigilant, <name>. None should be spared our wrath as none of our own were spared when they struck at our homes and families. Find this General Drakkisath and destroy him! The task certainly will not be a simple one, but the rewards shall be extravagant.
text.446: This Ichor was crafted by an old colleague of mine: Thule Ravenclaw. He was a young, promising mage before the great war, but when the Lich King rose to power, he betrayed his brethren and allied with the Scourge. I did not realize he still lives, nor that he leads the Rot Hides in their forays against us! I know many of his spells, and can help concoct a potion to counter them. Take this scroll back to Apothecary Renferrel. It has the incantations needed for the potion.
text.93732: This used to be a port back when the skycutters could travel between the provinces, but since we've long since lost contact with the other islands, the docks are mostly for show. Though we keep our ships in good repair, well... just in case. Since you are new to Valanaar, it might be worth your time to show yourself around. I'm sure there's work to be had for an enterprising adventurer as well, if you ask around. When you've finished, please deliver this note to High Elder Talaanis Shadowsong for me.
text.6362: For a small fee, I will give you a wind rider to Thunder Bluff. There's no faster way to the city! If that is acceptable, speak to me again when you are ready to go. If you're taking those hides to Ahanu, then I think he's at Hewa's Armory, at the base of the wind rider tower in Thunder Bluff. And that's right where you'll land!
text.3790: Excuse me {class}, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible. The Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is looking for seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm is spearheading this research. Please - if you are interested, speak with him directly in the Cenarion Enclave within Darnassus proper.
text.95108: With far sight, we have seen their den. Deadwood brew dark rites in their pots. They feed this foul mix to their young, so bad roots take. Then they learn to fight with vile ways. Go, stop this spread. Slay the dark ones and smash their stew.
text.322: There is a dwarven weaponsmith in the Dwarven District of Stormwind who can craft with lightforge iron. His name is Grimand Elmore. I've packed the iron you found into a crate. Take it to Grimand and tell him your tale. I'm sure he'll oblige someone on a quest such as yours, and craft for you a weapon - a weapon to give even Morbent Fel worry!
text.93090: Please extend my thanks to Ayessa for all that the Windshapers and your new friends from this "Earthen Ring" have done for Zephras Isle. I'm aware of the plan to take the Windshapers' shamans and leave the island, and your order has my blessing and well-wishes in this expedition. I can only hope that whatever solution the Windshapers find can truly provide us with the stability we've lacked these past years. Winds be with you, <name>.
text.98979: You wade through toil and torment in search of riches and glory, ever pushing onward and upward. The weight of such an existence weighs heavily on all of us who choose this life. Should we not unburden our enemies of that which weighs heavily on their shoulders? In the city Stratholme reside two great, but opposing evils. Bring me the mantle of the false crusader, Dathrohan in his great bastion, and the pauldron of the one called Rivendare in his slaughterhouse sanctuary.
text.9266: You must've done something really bad to us or our friends, <name>. At any rate, I'm here to offer you a way to get our good graces back. As you know, Winterspring is quite cold. With so many of us goblins coming from other cities, we could use a hand keeping warm. Bring me some runecloth and coal and I'll put in the good word for ya. Be warned though, our enemies are not going to take kindly to your helping us.
text.4223: <Magistrate Solomon sighs.> You must return to the Burning Steppes, <name>. As a deputy of Stormwind, you will be required to report to Marshal Maxwell. Good luck.
text.7761: Imbecile, I hold very little faith in your ability to prevent outsiders from accessing the master's lair. In the very likely event of your death, this orb has its own failsafe built in to prevent outsiders from teleporting directly into Blackwing. Only those with the Mark of Drakkisath branded upon their hand may make use of this orb. Thankfully, Drakkisath is not nearly as incompetent as you, Quartermaster. He guards the brand himself! -Warchief Rend Blackhand P.S. Destroy this letter, idiot.
text.8433: The battle in Warsong Gulch rages on, <name>. Do your part to drive the Silverwing Sentinels out of our lands!
text.85636: My eyes failed me long ago, but I do not miss them. Even in a tribe such as ours - where one's vestments convey station and purpose - the most potent of garb exudes power that simple eyes cannot see. The prized tunic of the Zandalar madcap is no exception, exuding the raw power of chaos and madness that they are able to channel. The Paragons of Power I need lie in Zul'Gurub; bring me what I seek, and I will reward you with your own legendary tunic... one befitting a weaver of madness.
text.3982: I was sent here under the auspices of Thrall. Do you actually think these buffoons could capture me? I allowed myself to be captured so that I could gather intelligence. <Gor'shak whispers.> The Princess of Ironforge has been kidnapped by Emperor Thaurissan. Princess Bronzebeard is in this very city! I bet old Magni's heart almost stopped when he heard that news. <Gor'shak laughs.> Shhh! Do you hear that? Guards coming! DEFEND YOURSELF!
text.94613: Our warhorses come from two nearby farms. One of them, owned by the Wheeler family off the road just outside of town, has apparently lost all of their stock. The cause of this is currently unknown. With no horses, we have no cavalry, and without cavalry, our campaign against the Horde stands no chance. Thus, you see, this situation must be resolved with utmost haste. Of where to start, however, I am less sure. Go to Wheeler's Grange and speak to Benjy. See what he has to say for himself.
text.204: To have a chance against Kurzen, we need his healing support neutralized. He has gathered around him a large number of Medicine Men who heal his forces with Jungle Remedies and poison our fighters with Venom Fern Extracts. We need those remedies to cure our own people, and we need a sample of those extracts to study so we can make our own remedies. Search the Kurzen Compound for both - his Medicine Men will have the remedies, and the extracts are probably stowed in some of the camp's supply boxes.
text.92169: The Blackthorne Pact. That's what they call themselves. Apostate druids that have taken over Hyjal Summit. Violent, and extremist. They blame Malfurion Stormrage for robbing them of their immortality, and have sworn to reclaim the power that they were forced to relinquish. I did not understand the magic that empowered them before, but it's becoming clear now. Take the staff, use it on the Blackthorne druids around the mountain. It should respond to and dispel the wards protecting them.
text.97270: There must be more to the Maul than this! Perhaps the loud Spectator who oversees the event at Dire Maul will know!
text.93928: I need a cookie, see? Nyeah!
text.2935: The venom from the broodguards wasn't as potent as the venom you brought originally. It must have come from a different spider. I want a fresh sample of that venom. To find out where it came from, you must consult with a troll who knows the Witherbark well--Master Gadrin in Sen'jin Village. Travel to Durotar and speak with Gadrin. With luck, he'll know where the Witherbarks get their venom.
text.94235: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Gnomish Universal Remote, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.93314: <Jereman shifts her weight, her feathers bristling in anger as she clacks her beak in displeasure.> I do not know what awaits us here, but there is an overwhelming sense of wrongness about the mountain I have not felt in centuries. Having gotten a taste of the Wild King's magic first-talon however, I know he must be stopped. I only pray we have arrived in time to save the other Wild Gods who reside here.
text.4729: You're probably wondering what I'm doing out here. Look at the cages! Ain't it obvious? I'm an animal lover, first and foremost, but a salesman by trade. I track down exotic animals for the rich and famous and domesticate the beasts so they behave as proper pets. Now you're probably wondering, "What can I do for you, Kibler." The answer is simple: Take this here beast cage and find me some worg pups. For that, I'll domesticate a worg for you!
text.9004: That's an amazing story, <name>! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut. As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
text.2204: You are going to need to find some "oomph" for the necklace, and Uldaman is probably the best place for it, actually. I guess there are a lot of constructs running around in there, yeah? Well, take out the biggest, baddest construct in that place and grab its power source! I am pretty sure I can fuse that source into the necklace. Without that power source, fixing the necklace will be impossible. Come back to me here to Ironforge when you have it, and we'll get it all fixed up for you!
text.7223: Battles rage constantly in Alterac Valley, and the supplies we get from Ironforge are not enough to outfit our experienced troops. If you find armor scraps from the battlefield, aid the war effort and bring those scraps to me!
text.793: The Seal of the Earth is held by three runestones, held in the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst in Lethlor Ravine. Using the Sign of the Earth, you will be able to remove the runestones and unlock the Seal of the Earth. Be wary though, <name>, the black drakes Blacklash and Hematus are not to be trifled with. See them dead and return their bindings to me. To reach the ravine, travel to the far eastern part of the Badlands. Be careful though, for the ravine is home to countless drakes.
text.736: You need Yagyin's Digest? Your plan, then, is to gather another flock? Of course it is...and of course I will help you, brother. But you must help me too. I require three items of power. Bring me these and the digest will be yours. I cannot utter the names of these items, but I will write them down. Get me the items on this list. If you can do that, then you are truly worthy of opening your own chapter of our order.
text.86725: Ah yes, the dangers of the desert. No, not the sweltering heat, not the unbearable sunlight, not the sand crawling up into your robes, not the freezing nights. The other dangers! The bugs, and now the bothersome brutes. Our reconnaissance has reported the Horde are gathering dirt! I usually wouldn't call this out of the ordinary for them, but Silithyst? I would rather they not uncover the secrets of the sand. As Chief Expeditionary Requisitioner I am requesting a competing order! Get me that dirt!
text.93407: We need to improve our defenses here, and we lack the resources to construct fortifications. We do, however, have all of the bounty of nature. Search the forest for thorn bushes and bring their seeds back to me. With the power of nature, we will grow our own defenses.
text.980: Now, I've heard about other hot springs in a place called Winterspring, far to the north of here. The strange thing is, there are no volcanoes anywhere near them. Interesting, I know. Well, if you want to find out more, you should head to Winterspring and speak to a friend of mine. Her name is Donova Snowden, and she is currently staying by the hot springs there. Thanks again for helping me with my thermometer! See you later!
text.817: Many of the hides we use come from Durotar tigers, <name>. Blankets, armor, tents: there are a great many reasons we hunt the beasts, and many reasons we let them thrive at the same time. The time has come for us to cull the flock, so to speak. Our numbers grow, and our needs are beginning to overwhelm our stocks. I need more hides if I'm to prepare suitable goods for our people. Bring me 4 Durotar tiger furs, and I shall reward you. You can find them on the islands south of here.
text.94885: The log is full of meticulous recordings on the comings and goings of Twilight's Hammer forces throughout the Riverglades. The author is nowhere to be found, but this information could help shed light on enemy movements. Someone in Farholde will want to see this.
text.98887: The Theramore Expeditionary Force are tenacious and continue to send reinforcements to bolster their position on the Darkspear Islands. Go, show them the might of the Horde! Bring me the evidence of your victory in this key battleground and you will be well rewarded.
text.86670: To the Caverns of Time you go, Lord <name>. Anachronos awaits your return. Give him the eye of C'Thun as he will undoubtedly wish to place it in his master's collection.
text.8995: All is now ready, <name>. When alive, Lord Valthalak used to inhabit what is now The Beast's chamber. Go there and use the Brazier of Beckoning to summon forth Lord Valthalak. It will reincorporate him, so he'll have to be killed again. I'd take care of The Beast first, and be sure take enough friends along to survive the upper portion of Blackrock Spire. Once you've dispatched Valthalak, use the amulet on his corpse. With his spirit reunified, he'll likely want his amulet back, as well. Good luck!
text.102: Stormwind has abandoned us. A foul wind of depravity rustles through the plains of Westfall. This was my homeland and I will not turn my back on the citizens who choose to remain here. We, the former farmers, shall make our stand. Your task, should you choose to accept, is to patrol the grasslands of Westfall. Track down and slay the vile Gnolls that seem to be working in conjunction with the Deadmines thieves. Bring me eight Gnoll Paws and I will reward your bravery.
text.137: If you earn a commendation from one of our Marshals, then bring it to me. It will be good for one of our Lion Emblem gloves.
text.124: As if the attacking orcs weren't enough! Now I have gnoll brutes and mystics prowling along the ridge north of my stable, taking my horses when they stray... If you can get rid of those gnolls, my horses and I would be very grateful.
text.94230: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Explosive Sheep, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.8969: Now we have what we need, so it's time to discuss who it is that you'll be summoning. Kormok was ok for an ogre, right up until he turned to necromancy. After that, things got creepy for just about everyone in the outfit. It was no surprise then when he took his piece of the amulet and returned to his new home, Scholomance. But even there, or perhaps especially there, he was not safe from the spectral assassins. They slew him right in front of his master, Ras Frostwhisper.
text.759: There is but one water well left to cleanse, named after the Wildmane clan. For this well to be pure, the land must offer the teeth of a fierce predator, the prairie wolf alpha. Find the alphas to the north, then return to me when your hunt is finished. Alphas often wander around the base of our mighty city, Thunder Bluff.
text.947: I am devising a potion that requires rare mushrooms, mushrooms that grow only in a certain cave. The cave lies behind Cliffspring Falls, to the east and slightly north along the mountains. I would go there myself, but I was advised by the Grove of the Ancients to stay away from that place. Our venerable allies sense that the cave is the hiding place for a new evil in Darkshore. Please, <name>, gather the mushrooms for me. And while doing so, scout the cave to confirm the Ancients' fears.
text.118: I've been using so much iron keeping the Stormwind Guards outfitted, I don't have enough to supply the stable's horses with shoes! Take this note to Blacksmith Argus in Goldshire. It explains to him my problem and requests a shipment of horseshoes.
text.984: Some of my brethren were rescued from a corrupt furbolg in Teldrassil, and I've vowed to stop any more atrocities before more of our kind are injured... or worse. I have seen a couple hints of corruption in Darkshore already, but I have yet to find any widespread signs. I think it would be logical if the investigation continued with the furbolgs. Would you find one of their camps, and return to me if you see any signs of corruption?
text.98462: Back for more, eh? You know the drill! Bring me some Chillwind Chimaera Fur and Winterspring Owl Feathers, and I'll use the ingredients to mix up a shrouding potion that'll help to conceal you from the eyes of the creatures living around here.
text.99015: The ruin known as Dire Maul is a solemn tomb. Countless kaldorei souls have died to pay the balance of a grim bargain struck with an unthinking, uncaring evil. All in the name of maintaining the splendor and immortality of a privileged few. Go there and slay the beast known as Immol'thar that lies at the center of the western wing of the city. Bring me a phial of its cursed blood and break the cycle of death in that haunted place. Then I will cleanse the artifact you carry.
text.162: I urge you to take this report to someone who has working knowledge in this kind of thing. I know this night elf scholar named Gracina Spiritmight. She's spent a lot of time studying life forms that are unique to the ecology of Azeroth; she's a historian to boot! If you want someone to help figure out what exactly this threat is, and more importantly how to stop it, give her the report. We'll need the help. Last I heard, she was residing in the Temple of the Moon, located in Darnassus.
text.88722: Greetings, friend. Have you insignias of the Dawn or the Crusade that you would like to redeem for items of power? I must warn you; purchases made at honored reputation with the Dawn come with a fairly prohibitive surcharge. I would advise that you gain a better reputation with the Dawn before moving forward with your plans.
text.98252: Show my Eye of Kilrogg the way out of this ravine and back to the Ashenvale road. Keep it moving and I'll follow once I see a clear path. I'll stay here--one of us should keep our bearings. If you lose the way, I can guide you back through the eye. I will not have us both wandering blind in this malicious forest. I can hold the channel for four minutes. No longer. Reach the road before the vision breaks, or return to me and we try again.
text.93197: With all of the fighting and the retreat from the Nordrassil Lodge, we've been terribly shorthanded out here. If you are traveling back and forth between here and Everlook, I have some mail that needs to go to the town for distribution, and we need any waiting mail brought back up. I have a stack of parcels ready for transport, if you would be so good as to help.
text.5882: Possessing a Cenarion beacon allows one to see a corrupted soul shard on those tainted beasts that are put down for the greater good. I grind shards into a usable reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve. We will use that salve to turn corrupted plants into healthy ones again. In exchange for these shards, I will give you some Cenarion plant salves I have already prepared.
text.3509: There is only one way to harm the demon lord and his minions. A weapon of power must be forged bearing his true name. When such a weapon is forged, the demon and all under his command are vulnerable. A lesser deity resides in Azshara: Lord Arkkoroc. You must seek him out but be warned, his minions will stop at nothing to destroy you if you are discovered. Undoubtedly, you will have to pay a price for such information.
text.84203: A truly amazing story, <name>! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past. As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
text.94999: Oh! Sorry, I didn't see you there. I was just putting together a little something for a friend of mine. Well... more of an acquaintance, really. Have you met Watcher Fredericks yet? He's stationed at Southern Watch just west of here. He comes by the ranch on patrol every now and then. I thought it would be nice to give him a little something to show my appreciation. I'd deliver it myself, but I need to keep an eye on my little brother and tend to the ranch. I'm sure you understand.
text.7837: Greetings once again, <name>! Our need for runecloth is constant, and we can always use additional resources if you are willing to part with them. For an additional stack of twenty runecloth, I will make sure that you are recognized for your continuing efforts on behalf of the Darkspear Trolls. Whenever you are ready to hand in the stack of runecloth, I'll accept it.
text.8169: As you no doubt have heard, the League of Arathor is sending large numbers of troops into Arathi Basin. Eager for food and supplies, these Alliance fools are intent to take and control the rich resources there. We must show them that Arathi will never again be a home for humans! Go to Arathi Basin and assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the stables. Pull down the enemies' banners, declaring those territories for the Horde. Go, <name>. Report back to me when this task is complete.
text.8625: It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon. Bring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
text.9188: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order. Work Order TR-95: 6 Brightcloth Pants. All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged. -Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
