text.84158: Hail, {class}! I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world. Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this. Perform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers. I'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus. Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
text.96260: Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me. One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study. Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
text.908: The Twilight's Hammer has moved into the Moonshrine Ruins of Blackfathom Deeps. Their presence can only serve to coerce the elements into working against us. If left unchecked, this region will be theirs for good. <name>, go into Blackfathom and find the ruin's fathom stone; it should be somewhere close in the water. In it is a fathom core - a device that when properly read it will relate a history of all elemental activity. If I have it, I and the Earthen Ring can maybe do something to stop them!
text.894: The Venture Company set up a small research facility far to the north of here, southwest of the Sludge Fen. I don't know very much about what they're doing, but did manage to discover that they're experimenting with something called a "samophlange". Now what the heck is a samophlange? Well, whatever it is, I want to examine it, so I need someone to go get it. I obtained a copy of their control system operating manual, you should be able to figure out how to disengage the samophlange from it.
text.3123: This will be a test; both of the ritual I performed, and of your abilities. Take this vessel, <name>. With it, you will have the power to shrink and capture a creature inside of it. Travel to the Hinterlands and look for creatures known as Wildkin that were once pets of the night elf goddess Elune. The vicious, primitive, or savage owlbeasts are your targets, <name>. Kill 10, and use the muisek vessel to shrink and capture them before their spirits can escape.
text.8302: Choose your deputies wisely, mortal. Each time you return with your task complete, a new deputy you will be allowed to choose. With that said, I require more of the carapace fragments. Waste no time!
text.927: The heart of Blackmoss the Fetid is covered with a dark, oily moss. In fact, the only way to tell this is a heart is from its slow, rhythmic beat... A beat that continues even now. Perhaps Denalan will want to see this heart.
text.79363: A sword left by the spirit of Raven Hill's guard, Silvia Valor, who lived her life protecting civilians and their homes. With Silvia's spirit still visiting farmsteads, perhaps her unfinished business was to route the defias who have taken up residence in Addle's Stead south of Raven Hill.
text.4109: If you possess a Cenarion beacon while mining in Felwood, you will be able to see tainted vitriol that corrupts a vein of raw metal. I know how to purify that vitriol and turn it into a reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve. You will then use that salve on plants you find in the wild that need saving. If you have collected any tainted vitriol, I'll give you some Cenarion plant salve I have already prepared.
text.95273: Now that we know Deadwood don't foul the water outright with their presence, we can take this sample and cast our wards with sound will. We've heard there is a pool of the mountain's tears within their den. Travel with force and pour this water into the pool deep in Deadwood Den. Return to us when you have learned what secrets the dark depths hold.
text.3371: There is an empty, vacuous hole, where my heart used to be, <name>. The loss of Dorius is not one that I will soon recover from. I must see his final wish through - the perpetrators of this cold blooded murder must be brought to justice. Return to the Searing Gorge and fulfill his last request: Free his men.
text.93609: <The necklace you have been seeking is at last in your possession, but unfortunately the magic contained within has been entirely depleted. While not ideal for your current situation, at least it made its acquisition from the quilboar relatively easy. It is probably best to bring this back to Mithera.>
text.92859: Folks have been trying to get onto Mount Hyjal since the end of the war, but there's one big problem... all the demons in Darkwhisper Gorge! I think I have the solution. A concoction made from locally-sourced ingredients might be able to make the drinker blend in with the Winterspring surroundings so that creatures here can't see you as easily. I'd love to test this theory, if you're game for bringing me a few small things!
text.683: <name>, I have but a small request to ask of you. Take this note I have prepared to our great monarch of Ironforge, King Magni Bronzebeard. 'Tis a small task to ask of one such as yourself, someone who has shown great valor to the cause of the Alliance thus far. For me to go before the King in my grief-ridden state would not serve the purpose of my cause. Surely you understand.
text.4661: You take a sample of slime from Felwood and place some of it into the various tubes and beakers on the table. As things begin to boil and spurt, the slime changes colors. When the process slows down and the liquids calm, you see a small petri dish with your altered Felwood slime samples in it along with some other remnants.
text.411: Take this Nether Gem to my old comrade Bethor. It will let us communicate ... and I have much to tell him.
text.764: This explains the buildup of Venture Co. employees and equipment we've seen in Mulgore. Those goblins... their company is expanding too quickly for their own good. It's how they say, show a goblin something, and you can hear the scales in the background. Greedy little things, they are. Unfortunately for their business enterprise, we tauren cannot allow them to conduct their operations in our lands. Go to their mine northeast of the ravaged caravan and send them a message.
text.2995: The Quel'Danil Lodge is a center of communication for the high elves of the Hinterlands. Their ambassadors are working to establish relationships with other races, with whom they share their knowledge of the Witherbark trolls that inhabit the area in the southern Hinterlands. All of the documents regarding the communications are kept at the lodge. We don't need the Highvale building alliances with others, <name>. Destroy the Highvale documents. We need to burn their lines of communication... literally.
text.86968: Really can't thank you enough for the help back there. You really saved my bacon. I've been chatting with this nice young woman while waiting for you and I think she might have some ideas to help you get into that forsaken crypt, if you really do insist on pushing your luck. I'm getting ahead of myself. though. I believe I owe you some information.
text.82097: My memories are cloudy, but I will tell you what I can. The circle of statues in the Sunken Temple, while dangerous, I believe that they hold the secret to unlock an even greater treasure. From the main altar, I was able to activate a series of lights. I think that if you can uncover what these lights mean, you might be able to unlock whatever secrets are hiding in this room. I warn you though, <name>. Great evil lies in the temple. It's likely that anything valuable will be fervently guarded...
text.7877: In the library, Athenaeum, you will find an ancient chest hidden beneath the stairway. Take from it that which you desire.
text.4290: Once, a long time ago, a brother of mine took some meat from one of Lar'korwi's kills. He didn't know it at the time, but Lar'korwi saw him from the forest. Lar'korwi followed my brother for days, destroying everything he touched. My brother, scared, finally decided to run from the Crater and leave Lar'korwi behind. Lar'korwi killed him not far from this spot. If you want to provoke Lar'korwi, find a fresh kill of his and take some of the meat from it. Return to me afterwards.
text.761: The swoop is a cunning bird, and difficult to find and hunt. A collection of Swoop Quills is a badge of cleverness and determination for a hunter. If you are willing to take up this task, then enter the plains and hunt the swoop. Bring me their quills, and bring honor to your clan. The swoops may be found anywhere in Mulgore, but your eyes must be sharp to spot them, and your hooves must be quick to catch them.
text.8573: The badges you collect from performing combat, logistics and tactical assignments for Cenarion Hold are more than just for show, <name>. You'd be wise to hold on to them. As you prove your loyalty to our organization I can offer you some of the gear we reserve for our closest allies in exchange for those badges.
text.7833: We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth. A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Darkspear Trolls for your generous actions. Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive. If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
text.7905: The Darkmoon Faire is coming! Be sure to experience all the wonders and excitement of it when it comes to town! If you act right now, you can redeem this voucher for free prize tickets! Just hand your voucher to Gelvas Grimgate located inside the carnival. Right now, the Faire is outside Goldshire, in the Elwynn Forest. Don't miss out! Go today!
text.93773: It seems that Ve'han has successfully stolen at least a portion of the power of a Wild God. Such a thing seems beyond belief to me, but here we are. And what is this "Pact" Ve'han spoke of? <name>, you must return to Ketharas. Tell him what you've learned. I'm sorry to say but it is likely well beyond your abilities to put a foe such as Ve'han down. Only the power of--well, the Wild Gods themselves may be able to counteract this magic.
text.9228: Greetings, friend. Have you insignias of the Dawn or the Crusade that you would like to redeem for items of great power? Those exalted amongst the Dawn receive our greatest discounts! I encourage you to make a purchase.
text.87517: It seems that the beast that attacked light's hope is Caldoran's pet and the attack on Light's Hope was merely a ruse to draw our forces out and commit us to this attack. Caldoran and Beatrix sought to use us to create a distraction and remove a rival in Balnazzar, and then turn on us and remove us as a presence in the Plaguelands after they regained control. We don't have all of the answers and it's looking grim, but we will put these dogs down for this treachery.
text.1389: The lost ones who live in the Fallow Sanctuary look as we look, but they are monsters... driven mad by the rigors of our journey to Azeroth. Once our brethren, they now live in the Fallow Sanctuary to the east, catching or killing any who wander near. And they have stolen something sacred to us--draenethyst crystals. We lack the force to enter the Fallow Sanctuary and reclaim our stolen draenethyst from among their huts and campfires, but without those crystals... we too may lose our way.
text.96256: So I be hearin' you and a lucky few got a guest invitation to the city of mages, Dalaran! This be quite the honor. Every encounter I be havin' with Kirin Tor ended with me regrowin' a body part, so it not be every day that a member of the Horde get a chance to see the magical city without risking painful death! As it happen, I be needin' something that can only be found there. A book, written by an old friend--a dwarf named Olvek. It be a small thing, but if you can get it for me, I be grateful.
text.96918: I think we've got a regular virtuoso of violence in you, buddy. I'd like to see a bit more of your tenacity though, this week.
text.7788: Beyond this tunnel you will find a field of strife and turmoil, young {class}. The Horde continue to decimate our sacred forest, cutting down the evergreen foliage to power their machines of war. Enter Warsong Gulch and defend Silverwing Hold. Push back the invading Horde forces! Do this, and earn a talisman of merit. Bring me such a talisman, <name>, and I shall reward you.
text.99033: In the ruins of Dire Maul lies the seat of the king of the Gordok ogres. This warlord has plundered most of the riches of the fallen kingdom of the kaldorei, including the crown jewels of the ruling house of ancient Eldre'Thalas. I require these gems and you will retrieve them for me. These riches will be well hidden, so you may need to use guile to not only defeat the king, but earn the tribute of his followers. Return the jewels to me and I will purify the corrupted leg armor you carry.
text.6605: I just got back from Felwood, <name>. On my way through, I stopped at Bloodvenom Post and I met a very odd character... She seemed intent on one thing, and I suppose I could tell you what that is, but I think she'd like to explain it to you herself. If you're interested, head to Bloodvenom Post in western Felwood and look for Winna Hazzard. Who knows, she might need your help...
text.590: What? What?! You want money? I don't owe you any money. Letter? What letter? Oh, you wanna fight then? All right, mate... let's do this! Owe you any money...
text.4723: The remains of a giant thresher - much larger than one you'd expect to find in Darkshore - lie beached on the coast of the Mist's Edge. How this creature came to be here is unknown; the group of murlocs that now feast off the carcass of it seem to be much too weak, even in large numbers, to have brought down the beast. While some of it has been picked clean, enough of it remains to take a sample for Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde in Auberdine to study.
text.1239: Vigorous digging reveals the head of a male orc, raggedly severed at the neck. His lips are frozen in a snarl, and its dark eyes stare defiantly.
text.398: Wanted: Maggot Eye! A foul beast, even by Gnoll standards, Maggot Eye has been sentenced to death for his crimes against The Forsaken. This despicable villain has been stealing corpses for use by the Lich King's army. Maggot Eye was last seen pillaging the lands near Garren's Haunt to the north of Brill. The town of Brill hereby offers a reward to the capable soul who can carry out the execution. Show Executor Zygand the villain's paw once the deed is done. Mercy is for the weak.
text.5742: You have worked hard, friend. Rest your weary bones and allow me to properly introduce myself.
text.110: I'm going to spend some time taking a look at Scrimshank's surveying gear... as well as putting his personal effects in order. I get the sneaking feeling behind my ears that this isn't the last loss we'll be facing against these bugs. I'd like for you to check in with Alchemist Pestlezugg to see if he has had a chance to process the insect parts we sent him. If they're ready, bring them to me.
text.385: Many a hunter is attracted to Loch Modan to hunt our famous crocs. There are always merchants who seek out crocolisk skins for clothing items or armor, and there are also some who enjoy the taste of their meat. We do some trade in this, but not a huge amount, as the crocolisks are ferocious and have entrenched themselves on the islands in the Loch. But don't let me dissuade you, it's quite an experience, wrestling with the jaws of the beasts. Why, this one time...
text.9237: Thanks to you and Omarion, may he rest in peace, I am now able to create a Glacial cloak. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
text.4742: As you can see, the unadorned seal has three empty sockets. Each of those sockets must be filled with a gemstone representing the leadership's command. Finally, Overlord Wyrmthalak, master of the lower citadel, must forge the seal in the flames of the Black Dragonflight. Understand this, mortal: the chance that one of the three generals of the lower citadel would carry a gemstone at any given time is rare. You must be vigilant in your quest. Remain determined!
text.1109: As you can see, <name>, we're up to some very.... interesting experiments at the Royal Apothecary Society. As the Master here, it is my job to oversee the most ambitious of our alchemical attempts. So much work and so little time! You look well traveled for a {class}. Perhaps you can aid me. I'm in need of a rare substance. It's foul material; it comes from a rare species of bats only found in the muck-hole known as Razorfen Kraul. Bring to me the guano from the Kraul Bats so we can begin our work...
text.82009: Can you hear the explosions on the racetrack? No seriously, can you? Most of my hearing is gone. Anyways... Magnets! By carefully placing magnets all along the racetrack and adding the reverse polarity to the bottom of our vehicle, we shall simply float above the mines! Take that Goblins! The last piece of the puzzle, we need something that can hold an electrical charge to manage the complicated electrical paneling. Head to Southwest Un'Goro and bring me a Thunderstomp Stegodon Horn!
text.9101: As a Watcher, I was allowed access to many of Medivh's personal effects. Among those items, I found the tomes most enlightening. While the majority of the books were filled with - to put it bluntly - tripe, there were some gems. One of those tomes documented the creation of a set of armor fit for an archmage: Frostfire. <Angela points to her head.> It's all in here and I am willing to share the fruits of that knowledge with you as long as you are able to provide me with the necessary materials.
text.923: There is a malevolence growing in the timberlings. We are trying to find the source, but until we do...in order to keep Teldrassil safe we must cut down the timberlings who are beyond help. Those that wander Wellspring Lake in northern Teldrassil are the most tainted. They must be removed! Destroy the Timberlings you find there, and gather the mossy tumors growing upon them. Bring the tumors to me so that they may be burned.
text.94307: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Shadoweave Robe, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.937: I was dispatched with a small group of Sentinels here to protect the Oracle Tree from the harpies that have made nests all around the glade. Little by little we are trying to push them back. When the Oracle Tree attempted to send a runner to Darnassus with a report, the messenger was attacked and killed by a group of the harpies. If you feel up to the task, go to their nests, slay them, and return their belts to me as proof of your deeds.
text.9049: You will find the remnants of our fallen heroes on the corpses of the Lords of Naxxramas. Bring those desecrated keepsakes to me along with wartorn plate scraps and crafting materials capable of revitalizing the cursed armor and I shall craft a fine piece of armor for you.
text.956: If the grells have come into close contact with the seal that binds my eternal prison, I suspect I know the cause. No doubt the seal has come into the possession of the satyr that lead them. I feel strongly that this must be true, <name>. One of the satyr must surely possess it. If you can obtain it, you would bring me so close to passing the bars of my prison that tears would come to my eyes.
text.823: We at Sen'jin Village are not without our own troubles, and we thank you for your aid. But the news you bring regarding the Burning Blade could be trouble for everyone. There is an orc stationed at Razor Hill, Orgnil Soulscar, who polices Durotar from evils such as the Burning Blade! Go to Orgnil and tell him of our plight, as well as your news from the Valley of Trials. He will want to know these things. Razor Hill lies to the north.
text.2950: No, no, no - I'm not all of the sudden saying that the ring is mine. I normally don't do this, but your information about the Dark Irons was very useful. I'll improve your ring for you, better than whomever made this simple little thing could have ever done. Probably some gnome... If you bring me a bar of silver, a moss agate, and thirty silver coins for my trouble, I'll add a silver and agate lattice to the ring that will strengthen the magic inside of it. Interested?
text.98918: It's not enough to merely win against the Horde, {class}. Our victory must be decisive. Return to Darkspear Islands and achieve victory there while controlling at least three outposts. For the Alliance!
text.289: <Bolstered, Fitzsimmons continues his tale...> I am the sole survivor of the ill-fated Third Fleet of Kul Tiras, wrecked off the coast to the north. But although I'm the only member of the fleet still breathing, I'm not the only one still walking about! For on one of our ships was hidden a great, and terrible treasure, and the eerie power of it keeps the souls of my brothers trapped within the ships' rotting hulls. But if you can free some of my brothers, then perhaps you can break their curse.
text.5056: In northern Winterspring, great cats assemble around a large landmark called Frostsaber Rock. The leader of these cats is known by the name Shy-Rotam. Defeating the matriarch of the frostsabers would grant you much respect in the eyes of your fellow {race}. Go again to the harsh wilds, and once there, gather sacred meat from the frostsabers. Find the stone of Shy-Rotam, and place it there. Placing the meat of her kin before her will summon Shy-Rotam, in anger. Be ready for her fury, and defeat her.
text.94302: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Turtle Scale Breastplate, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.8469: You've certainly earned my trust, <name>, but you may need to continue to earn the trust of my untrusting tribe. There is something you can do to earn that trust. The Winterfall are known to carry spirit beads to ward against foul spirits. These beads have clearly failed in their purpose, as the Winterfall themselves are the agents of corruption. Bring to me these spirit beads from fallen Winterfall furbolgs; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.
text.5847: Welcome to the World of Warcraft! As special thanks for purchasing the World of Warcraft Collector's Edition, turn in this gift voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell. You'll then be given a gift: a little companion to join you on your quest for adventure and glory. Thanks again, and enjoy your stay in the World of Warcraft!
text.1024: You'll have to do the research yourself, but from what notes Teronis has made, it sounds like your next course of action is to find the other pieces of the rod Dartol created. I would start by heading to the moonwell east of Iris Lake. When you're ready, follow the road and turn north when you reach a small sitting area on your left. A dryad there named Shael'dryn is better suited to guide you. Seek her out. Keep the gem with you--Shael'dryn will need it if she's to help you recreate the rod.
text.8655: Qiraji magic is strong and ancient. The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon. Bring me the qiraji bindings of dominance and other minor components and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you. You will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
text.87502: I am not pleased to engage you for aid. You consort with the heretic and the unclean and it is beneath me and our sacred order to entertain your presence here. However... you seem adequately capable and will prove to be a useful instrument here for our needs. Go to Tyr's Hand and scout the cathedral there before moving deeper into New Avalon to scout the rear keep and mage tower. Return here without delay and report what you find. We need to know what we are up against.
text.8997: I suppose that this is goodbye then, my friend. But, I'll always be here if you want to come back and talk with me from time to time. Probably while you're loitering around waiting for your buddies to join you for a raid on Blackrock Spire. Go, before I start to cry. Go back to Deliana in Ironforge and tell her what's happened.
text.362: Devlin Agamand was the younger of two sons in the Agamand family, and in life the two could not be more different. Thurman was tall and gentle while his younger brother was weak and sharp tongued. When Agamand Mills fell to the Plague, I was not surprised to hear that Devlin was quick to succumb. His mad chattering can still be heard near the road leading to the Agamand Mills. I'm collecting the remains of the Agamands, and I want poor Devlin. Find him, destroy him, and bring me his bones.
text.1514: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a windblossom plant. The berries that hang from the plant appear rotten and poisonous. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
text.3782: With what we call an Evergreen Pouch, we have cultivated Tharlendris seeds in the soil from Un'Goro Crater. These seeds have blossomed into an array of random, potent herbs. One result is morrowgrain, a mysterious herb we know little about; I very much hope to unravel this mystery for the Circle. Take this voucher over to my daughter Bashana, and she will give you some seeds so you may assist us. If you run out, you will need to purchase more from her.
text.52: Hail, <name>. Wild animals are growing more and more aggressive the farther we get from Goldshire, and the Eastvale Logging Camp suffers nearly constant attacks from wolves and bears! We could use your help out here.
text.3201: I can't believe Pebblebitty doubted the authenticity of the horn. Between you and me, I think she's just jealous. I know she really wanted to kill that beast herself, what with the 'incident' and all. So you need a proof of deed? After the contribution you just made to the museum, it won't be a problem. <Curator Thorius begins to fill out a large document.> There we go! You can take that back to Pebblebitty.
text.95776: You have done well to slay the naga just off of our coast, but the fact that they are in our waters in such numbers means there is yet a larger threat. I have spoken to Kin'weelay, and he thinks these Brinescale naga are infiltrating the ruins of the Drowned City. If the naga are there, then they are up to no good and are likely searching for something. We can't let them get their hands on anything that could compromise us here and it is time to put an end to this. Slay their leader and return to me.
text.391: Let's get one thing straight, <name>: I don't trust you. But, with the situation as it is, you probably won't make a difference. So here's how it's going to be: go down there and have your talk with Thredd. If you're really on our side, then kill him and bring me his head when the job's done. And if it turns out you're on his side, and don't come out... when we find you, you'll die along with the rest of the maggots.
text.77: I possess original packaging materials for the ripple Dran Droffers seeks. I will assist you in packaging the ripple for Malton's abrasive father... for a fee of two additional bottles of said ripple. They are located in crates found in the abandoned Horde base near Skulk Rock. It will be an arduous task, to wit; foul slimes and oozes will be found sticking to the ruins; rumor has it they are led by some sort of master ooze. Regardless, procure the ripple and return to me here for packaging.
text.5383: You open the bag to discover various instruments of torture. Amidst the paraphernalia, an odd object catches your eye: A vial of blood - still warm to the touch. You think that the Sarkhoff's might be interested in your discovery.
text.6143: Maybe you heard or maybe you haven't... my crew and I was out fishing near Ranazjar Isle, north of the wrecked ship off the coast up north. We used to fish there all the time; now all I do is think of a way to seek revenge for my fallen comrades. The naga attacked us one morning, killing everyone except me. Me conscience can't handle the guilt, {class}; I need you to go and fry them naga for me. I'll make the effort worth your while; you think you can help me with that?
text.8711: The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong. Just the sight of Qiraji artifacts fills me with an urge to practice my craft with their shattered and smelted pieces. Prove your allegiance to the Circle, <name>, and I will make you a powerful weapon from the finest Qiraji materials.
text.8538: The links between the Twilight's Hammer and the Abyssal Council are proving to be more important than we had expected. We believe the elemental nobles known as the Abyssal Dukes are one of the primary force organizing the Twilight's Hammer cultists. Find a way to lure the four Abyssal Dukes into our plane of existence and destroy them! Your dedication and prowess in past assignments have led us to choose you for this particular assignment. We are certain you will succeed in this endeavor.
text.92597: Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from leylines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these leylines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies. Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a leyline there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.
text.93065: The Peacekeepers are mobilizing and we are all gearing up to head out. Make whatever preparations you need to make and meet us at the eastern road leading north out of town. We'll have one final check-in with everyone before we move out.
text.8599: It isn't often that I get visitors. As a matter of fact, the last time I had a visitor was when I rescued that dear, sweet gnome from the wreckage of the crashed flying machine. <Meridith gazes into nothingness, lost in a memory.> Do you know him? Narain? Narain Soothfancy? Oh it would mean so much to me if somebody would deliver a message to him for me. I must tell him how I feel! I know it's love! I just know it! Could you possibly deliver a message to Narain? I would be forever indebted to you!
text.4462: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a night dragon plant. The fruits that hang from the plant appear rotten and poisonous. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
text.98824: With titan-like inscriptions like that on its facets, nothing less than Ironforge's Hall of Explorers is the right place to bring it. I'd like to think that you'll be noted in the history for it in the catalogue -- "Recovered by <name>! Authenticated by Prospector Whelgar..." Ah, I'm gettin' meself carried away. High Explorer Magellas will receive you, and given the exquisite nature of what you carry, will surely be most generously appreciative should you donate it to the museum. Good find!
text.93689: This is excellent news! With Dalaran returned to peace, I can see no reason the Kirin Tor would not welcome you with open arms! Please, report to the council with great haste. I'm sure they will be looking forward to meeting the city's savior.
text.98981: You wade through toil and torment in search of riches and glory, ever pushing onward and upward. The weight of such an existence weighs heavily on all of us who choose this life. Should we not unburden our enemies of that which weighs heavily on their shoulders? In the city Stratholme reside two great, but opposing evils. Bring me the mantle of the false crusader, Dathrohan in his great bastion, and the pauldron of the one called Rivendare in his slaughterhouse sanctuary.
text.3528: Now it is time to capture the essence of the avatar of Hakkar. Take the Egg of Hakkar to the Sanctum of the Fallen God in the Sunken Temple in Azeroth. Invoke the egg's power to stir the dead god. He will send his minions against you. Defeat his bloodrinkers and take their Hakkari blood, then use the blood to dowse the eternal flames that hold Hakkar's spirit. When all the flames go out, the avatar of Hakkar will enter our world. Defeat him, and place his essence within the egg of Hakkar.
text.8917: Hail, {class}! I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world. Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this. Perform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers. I'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus. Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
text.523: The contract you recovered was signed by Baron Vardus, a noble of the former kingdom of Alterac, and one known for a cold heart and brutal practices. I'm not surprised someone like the Baron was behind this. Find this man. Find him, and bring him to justice. He must be among the Syndicate haunts - perhaps at the ruins of Strahnbrad, or perhaps within the valley north of them.
text.1267: Hello, <name>. Tervosh has explained to me much of your quest. When it was brought to my attention that you were seeking one of the men directly responsible for the missing diplomat, well, we were forced to find you to ensure he was dealt with quickly.
text.434: After I put on Spybot's disguise, he'll head in to talk to Lescovar. The guards should let him pass no problem. While you were getting materials for me, I took care of informing Marzon that it was time for him and Lescovar to meet again. I even dropped some false information. Lescovar will dismiss his guards and wait for Marzon out here in the garden. After you catch wind of talk about the Defias, make your move. You need to kill them both before the guards return! When you're done, speak to Trias.
text.2582: Ah, <name>, welcome back. It seems you enjoyed the effect of the robust, operational imbue, derived from snickerfang. Be warned, while the immediate effect is a titanic burst of strength, the long term effects on your spirit and intelligence could be hazardous. With that said, do you require more? If so, bring me another three snickerfang jowls, two blasted boar lungs, and one scorpok pincer.
text.7790: A grisly scene, these two elves appear to have died locked in combat to the end. What could have brought such viciousness to their normally reserved demeanor? Their bags and equipment are strewn along the shore. Was it a deal gone bad? A rival's ambush? Search the source of the river for clues to the demise that was washed downstream.
text.85630: Mages in our tribe are known as illusionists. They employ powerful mojo in their incantations, often befuddling and confusing the tribe's enemies! <Al'tabim laughs wickedly.> It is quite the sight to see a powerful illusionist at work, bringing our enemies to their knees from their own madness! For you to know the way of our illusionists, go to Zul'Gurub and bring back to me selected Paragons of Power. For this, I will give you arm wraps our illusionists use to weave their spells.
text.84154: Well met, {class}. I've something that might interest you. I have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor. The blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment. Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. You shall find the effort worth your while.
text.9232: You fancy yourself a hero of the Dawn, eh? I've seen our greatest soldiers get rolled over by Kel'Thuzad's plebes! How well could someone so clueless possibly fare in Naxxramas? <Wilhelm sighs.> Bah, what choice do I got? You're the best I can do; I may as well help you. Omarion left me with one recipe. It's the only song I know... I can make a few variations of these pants; you just gotta supply the materials.
text.92700: Now that you've arrived in Valanaar, you'll likely want to check in with the other members of the Windshapers here. The current Grand Skyseer and her people operate out of the lodge near the center of Valanaar. You should also be aware, the Windshapers and High Order don't get along very well in these parts. Be careful and give the High Order a good, wide berth. We've got enough to worry about with the cult, I won't tolerate faction violence in the streets of Valanaar.
text.1265: Hendel? Yes, I know the man. But why would you need one of my soldiers? Elling sent you to find him? Hmm, I don't like the sound of that. Elling wouldn't have you come to me first if your business wasn't troubling. I understand if you can't tell me what this is about, but know this: I have a duty to protect these lands. If you're going to cause a disturbance, then I suggest you inform me of whatever you can. I believe Hendel was stationed at the first tower outside of Theramore. Be cautious.
text.91753: Academic rigor is of course essential to the enchanter's craft, but a practical foundation can pay dividends. Consider, as an example, the lowly Kobold. Lacking formal education, they nevertheless demonstrate a sort of innate aptitude for simple cantrips and enchantments. Obtain some of their wax effigies and deconstruct the enchantments bound within them. You may find it elucidating.
text.9243: Thanks to you and Omarion, may he rest in peace, I am now able to create a Polar tunic. All you need to do is bring me the materials and pay a small crafting fee.
text.66281: You open the aged and weathered tome and discover text detailing a necromantic ritual. Perhaps Archmage Tarsis would be interested in having this information.
text.92466: While we owe much of our prosperity to the elements of wind, the path we walk requires that we obey the call of all four of the primary elements and undertake a trial for each. Before you begin your first trial in earnest however, you must prove the strength of your resolve. Travel to the standing stones to the east. A force of Al'Aketh converts has been spotted there and they must be driven off. Confront the cultists there and bring me one of their signets as proof of your deeds.
text.84384: De loa have told me of a poison gatherin' strength in Ashenvale, on the tainted land where the great demon Mannoroth was slain. Someone be drawin' power from the pit lord's remains. They must be usin' illusions to hide their rituals. If you are to stop them, you'll be needin' protectin from their deceptions. My tribe uses an extract from owlbeast glands in an enchantment to discern truth from lies. Collect these glands from the owlbeasts in Winterspring.
text.6805: We, the elementals of water, wage war with those beings of the lesser elements. If you are truly our ally in this conflict, then show me your conviction! Far to the south, in the desert land of Silithus, the servants of air and earth scurry in a corner of rock named the Crystal Vale. They protect items of power from smaller beings, mortals, and although I do not know why they do this, I wish to foil their efforts. Go to the Crystal Vale in Silithus and defeat our enemies, then return to me.
text.94532: Though the gnoll presence has dwindled with the Twilight's encroachment, the threat remains. The hills to the southwest are infested with their kind, disrupting trades and travelers alike. Clear a path for our allies by removing the threat.
text.95805: The sun and the moon, An'she and Mu'sha, are not part of our world like the elements, yet their light gives us life, guidance, and hope. We pay respect to the spirits of the world, and so we pay respect to the twins as well. If you would show your respect, take this smoldering incense and bring it to a shrine in the hills to the southeast, overlooking the mesa, south of the quilboar. Be quick, so that you can reach the shrine before the incense burns away. Don't get it wet!
text.8740: Bands of mounted Twilight's Hammer cultists have been spotted riding outside the reach of our forces in Cenarion Hold, picking off our smaller patrols and caravans. Find and defeat the twilight marauders along with their leader, a terrible warrior by the name of Morna. Report to Windcaller Proudhorn after completing the task.
text.95494: I need someone with a strong sword arm and some extra time on their hands to help me gather some lion hides. It stings my pride to ask a stranger for this aid, but I took an injury to my leg recently. Until I heal, I'm in no shape to go hunting myself but I have obligations to keep. The big ones in this area generally have the best hides, so start with those first.
text.79704: Insert your salvage into the machine, get fabulous prizes! Probably. Maybe.
text.7734: I have a lead on an even BETTER source of hides, if that's even possible to believe! In the northern parts of Feralas - deep within Rage Scar Hold - are another throng of yetis. They're much tougher than the ones you dealt with before, so if you're up for a bigger challenge you'd best be on your toes! I would reward you handsomely for a stack of ten of their hides; bring them to me here, and we'll finish our business.
text.92591: We've tried to escape the mountain, but our attempts have always been thwarted by the Scourge. A powerful lich reanimates the remains of those we destroy and sends them against us again. So long as that lich endures, we'll never be safe. The lich has a pile of bones from which it rebuilds skeletons. Take this torch and set fire to the bone pile in the ruins. The lich will be sure to respond. Bring me its amulet, so that we may destroy it and be rid of the lich for good.
text.4401: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a songflower plant. A pungent, unhealthy odor emanates from the plant. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
text.78917: The dread beast Aku'mai lies dead. Hidden amongst the viscera and gore of its swollen corpse is an enormous iridescent pearl teeming with raw Void energy.
text.4508: My recent findings and the knowledge we have gained here today needs to reach hands that can quite possibly do something with it. As resourceful as we are here in Gadgetzan, we can't do this alone. Take my latest report back to Gracina Spiritmight in Darnassus; she's still at the Temple of the Moon, is she not? She's got friends who are Alliance bigwigs; if we can get them involved in this <name>, then we just might make it out of this alive.
text.97204: Greetings, {class}. It would seem you are now seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride a kodo, for a fee of course. Harb will provide you with a free mount once ye have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts you would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but you will have to find trainers for each. Speak to me when you have enough coin, and I will teach you about riding the noble kodo.
text.7961: These rabbits are breeding uncontrollably. Something must be done! Help us <name>, you're our only hope.
text.96222: While war rages throughout the region, the Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. I worry that they will grow callous in time and stir further unrest if the other clans continue to turn a blind eye to their presence. Khan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment, and I wish to have it as a negotiation tactic. Find a war horn mouthpiece from the centaur there and use it to challenge him atop the highest peak. Bring the key to me, and I will have a proposition for you.
text.93787: Humans within these lands have long enjoyed the warmth, comfort and sustenance these lands provide. It's time we start denying these humans such pleasantries. Seek out the supplies of our enemies at the farm to the southwest. Take whatever you find. It won't bring pleasure like bloodying a blade, but slowing them buys us time to plan our next move.
text.92434: Whatever caused Dalaran's barrier to lower has left the city in turmoil. With you having dealt with their patrols, there is no better time than now to make our way inside and discover their secrets. Take the key you found at the internment camp and seek out their sewers along the northern border of the city. With luck, those mages had no reason to put a ward over such a... disagreeable point of entry.
text.5227: The Scourge's plague cauldron stands before you, spewing vast amounts of toxins into the air. A small, non-descript access panel lies in the base of the cauldron's vast platform. Having already defeated the cauldron lord and acquired its key, you are free to add the appropriate reagents to the cauldron to make a counter agent to the plague.
text.6183: Five of my best field agents were assigned the Marris case. One returned, only to end up dead in his sleep three days later. What little information we did manage to get out of him was incoherent gibberish. We made out two words: "Nathanos," and "Blightcaller." I do not have the available manpower to continue this investigation and Ravenholdt will not assist us. We must get to the bottom of this; if only to provide closure to the families of the deceased. Will you help?
text.2523: You have found a sickly, corrupted version of what appears to be a songflower plant. A pungent, unhealthy odor emanates from the plant. It desperately needs some sort of attention if it is to be turned back to normal.
text.9001: That's an amazing story, <name>! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved. Now maybe I'll be able to sleep at night with both eyes shut. As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you'll really enjoy.
text.96984: You may not have our best interests at heart, but I won't deny an extra pair of hands. And if Dalaran falls, it takes everything with it--including your Undercity. So, your benefactor wants in? Fine. I'll imbue your key to work past my wards so you can enter the city. Once you're in, meet me at the Violet Citadel where this all began. With everything going on the Kirin Tor will be too busy to stop you. Scavenge what you will, but whatever happens, our first priority is to prevent a catastrophe.
text.9415: Are you Marshal Bluewall's new recruits? Of course you are. What are you waiting for? Good soldiers are dying in the desert. Aren't you excited to join them? Now, get going and don't dry out on the way.
text.5526: Your knowledge of Eldre'Thalas - Dire Maul - in Feralas will now come into play, <name>. In the eastern part of the ruined city is where Alzzin the Wildshaper has exerted his corrupt dominion. Go there with all due haste and brave whatever challenges await you. The Fruit of Fertility, now corrupted as the Felvine, should be close to Alzzin. When he falls, capture whatever essence of the Felvine you can. Seal it in the Reliquary, and bring it to me. Good luck, and Cenarion's speed.
text.84138: I'm the chief engineer, founder and lead researcher of the Deepsea Exploration and Liquefaction Technologies Alliance. I've nearly finished my latest experiment, and I need your help! I am working on a special device to geolocate resource-rich dimensions. To complete my construction, I need something back: a book of arcane formulas that I lent to an old colleague of mine, Nami, who continues her work in Winterspring. Retrieve the book for me and you'll be included as a published contributor!
text.85634: The madcaps of Zandalar are similar to rogues, but above all else they embrace madness... chaos... the unpredictability of existence. A terror to behold on the battlefield, they sowed the seeds of confusion and mayhem amongst our enemies in the savage times after the tribes splintered. We would not be here today without them. Bring to me the Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub that I seek, and I will grant you the first of the madcap's prized armors. Embrace the madness!
text.82020: Return to Loganaar and inform him of what we've learned. I'm going to try and scout the temple myself to hopefully make contact with the dragons, or at least glean more information.
text.7381: While it is true that Korrak has been slain, one question remains: Will he remain dead? Trolls are notorious for their other-worldly tribal magics. I would not be surprised if the fallen leader was raised from the dead to once more rule over his clan. You know what to do should this ever occur. <Warmaster Laggrond makes a cutting motion across his neck with his index finger.> And this time, I want his skull. Just keep your eyes peeled, soldier. Dismissed!
text.93574: <With a terrible crunch, you removed a piece of the worm's carapace upon its demise. Despite its enormous size and hefty weight, it is disappointingly ordinary. This creature was seemingly not the result of a cruel experiment nor carefully bred to be an all-devouring beast. It is simply an impressive shell, likely desired only by collectors. Perhaps you could find one, though other than the centaur, who else might be alive around here?>
text.5219: One of the plague cauldrons is located in the field of a former farmhouse now referred to as Dalson's Tears. Well, we shall shed no tears this day as we thwart the Scourge and have them choke on their own fumes! Go to Dalson's Tears, almost due north of Andorhal, and eliminate the cauldron lord there. It should have a key like the last one did, allowing you into the cauldron. Use this bottle to obtain a sample from inside the cauldron; each cauldron has its own distinct brew of toxins it uses.
text.5055: Swift, and clever, Brumeran glides silently across the snowy landscape of southern Winterspring. But do not let her graceful appearance convince you that she is harmless. All that cross her pay considerably, and often with their own lives. Seek out Brumeran of the chillwind among the chimera. Defeat her, then return again to me.
text.758: The totem is ready, <name>. And again, it is your task to perform the ritual of cleansing. Go to the Thunderhorn Water Well, north of the village, and use the Thunderhorn Cleansing Totem in your ritual. After you do this, return to me. May the spirits guide you.
text.96060: Let me be the first to share that I was a master swordsman in life. I forged weapons by day and wielded them by night. As you are quite well aware, my relationship with this particular blade is now extraordinarily complicated. Though I think I could swing it around, I'm not convinced it would be of much use unless I was fighting other spirits. Is that really of any value to me in Shen'dralas? Nonetheless, I would like its capabilities tested and I think our forests could use a gentle culling.
text.8908: Well met, {class}. I've something that might interest you. I have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor. The blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment. Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. You shall find the effort worth your while.
text.5091: Hear ye, hear ye! All heroes are called upon to heed these words! A call to arms has been issued by the Kingdom of Stormwind! All able bodied individuals are entreated to take up arms against the dark threat of the Scourge in the northern lands of the Eastern Kingdoms! Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the Plaguelands! Heroes of the realm - seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist who has set up his base camp in Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains!
text.93034: One of our scouts returned to the village while you were away, with news that confirmed my fears. The Magram are up to something, <name>. It is not good. The Valley of Bones far to the east is a cursed land that few centaur dared to enter and fewer still ever return home. Our enemy has found something there, something evil, and we need to learn what it is. Seek out the scout Nerlokh at the southern entrance, but you may have to prove yourself further to the Gelkis.
text.94980: <The moulding appears to be for a key.>
text.92741: The Shadowgale Forest is incredibly dangerous and is usually off limits to normal adventurers. In recent months there's been an explosion in the shriekling population and they've started to expand their territory outside the woods, which is a potential problem. I have an interest in the alchemical properties of shriekling talons, so a much-needed culling also presents an opportunity for scholarly gain. Travel to Shadowgale Forest and hunt the beasts. Bring me as many of their talons as you can.
text.89013: What's a travel lodge without somethin' to drink? I can brew a fine mead, but I'm gettin' a bit on in years to gather the honey myself. There are wasp nests in the trees north of the Haldaar camp, an' west of Valormok. If ye see hippogryphs, yer in the right place. They're nasty buggers, but the honey is like nothin' ye've ever tasted. I'll lend ye my pellet gun to knock down the hives, ye can't reach 'em otherwise.
text.131: Here is your bouquet. I chose Daffodils for you. They're my favorite!
text.5541: Hegnar Rumbleshot sells guns off the road to Anvilmar. Riflemen and mortar teams spend a lot of time practicing out near his shop, and he's always needing fresh ammunition. But... the last crate of ammo I sent him got lost along the way. My courier said he was camped near the Grizzled Den when wendigo chased him away... and the fool left Rumbleshot's ammo behind! <name>, can you get that ammo and take it to Rumbleshot? He's been waiting on it and I'm sure he's running low.
text.4463: Present the components, mortal. I will also require payment in the form of thirty gold pieces for this creation.
text.94401: You might have heard of kodos, but have you heard of the stegodons? The kodo are descended from the mighty stegodons, but except for in the deep crater, the stegodon are gone! Far to the southwest, you will find a place known as Terror Run, the last place where this mighty beast still roams free. They are a nuisance, and while more likely to be prey than predators, their enormous size and thunderous stomps deter most dinos from leaving their nesting grounds. Kill a few, just to quiet things down.
text.7001: The war in the valley has taken its toll on our soldiers. We must revitalize our forces! If we can fill up the stables, the Wolf Riders will once more be able to ride out into the field of battle. Take this muzzle and track down the frostwolves that inhabit the nearby forest. Once you find a wolf, use the muzzle to tame the beast. Bring the tamed beast back to me so that I may place it in the stable. When we have enough wolves stabled, the Wolf Riders will rejoin their patrol on our front lines.
text.96799: <Lieutenant Connar listens as you tell him the reason you are here.> So, Danneth has an orphaned nephew in Dalaran? If you haven't spoken to him about this yet, I'd suggest you do so. He doesn't exactly seem like the parenting type, but he might surprise me. If he does want to go and collect the boy once he's recovered, he has my blessing to take leave for that.
text.5385: You pick up the sack carefully and prepare to make your way back to Jessir Moonbow on the border of Felwood and Ashenvale. Hopefully the paladin will be given the proper respects once you've passed his remains on to his friends.
text.92849: <Judging by what you've just found, it's very likely that Fillion befell some misfortune here. He may still be nearby, and he might be in need of aid. You notice a cave just to the north of your current location. You should continue searching for him there.>
text.90519: I hate fish. I cannot stand the smell of them. They are extremely creepy. Truly the worst. Since this is my kitchen, I can and do exercise my authority to say NO to fish imports, but sometimes our soldiers get it in their heads that they need a fisherman's feast. Tonight is one of those nights it would seem. I need fish, on the double!
text.93848: The magic that Ketharas was able to craft to counteract this threat was vital to this victory. Our druids should be able to replicate the magic and use it to dispel the wards empowering the Blackthorne Pact at scale. You should go back to Ketharas and let him know what transpired here. Tell him that he has the thanks of the Guardians of Hyjal and the Cenarion Circle. He should know that he is always welcome amongst us should he desire a place alongside his fellow druids once again.
text.3636: The Scourge is a persistent threat to the Alliance, a fact I am sure you know quite well. Recently, we have come across some very peculiar findings, <name>. In the Barrens lies a horrid tangle of briars called Razorfen Downs. While once it was the home of simple quilboar, now it has become apparent that a pact was made with the Scourge, creating creatures far worse... They are now ruled by the lich, Amnennar the Coldbringer. Align yourself with the Light, <name>; put an end to this evil union.
text.5086: I've studied the sample you returned with, and while I can't say for sure, I believe it contains traces of toxic elements. However, the only way to know for sure is to gather some as a comparison. I believe that the Deadwood furbolg may be gathering these elements from other corrupted creatures in Felwood; in particular, the elementals living in the Irontree Woods, called toxic horrors. Collect a few samples for me to compare, but be careful -- it's very dangerous there!
text.310: I have to admit, those Thunderbrews make some good drinks. But they need to learn that theirs isn't the only decent brew! Maybe you can help me teach them that lesson... Here, take this barrel of Barleybrew Scalder. Sneak into the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos and switch it with one of their barrels of Thunder Ale. Then we'll see how their patrons like my brew over theirs! And if the barrels are guarded, then you might have to distract the guard...
text.1319: I'm sorry I can't be of much help, <name>, but I can refer you to someone who would be. Caz Twosprocket, one of our best blacksmiths, works the forge at the smithy. Take the shield to him, and see what he can tell you.
text.4292: This will be the most difficult part because there is some complexity to the plan. To the north of here, you will find a small trail into the mountains. It was here I saw Lar'korwi last. You will know you are in the right area because of all the bones from massive creatures that once wandered nearby. Take the meat you recovered and place it there. Then, rub this mixture I created on the meat. If both lures mingled together do not bring Lar'korwi to you, then I know nothing else that will.
text.4741: In the northern areas of Winterspring, the Wildkin grow even more ferocious. We must continue our measures there. Hunt the moontouched owlbeasts in Winterspring, and explore the area they inhabit. This is dangerous ground, but I know that you will be able to handle the challenge. Return to me after you have slain 13 of the wildkin.
text.616: Baron Revilgaz has had me keep an ear out for rumors of the strange and out-of-place in Booty Bay and Stranglethorn. I don't usually put much stock in ghost stories, but I heard some sailors in the tavern talking about a haunted island off the coast. Water elementals and a raving goblin ghost, they say. If you're going to go talk to Revilgaz, could you relay that story to him?
text.91685: When we first got here, I did some surveying for any untapped resources. Y'know, typical prospector stuff. I didn't see nothin' special 'til I searched Lake Mennar, to the south. There, I saw a huge rift floating above the water's surface. I couldn't get close, but I think it was an open leyline. If I'm right, we can use this wand to siphon magic straight from the source! Bottle that up, sell it to the highest bidder, and bam! I'm rich! If you go and siphon that rift for me, I'll cut you in.
text.5891: The power of a disenchanted magical item is felt by the essence it creates. I've devised a way to turn raw essence used by enchanters into a suitable reagent for creating Cenarion plant salve. You don't need a Cenarion beacon for this; any suitably disenchanted item that yields lesser nether essences will work. I just need a single lesser nether essence; in exchange, I will give you Cenarion plant salves. The essence is extremely potent - a little definitely goes a long way!
text.6504: I just picked up this shredder from Ratchet and I was on my way back to the Warsong Lumber Camp, where I am supposed to be on duty. I was given a manual on how to operate the shredder, but on the trip back, a huge gust of wind blew it from my hands. The pages went everywhere, and all I was left with was the cover. The pages could be just about anywhere by now, I suppose... but I don't know how to use the shredder without them! Will you find them for me?
text.96800: You there, {class}. I have a matter I could use assistance with. I just so happen to be writing a thesis on the ancient Wildhammer runemasters of Grim Batol, and there's a particular tome I need to complete my research. According to our ledgers, a mage by the name of Doan checked the book out of the old Dalaran library before the Third War and never returned it! Arcanist Doan is now holed up in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades. Retrieve this book for me and you'll be well rewarded.
text.4496: My research revealed to me that the silithid are like bees; destroy the queen of the hive, and the rest of should be thrown into disarray. I'll brew a lure that we'll use to bring out the queen; once summoned, you'll take her down. First though, we need some reagents; we don't want you bungling into the jungle unprepared. Go west to find the silithid hive in Un'Goro Crater and obtain a scent gland from one of the bugs. I'll also need some samples of the native Un'Goro soil.
text.9111: <Father Montoy makes some strange gestures in the air in front of you.> Blessed boy, have you found the vestments of the fallen? The poor souls whose last breaths were taken on the field of battle - stripped of everything including their dignity. Bring me the desecrated remnants of the departed along with reagents of purification and you shall know faith.
text.89568: I think we need to learn more about this new plague. This seems to be targeted at... killing the undead and the living? The undead are naturally immune to the plague of undeath, being of said plague to begin with. If what I suspect is true, this might be something new and terrible. I am loathe to subject the undead here to more torment, but we must learn more before we return to Light's Hope.
text.3565: What is it? Oh yes, your payment. Of course. Take this and be off with you. I'm sure Jediga is awaiting oh so patiently for your return.
text.91698: <A matriarchal furbolg speaks to you from within the cage> "Deadwood trap me and my cub in tough cage. Key hang on Deadwood Warden belt. You hunt them, take key, lift latch, set us free. Do this, and Barkskin know your heart true."
text.5250: In Winterspring, to the northeast of Felwood, there are many ancient elven ruins. It's a harsh land, but it holds many secrets and places to explore. My studies here keep me so busy that I have not had the opportunity to travel to Winterspring for some time. But there's no reason why you shouldn't travel there and study the ruins. While you're there, look for Wynd Nightchaser. He spends most of his time in Starfall and he knows a lot about the area. Tell him that you are a student of mine...
text.99152: While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep. I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course. Travel beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
text.93123: This skeleton looks different than the others you've seen in these catacombs. Although unmoving, there seems to be a very faint spark of something burning inside its hollow eyes. You hear a faint buzzing sound in your head. There are no words, but it seems to be somehow... pleading for something. An image forms in your mind of a small chest containing a faintly glowing urn. You are being shown the phylactery of a lich.
text.95819: Greetings, accomplished craftsperson! Completion of this form will grant you non-exclusive, revocable, and legally limited permission to display advertisement signs for your tradeskill(s) all across Azeroth! Once completed, please bring this to your local Durotar Supply & Logistics Contract Coordinator to begin processing. Happy crafting!
text.2561: After examining this charm, <name>, I see now what must be done. Please take it, and do as I ask. You are to explore the deepest areas of the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. There, you will find my soulless body... Although I regret what I am about to tell you, I see no other way to free myself from the control of the Gnarlpine. In order for me to escape them, you must kill my physical form. Once that is done, use the voodoo charm on my fallen body. After you have completed this task, please return to me.
text.98245: I don't know who I hate more: the bloody Dark Irons, the Dragonmaw, or the drakes they rode. <Howin spits.> I aim tae make things right. But we're gonna need some supplies. These whelp scales will protect against dragonfire a good bit, but they're a pain in the arse tae weave together. The Razormaw raptors up in Raptor Ridge to the northeast and Saltspray Glen to the northwest are so named for their pointy chompers--they oughta break through the scales. Bring me a handful of the incisors.
text.85613: Vengeance is power. The Zandalar vindicator is such power. The tribe has many enemies. The vindicator exacts retribution on them. No crime against us is unpunished. The vindicator delivers this punishment. Our enemies fear our vengeance. They should. They forever will. Become one of our vindicators. Seek the Paragons of Power inside Zul'Gurub. Slay the minions of Hakkar and claim vengeance in the tribe's name. You will be rewarded.
text.82011: We did it friend! The Goblins are throwing in the towel. In fact, the consultant the Goblins hired wants to talk to you personally! Try not to flaunt too hard now, wouldn't want them to pop a sapper!
text.96822: We lost many brave warriors of the Horde when we sacked Tiragarde Keep. Now that the humans have reinforced the ruins, we cannot collect their remains to properly honor their deaths. Go to the ruins surrounding the keep, and search for the weapons left by our fallen kin. We will display them in a place of honor.
text.8916: Hail, {class}! I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world. Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this. Perform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers. I'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus. Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
text.8641: It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon. Bring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
text.920: <name>, is it? I heard that Tenaron has been asking for you. You'll find him in the highest room atop Aldrassil. We may live long lives, but it's best you not keep him waiting too long.
text.2769: Have you met the Brassbolts brothers? They're over in the Shimmering Flats, in Kalimdor, racing their rocket car against the goblins. They usually win which is no surprise--the goblin car blows up so much it barely ever crosses the finish line! But even then, the Brassbolts brothers are always looking for new ways to make their car go faster, and Wizzle told me he needs a very rare component for his next experiment. He probably needs help getting that part. Speak to him and find out.
text.8931: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux. I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin. Bring me an ordinary belt and a set of gloves that you wish to upgrade.
text.9077: If you want Bonescythe made, you're going to have to supply the materials. Enter Naxxramas, the big floating city of death in the sky up there, and find desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps. Bring those back along with the materials to put everything together and you'll have your Bonescythe. Oh, and you'll need to pay me for my troubles... I'll supply the bones.
text.94216: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Elixir of Lesser Agility, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.698: I'm working on getting some supplies together for our outpost near the beach to the east--Tok'kar does what he can, but between shifts of guard duty and cooking for his soldiers there's not much time left in the day. They do enjoy cooking up some sawtooth meat when they can, but I haven't had time to get them another shipment. Would you mind helping them out? The young sawtooths aren't as tasty as the older ones, so stay clear of those; give them a year or two to get to full size.
text.2821: My philosophy on leatherworking is that the work must be the best quality possible - no compromises. Anyone who says that quality doesn't matter is trying to sell you ocean-front property in Dun Morogh! In my latest pursuit of high-quality materials, I have run across thick yeti hides. The Yeti are native to Feralas, with many found in Feral Scar Vale. I want some, and I'll give you a choice of one of my leather goods for a stack of ten. If that sounds fair to you, then we're in business.
text.2861: Rumor is that Tabetha, a mage colleague who lives deep in Dustwallow Marsh, has a bone to pick with a certain sand troll in Zul'Farrak. If you speak with Tabetha she can tell you more. And bring some friends with you, <name>. If Tabetha has you go to Zul'Farrak then you're not going to want to go alone. You will find Tabetha's cottage west of Theramore, and just north of the Stonemaul Ruin.
text.5089: From the corpse of the defeated serpent you uncover what appears to be a note of some importance: A letter from his superior, General Drakkisath, concerning protocol. Your instinct tells you that you should take it to Marshal Maxwell.
text.6521: Malcin claims he is outside Razorfen Downs. This ambassador must be slain--his mission a failure in the eyes of the Lich King. His presence there does explain much of what we've discovered about the area--some of the quilboar have grown frightfully powerful while showing signs of the Plague in their own way. Truly that must be a sign of some sort of deal they've struck. Find Malcin and slay him, <name>. Return to me after the deed is done.
text.4289: This crater has many strange creatures--they seem to be nobler versions of the creatures found throughout my homeland and beyond. I cannot explain it, but this place cries of the Earth Mother. I pay homage to her every time I track one of her beautiful creatures across its basin. If you too wish to feel the enlightenment that accompanies such a great feat, then head to the north. There you'll find great apes who are a test for any mortal's strength. Bring me their pelts... prove your strength.
text.79980: "Not so bad, eh? Since you're reading this, it means my stash is still there. Take a hundred paces due north and don't break your ankles going down the steep cliffside. There should be enough to keep you going."
text.610: My FATHER sent you? I'd have thought that old codger would have given up on me by now. It wasn't really his fault I ran off, he just shouldn't have expected I'd be willing to live a boring life, reading over musty books and associating with grey-haired, stiff-backed, stuffy mages! If you need my dagger, you'll have to get it back from "Pretty Boy" Duncan, one of the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Put something 'tween his shoulders and I'm sure he'll give it up.
text.8304: My dear Natalia has gone missing. Truth be told, she had been acting strangely for weeks leading up to her disappearance. I had caught her talking to herself when no one was around on more than one occasion. She was adamant that everything was ok and that she must be allowed to continue her research. She was last seen heading to Bronzebeard's camp to the south. My soldiers are spread too thin, <name>. I need you to go to Bronzebeard's camp and question those dwarves.
text.6629: <name>, you've done a fine job killing Grimtotem. If you dare, Grundig Darkcloud and his personal band of brutes is by far the worst of the lot. He was the one who led the brutal attack on my village. You will find him in Grimtotem Post a bit further up the path to the west. Kill him, and I will be forever grateful.
text.9033: Five years since the last war... Tens of thousands of lives were lost and for what? The threat was never fully extinguished. And so the Lich King stirs once more... His yes-man, Kel'Thuzad, amassing for another attack upon our lands. We will not allow it! Prove your dedication. Prove that you are willing to risk life and limb to stop this madness and the combined might of the Dawn and the Crusade will be at your beck and call. Enter Naxxramas and destroy the Scourge within...
text.8952: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us. The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for. I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
text.841: Let me guess - you didn't get whatever world-ending, nefarious deed you were doing done in time. No wait, better still... you dropped it in the sand! Well, whatever the reason, I do have additional power sources I will sell to you. This time, however, it will cost you ten, YES TEN Wastewander Water Pouches! Times are tough all around, <name>, and power sources don't grow on trees! Hrm, but what if they did. Maybe we could MAKE a power source tree...
text.24: The once swift Shadumbra now lies still as you claim victory over it. The head of the slain nightsaber is a fitting trophy for this fight of the Ashenvale Hunt. Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post will want to see such a trophy to award you credit for this part of the Ashenvale Hunt.
text.9093: Many heroes fell in the last war and many continue to perish at the hands of the Scourge to this day. From the corpses of the fallen, the armor is stripped and taken back to Naxxramas to be used for unknown purposes. Recover the desecrated armor and wartorn armor scraps and supply to me the other material components I require and I will craft Dreamwalker armor.
text.835: Gazlowe told me once, "Rezlak. There's one thing you need to know in life, and that's if you want something done well, do it yourself." I can't deal with losing all our caravans, so I'm just going to take matters into my own hands. Drygulch Ravine lies through the eastern part of Razorwind Canyon. If we kill all the harpies there, the routes will be safe. Of course, there was one other thing that Gazlowe taught me, and that's "You can get anything done for a price." So, going to help me out, <name>?
text.6546: Much danger lies along this path, <name>. You'd do best to remember this while traveling in these lands. The threat of the alliance is quite near. We are faced by enemies on all fronts. The satyr are a formidable and prevalent force in eastern Ashenvale. I have also discovered that the naga have taken over a large area of the land of Azshara. It's good to see that we are still bolstering our numbers -- be ready for what lies ahead, <name>.
text.195: Now let's step up the challenge and see if you're up to it. Venture into the jungle and bag yourself 10 of those bloody Lashtail Raptors. Let's see what you've got!
text.8804: With the arrival of fresh recruits to Cenarion Hold comes the problem of keeping them alive in the desert. Dehydration as well as numerous poisonous creatures present a serious threat to inexperienced volunteers. Gather the supplies necessary for a desert survival kit and bring them to Calandrath in Cenarion Hold.
text.9187: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order. Work Order LW-8485: 4 Runic Leather Pants. All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged. -Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
text.99260: I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. Without that data to aid in our calculations, our attempts to steer our skycutter ships through the elemental plane will fail. The data is likely lost at this point, and I'm in no state to attempt to gather it again. I told the Supreme Magister of your role in saving me, and he wishes to speak with you again.
text.89261: Staying on top of your trade is crucial for maintaining a high standard of quality. Our soldiers entrust their lives to unnamed craftsmen, and to me for ensuring the quality of every piece of armor. My task for you is simple. If you are well practiced in Tailoring, Leatherworking, or Blacksmithing, then craft a pair of trousers, purely for your own benefit. You are free to keep the result. If you lack the skill, commission and donate any piece of the crusade's uniform instead.
text.85882: The deed is done. Dal'rend Blackhand, Warchief of the Dark Horde, lies dead at your feet. Take his head and present it to Master Shaw.
text.1153: {class}, you have done well in helping me in the past. The warchief is pleased thus far with what I've accomplished, and asks me to continue with renewed determination. My honor dictates that I give you proper recognition to the warchief for all you have done, but first I would ask you for your help again. Travelers recently came from the south from a place called Thousand Needles. There they killed a kobold who had an unusual ore sample, but they would not sell it. I want a sample of that ore to examine.
text.5245: The highborne spirits are miserable creatures, that's for sure. They are still searching for pieces of the very thing that has cursed them to Kel'Theril forever -- the stolen relic.
