text.1284: Rows of hoofprints lead away from the still-smoking skeleton of the Shady Rest Inn. There are at least a few visible impressions, with more rows of prints almost imperceptible in the soft mud of the marsh.
text.99435: Windsor has already set off to confront Lady Prestor in Stormwind Keep, {class}. He spoke highly of your bravery. I suggest you hurry to his aid! He is now certain that Prestor is Onyxia: Brood of Deathwing, twin to the tyrant of the Spire, Nefarian. According to him, even the Highlord is controlled by her trickery! The Marshal intends to break the spell and free all of Stormwind from the dark shadow of these fiends. Find him and ensure the deed is done!
text.5021: "The package must be delivered... delivered before I'm trapped here!" The cries of a panicked woman feel almost like a whisper floating through the house. Cowered in the upstairs corner is the apparition of a woman. She does not seem to be fully cognizant of her surroundings, and she is only vaguely aware of you. "Are you here to deliver my package? Please, before it gets much worse! I was going to ride out of here. It should still be by my horse... or am I too late?"
text.94275: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Solid Sharpening Stone, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.1072: The device I'm thinking about is my most advanced version to date. But we'll need a special potion if it's to work. I'm thinking we might as well get the good stuff since this mission could be your last. And for that, we're going to need some potent explosives: Nitromirglyceronium. The only person who can make NG-5 is an old friend of mine: Lomac Gearstrip. Look for him in Tinker Town. You talk him into making us some NG-5, I'll get to work on placement for my devices.
text.722: Ye're brave... <cough>... to come into Uldaman fer me, {class}. If ye're really here to help... ol' Hammertoe, then... <cough>... you'll need to find... me amulet. Deepshadow's got it... Magregan Deepshadow. He's 'round here... in the ruins fer sure. That amulet'll lead 'em... <cough>... right to the scrolls if he ain't stopped. It's up to you, <name>. Please... get that amulet. The scrolls will surely help the Dark Irons create even more powerful golems. I just know it. I can feel it in me bones.
text.8266: I understand that it can be difficult at times to come out on top in Warsong Gulch. Still, your effort on our behalf - even when victory is not achieved - is important. Should you complete one of the trials inside Warsong Gulch and not achieve victory, you will still receive a Ribbons of Sacrifice. Bring it to me so that the Sentinels may reward you for acting on our behalf... even if you weren't able to win this time.
text.312: I had a month's worth of dried meats salted and locked away for the cold season. Kept it locked so the bears wouldn't get it! But while I was off hunting deer, that beast, Old Icebeard, made off with the meat locker. He won't be able to smash through that Thorium though. But I'll starve if I can't get my meats back. You seem a bit more stealthy than me. Perhaps you can retrieve my stash? I'll never make it in and out of that cave fast enough with this bum leg of mine.
text.777: Okay, here you go. I'm going to be over here... behind cover. Feel free to join me.
text.96964: If the hermit truly wants his little gambit to leave the nest and fly, it will likely need a potent energy source. One that can sustain itself without collapse. <Jereman looks to the sky and clacks her beak together as she considers.> Ah, yes. I know just the clever creature we can consult. Go north into the area you mortals refer to as Dae'gun, the one with the demons, and seek out the fox Wild God Renalard. I believe he will have a solution to our little puzzle.
text.8461: There is a camp of Deadwood furbolgs directly to our southwest. Corruption permeates the camp, and I wish to put an end to it before they become a problem. The Deadwood tribe is evil, but it is the effects of the fel that pollutes their minds. Their hostility is not truly an innate quality, yet they cannot be helped. It saddens me that we must fight our own brethren. Please, <name> - I ask you to do what must be done. Simply spare me the details; such troublesome images upset me far too much.
text.92909: Oh no... I'm in for it now! I heard about the harvesters terrorizing the fields of Westfall, so I traveled all the way from Ironforge to see if I could recalibrate them. But they're far more aggressive than my calculations anticipated, and they chased me into this stable! If I had some isosprings and gyrostabilizers from the harvesters, I could build a device to cover my escape. Could you gather the parts for me?
text.95328: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.
text.551: This parchment is enchanted with a spell, rendering it indecipherable. But one word at the top of the paper can be read: Nagaz
text.2923: Tinkmaster Overspark is very upset with the fate of his mechanical creation, Techbot. I remember Techbot as a kind and helpful tool for the gnomes, but Overspark tells me it's malfunctioned. Very sad. But with luck perhaps he can be fixed! Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark, in Tinker Town in Ironforge. He would welcome your help.
text.97663: I noticed a few rocks that seemed unusual in the Dustbowl. Upon closer inspection, I saw that they had carvings! I could not resist making rubbings of them to study later. The nearby ogres took notice of my presence and before I could even react, I woke up under the care of the innkeeper, and with a terrible headache. Now, I am down all of my supplies and without any study material while I heal. Can you venture to the east in search of my pack, and take rubbings of the etchings yourself?
text.97003: You there, {class}. I need your aid. There are rumors of a beast that makes its lair deep in a cave at Thorn Hill, northeast of here. The Razormane call it Chol'aruk or "The Ravener". It's supposedly five times the size of a normal quilboar with a thirst for blood that can never be sated. Most don't believe the tales. But I do--because I've fought its like before. Seek out its lair and slay Chol'aruk. Bring me its head. I warn you though--prepare well and do not go alone. Blood and thunder, {class}.
text.94481: This hearty stew keeps our trainees fed, enough so that our enemies remain at a distance. Bring this and feed our trainees to the west. Don't listen to any complaints. With how difficult defending our supply lines has become, they should be so lucky we're not feeding them dirt.
text.4506: This corrupted water can be used to our advantage, <name>. With just a small amount of the water, my kitten doubled in size, and seems to be stronger... somehow. These cats may prove useful... Here, <name>. Take this cat carrier, and release the kitten inside next to the moon well in the Ruins of Constellas. Heh, heh... I'm sure you'll be pleased with the results! Return the cat to me, and I'm sure I can make it worth your time.
text.98476: Bring me any additional motes of unstable magic you encounter in your travels. The fabric of reality itself seems to be fraying, and the Earthen Ring needs more raw material for study.
text.617: You looking fer work, <name>? I might have some if you're up for a little challenge. I got a friend named Groy who makes a killing selling what the naga call akiris reed: it's some kind of valuable ocean reed. Not too sure what it's for, but he pays well for bundles of the stuff. Ya bring me ten stalks of the stuff, and we'll have business to do. The naga were last seen along the beach to the north of here.
text.8925: Next we shall need to find a stable and portable source of energy to keep the ectoplasm active. I've heard rumors of a mighty elemental called Magma Lord Bokk, whose heart is a powerful magma core - an endless supply of heat! It's said he can be found in the Burning Steppes, south of Blackrock Mountain. Bring the magma core to me and we shall have enough juice to power the extra-dimensional ghost revealer!
text.92682: Oh, so you've got more courage than sense, then? Fine, I won't argue. Ferauu and his goons aren't due to pick up their take of the harvest just yet, so I'm going to put you to work for your meals until they arrive. Head outside and gather today's batch of stormapples for me. Oh, and the bandits lurking around the stormapple trees... They think they are sneaky. They aren't. Kill them for me. Let's see what you've got in a fight.
text.9068: Would you honor me by returning the armor of those that fell in the defense of these lands? The armor has been desecrated and is undoubtedly being used for evil; however, with wartorn armor scraps, the desecrated armor can be renewed and worn for battle once more. Bring me the remnants of the fallen along with purification materials and Earthshatter shall be yours to don. Search Naxxramas.
text.94255: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Spider Silk Slippers, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
text.5090: Hear ye, hear ye! All heroes are called upon to heed these words! A call to arms has been issued by the Kingdom of Stormwind! All able bodied individuals are entreated to take up arms against the dark threat of the Scourge in the northern lands of the Eastern Kingdoms! Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the Plaguelands! Heroes of the realm - seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist who has set up his base camp in Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains!
text.7730: From what scouting we have managed to muster, we believe that the foe south of the gnolls is an insect-like race. Frankly, it is irrelevant whether or not if they're sentient. If they are driving the gnolls to frenzy against us, then they are as big of a threat - if not more - than the gnolls. Drive deep into where these Zukk'ash insects dwell; it is known as the Writhing Deep. Thin their numbers and report back to me what you find, bringing back their carapaces as evidence of your handiwork.
text.4105: A Cenarion beacon allows a seasoned herbalist to spot insidious fel creep - a malfeasant product of Felwood's corruption. My work here has taught me the knowledge of purifying fel creep into a cleansing reagent... used in what we now refer to as Cenarion plant salve. When you gather herbs in Felwood, you should encounter the fel creep so long as you have the beacon. In exchange for what you bring to me, I will give you pre-made Cenarion plant salve.
text.79098: This one is slain, but these infuriating alliance continue to fight... what is this charm?
text.645: What's this? With the four sigils brought together, they have formed together to create one sigil. There can be no doubt that this will be able to break the wardings placed upon Trollbane's tomb. Trollbane's remains are entombed in the Sanctum behind the chapel in Stromgarde. Retrieve Trol'kalar.
text.4482: Thirty gold, {race}. Thirty gold and the required components.
text.7362: The Elder Crone has sent me to this warzone to research the other races. More specifically, I am to collect gnome samples. Magatha is primarily interested in their survivability. Aye, the gnomes - while pitifully weak and miniscule - exude great resilience both in and out of combat. Fortunately for you, I am looking for ruffians to do Magatha's bidding. Return to me with tufts of gnome hair and you shall be known to the tauren as an ally.
text.264: Filthy scum! Leaves me for his damn crusade. Because "the Light is the most important thing we have against the threats the undead pose." Well, what about his children?! What about ME?! Night after night I sat patiently waiting for him... always second to his blasted duty! Well, witness what "justice" brings you, <name>! He's dead and I'm bearing the very thing he was trying to stop! Take this piece of junk and put it on his tomb at the Sepulcher. I want nothing to do with it anymore... or him!
text.8361: We've seen the Twilight's Hammer cultists performing rituals to summon powerful elemental nobles. We don't know if these are the beings the cultists worship or if they act as intermediaries to even more powerful forces. One thing is for sure: they are receiving orders from these elementals. I want you to find a way to contact an Abyssal Templar and give it a proper beating! Nothing throws the troops in disarray like taking out the chain of command. Bring back proof while you're at it.
text.95792: If you wanna land a big score, you gotta go where others wouldn't dare! This cave behind me's rich with untapped mineral deposits. I'm talkin' BIG bucks if we can get a crew in there. There's just this... teeny tiny... dragon problem. It's nothing, really. If you're willing to go in there and save me the hassle of clearing the dragons out, there's a nice reward in it for you. Not to mention, you'll be in the good graces of a future mining tycoon!
text.420: The troggs in the tunnel are extremely hostile, and haven't shown any hesitation in attacking travelers through the tunnel. You seem tough enough, though, so you should probably be safe. Directions? If you're going to speak with Senir, you'll find him in Kharanos. Make your way through the tunnel, and after you come out on the other side, just keep following the road, it'll run right into Kharanos.
text.92612: <Ketharas takes the branch and studies it. He begins to whisper a druidic incantation and the branch begins to glow brighter. The sickly green crystal begins to react as well, seeming to draw in the light surrounding it.> The secrets this branch holds are regrettably beyond my ability to discern. But I do sense... something. Take the branch and go to town of Nighthaven in Moonglade. Ask Dendrite Starblaze for assistance.
text.98192: You little! You help Krak smash the red bities and get scale hide! Krak smash red bities to take scale hide, but Krak hands too big. Krak keep cutting hides, make them full of holes. But you little! You go get hides from red bities in Dragonmurk in south. They mean and fast. You little, could get eaten.
text.8050: Welcome priest. The Eye of Zuldazar pulses with energy. You are ready to take the next step. Hand me the talisman and I shall perform the imbue.
text.897: This strange, insect-like creature looks outside of the natural order, as though it does not belong in the Barrens.
text.5249: In Winterspring, to the north of here, there are many ancient elven ruins. It's a harsh land, but it holds many secrets and places to explore. With all my work to do here in Felwood, I have not had the opportunity to travel to Winterspring. But there's no reason why you shouldn't! While you're there, look for Wynd Nightchaser. He spends most of his time in Starfall Village and he knows a lot about the area.
text.8183: The Heart of Hakkar burns from within. Although the Soulflayer is defeated, the kernel of his power yet remains in this cursed organ.
text.1106: I'm developing a new engine that'll make the car go so fast! Fast enough to fly, I know it! I just need to make pistons that can handle very very heavy stress. All my trials have failed because I can't make pistons hard enough! But there is someone who might know how. His name is Martek the Exiled. He is a great smith and knows more about metal than anyone. Take him this letter, I know he can help! But he's far far away -- in Azeroth, in the Badlands, in a camp, with a goblin! Find him!
text.79362: A shield left behind by the specter of Grant Valor, father of the Valor family and hero of Raven Hill. With Grant's spirit still battling the undead, perhaps his unfinished business was to slay the scourge that injured him in the Raven Hill Cemetery. It is likely the one his mace is still imbedded in.
text.1289: Well, judging from Captain Vimes's report, you've been a huge help to his investigation, and for that I thank you. I can put my mind more at ease knowing that the matter is in such capable hands. If you would, I would request that you return to Captain Vimes and help him in getting to the bottom of this mystery.
text.96408: Last night one of our mountaineers spotted a campfire on a hillside to the east. It looks to be pretty high up, overlooking the Gol'Bolar Quarry. It's probably nothing, but I'd like you to go check on that camp. If they are friendly, no harm done. If they aren't friendly... well, you know what to do.
text.157: Here is your thread, <name>. It has a thousand uses, from binding evil spirits to sewing life into inanimate objects.
text.2843: As long as you have the transponder in your possession, all you need to do is step on the pad and you'll be teleported to Gnomeregan. You may experience some unusual side effects, but none of those should be permanent... anymore. I almost forgot the most important part - getting back. When you're ready to come back, just step on the transpolyporter pad in Gnomeregan! Now to calibrate the transponder to your size and weight.
text.93461: You've got that "High Order" look to you. Those with Highborne ancestry always seem to have a slight twinkle in their eyes that gives it away. Before I properly put you to work around here, you should check in with our resident High Order elder Rathiril Sunlance. You can find him here in the main lodge, just around the corner from me. Oh, and check in with Coriella Calmbreeze as well, she runs the local inn and can provide lodging and supplies, should you need them.
text.766: My grandfather told me stories about his battles with a strider named Mazzranache. He told me of its demonic red eyes, razor-sharp talons and venomous bite. As fortune would have it, while traveling across the plains, I encountered it, and it took a nasty bite from my shoulder. He was as terrible as my grandfather described. I will need some hard-to-find animal parts to clean the infection from his bite: a wolf heart, cougar femur, plainstrider scale and swoop gizzard. Hurry, time is of the essence.
text.95321: Tazzik sent you to collect his winnings? That's a joke, right? His slackjaw champion didn't even last two minutes in the arena! That loser didn't earn a single copper. It's none of my business, pal, but if I were you I'd skedaddle back to Steamwheedle Port. While you're standin' here talkin' to me, that little rat Tazzik is probably tryin' to hop the next ship outta here.
text.98447: Despite you putting down the Valor family ghosts, the reports of attacks have not ceased. It was a good gamble, but perhaps we did not settle their unfinished business after all. From my research, it sounds like this family all went missing at the same time. Whatever trauma caused their spirits to be chained to this realm must have happened all at once. Our only clue is where you found the book. Return to Raven Hill and see what you can find. Maybe bringing their weapons will spark something.
text.3701: Venture to the smoldering ruins of Thaurissan in the Burning Steppes and gather as much information as possible. It is said that mysterious relics litter the ruins. Perhaps you should start your search there, <name>. Beware the Thaurissan guardians: Assassins that guard the ruins, keeping whatever secrets may still be buried there protected.
text.98310: There are other, larger golems all around the Wetlands. They each bear inscriptions marking them as Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru--matching the missing pieces of the Goaz Stone you found! I'd be willing to bet if we can bring pieces of them as well, we'll reveal more of the Goaz Stone! You'll find Ados at the Dragonmaw Gates to the east, near Grim Batol. Modr is right outside Dun Modr to the north. Golm lies beneath Grim Batol, east of Dun Algaz. Neru's behind Direforge Hill, to the northeast.
text.522: This is a contract for the assassination of Magistrate Henry Maleb. It was sealed and stamped in red wax, using a distinctive signet ring.
text.1138: I love crab. Crabs are the fruit of the sea! You can bake it, barbecue it, boil it, and broil it. They're pan fried, deep fried, and stir fried. There's crab salad, crab soup, crab stew, pepper crab, lemon crab, whipper root crab, and Ironforge surprise crab. That's... that's about it. I'm here fishing right now, so I can't get any fine crab chunks. You can pick them out of reef crawlers and encrusted tide crawlers. You can make a lot with it. You can bake it, barbecue it, boil it...
text.4083: The spectral chalice floats in the air, slowing rising and falling... as if to the beat of a dying heart.
text.950: Peering into the Twilight Tome is maddening. Text begins to swim and dance after only a moment's glance, and once beautiful scrollwork twists into grotesque shapes. Tearing away one page of insane scribbles is all that is possible before a swoon overtakes you.
text.441: Deliah had a husband, Raleigh, who now dwells in the Undercity. If the Deliah who lived in Brill is the one who owned this ring, then Raleigh will know. Raleigh is in the Trade Quarter of the Undercity.
text.92472: One of the most pervasive threats on Zephras Isle is the Al'Aketh Cult. They are religious zealots devoted to the worship of the supposed elemental ruler of Skywall, Al'Akir the Windlord. They are brutal, single-minded, and their power and ambitions are growing more deadly by the day. Your path will soon take you to Shen'dar Village to the south. Present yourself to Constable Aonda when you arrive. The cult threatens Shen'dar and they are in need of aid. Tell Aonda that I sent you.
text.99209: Yer back! Good, good. Are ye ready for a proper mountaineer's mount, <name>? Veron will set ye up with a free armored ram once ye have finished the final leg of yer training with me, and afterwards you'll be able to purchase any additional mounts ye would like. Speak ta me when you have enough coin, and I'll teach ye all I know about riding armored rams.
text.746: There are dwarves preparing a dig site to the northwest. They think secrets lie in the earth, and that is true, but hollowing and defiling the land is no way to earn its teachings. Collect the dwarven tools of digging, smash them, and return to me with the dwarves' broken tools. You can smash the tools at a forge. You will find one in Thunder Bluff, but any forge -- even a forge at the dwarven camp -- will suffice.
text.79242: As I was saying... Our boss wasn't with the Horde. She was a night elf named Illari Duskfeather. She gave us intel on the camps, and even let us keep most of the loot. She only kept a few of the rarer finds. Once the marshal was on our tail, though, she left us for dead. I don't know her motives, but I think we were set up as patsies. I'm not the vengeful type, but I won't stop someone else from hunting her down. If you're looking for her, she once mentioned a hideout on the coast of Arathi.
text.1361: A warrior of the Horde, Regthar Deathgate, is recruiting agents for a mission into the land of Desolace. Speak with him if you wish to volunteer. He is stationed in the Barrens, in a series of bunkers west of the Crossroads. And sharpen your weapons. Desolace is a place torn by war.
text.84188: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us. The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the amulet back together. Return to Mokvar and tell him that Bodley is his only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to him about any rewards you've arranged for. I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
text.1259: I don't recognize the name of Lieutenant Paval Reethe. Your best bet would be to check with Adjutant Tesoran. He keeps track of all the records for the Theramore guard, from personnel to their equipment. He should be able to tell you who this Reethe is with a quick check of his books.
text.95284: A small force of Kor'kron soldiers passed through here a few days ago. Never told me why they were here, and I didn't ask. They bought supplies, took a bit of rest, then moved on. The Kor'kron are the elite of the elite and tougher than elekk hooves, but I can't help feeling that something went wrong. I did overhear one of them mention "the island", and there's an island called Alcaz just off the coast. It's a really nasty place. Get some friends and look into what befell these Kor'kron.
text.93227: At first glance, I would wager that the Gelkis are struggling. Their numbers are far fewer than the Magram, and I rarely hear of them stomping around from our scouts. Nonetheless, they are one of the dominant clans in the Desolace and survive to this day. They must be doing something right. If you want to make peace with the Gelkis, take this tote of totems with you to Gelkis Village far to the southwest. Primitive as they may be, they are likely to have a treasurer of some kind.
text.98387: You can't fight a war without weapons. Though the Blackrock orcs have encroached upon these lands, their brazen efforts are not without certain vulnerabilities. Head southeast below Stonewatch Keep, seek out their encampments, and target their weapons and supplies. We'll see just how much of a threat they are without their tools of war.
text.7816: Yo! There be a turtle out there not like the others. She be the Gammerita, leader of the saltwater snapjaws - a downright dirty thievin' reptile. Mon, she stole my best lure. Snapped it right off my line! Since then, the fish just aren't biting the same. Find Gammerita and get my lure out of her stomach.
text.90625: A shredded wing of the Dread Lord Balnazzar is all that remains of the toppled Nathrezim. Someone at Light's Hope may be interested in this.
text.723: <Hammertoe holds his wounds and takes a moment to regain his composure before speaking again.> Find Ryedol, <name>. Bring 'im me amulet. <cough cough> He'll... <cough> figure out what to do. He knows I was seeking the origins of our people, and he... <cough>... knows it was also my mission to stop the Shadowforge clan. They must not be allowed to find the scrolls... <cough>
text.7081: The graveyards in Alterac Valley are prized territories. Both the Horde and the Alliance fight savagely for these sacred grounds. Are you, <name>, ready to join that fight? I want you to assault an enemy graveyard. Find a graveyard with a Horde banner in its midst, and pull it from the ground! Do that, and your task will be complete.... But if you can also hold the graveyard for a few minutes, then our troops will soon come to relieve you.
text.962: The Royal Apothecary Society, based in the great Undercity of Lordaeron, has sent me here for a very specific service, <name>. Perhaps you wish to aid me, and in turn The Dark Lady in our efforts to advance the Forsaken. Recently I studied a rare specimen of flora named Serpentbloom. I believe in greater quantities this herb has great potential. Unfortunately Serpentbloom can only be found in the darkest recesses of the Wailing Caverns, a dangerous cave system located in the Barrens.
text.85598: Zanza can create the ancient troll enchantments with the right components. The first is a primal Hakkari idol that must be taken from the most powerful of the Hakkari lieutenants: Jin'do and the Bloodlord. The second is a punctured voodoo doll. These can be found in the piles of refuse that litter this foul place. Look inside the jinxed hoodoo piles. Bring me these things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
text.8227: Amongst the shattered fishing lures and tackle is a rolled, silken measuring tape. Attached to the tape is a label that reads: "Nat Pagle, Dustwallow Marsh."
text.98830: The air smells sharp and metallic as you reach down to inspect the corpse of Prince Tortheldrin. Extremely powerful magic was just dispelled here. You notice that the corpse before you looks old and weathered, lacking the vitality that the prince exuded before he fell. There are other physical differences as well. One of Tortheldrin's glaives lies near his body, broken in two. The Shen'dralar Ancients will want to know of what you observed here.
text.95143: I've been watching you, <name>. You handle yourself well out here. Perhaps you'd be interested in helping me locate my brother, Tan'jani. He was always searching for something--for what I do not know. I received two messages since he left. The first from another traveler, letting me know he'd run into Tan'jani somewhere south of Loch Modan. The second was a bloodstained letter mentioning Riverglades and somewhere called Rog'mar, even further south. The rest was illegible. Think you can locate him for me?
text.565: I, the great Bartolo, shall make for you the world famous, Alliance renowned, Yeti Fur Cloak! Travel the planet and find yourself a better cloak, I dare you. Oh wait, what is that, little {race}? "Bartolo, there is no finer cloak!" Yes, yes! That, I have heard before. Bartolo requires a Bolt of Wool, a Hillman's Cloak made by a skilled leatherworker, Fine Thread and Yeti Fur, of course! Bring to me these items and you shall be a happy customer!
text.98046: <Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm's gaze narrows.> You're still here? Take the phial and get out of my sight, {class}. It is clear my answers do not lie in the waters, just as they did not before. Perhaps one of the priestesses in the Temple of the Moon to the south will dispose of it. <Fandral looks away, no longer speaking to you.> I must look elsewhere if this is to work...
text.3762: Excuse me {class}, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible. The Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is most interested in seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Hamuul Runetotem is spearheading this research. Please - if you are interested, speak with him directly on the Elder Rise within Thunder Bluff proper.
text.514: I have a colleague in Ironforge who may be able to help decrypt this letter. Go to the Library in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge and speak with Prospector Stormpike. Tell him I sent you and show him the letter. If there's anyone north of Blackrock Spire who can read this, it is he.
text.8395: Winning a war is about more than just outsmarting and outfighting your opponent. Victory often comes down to simply producing more than your enemy. What we have in Arathi Basin is a sizeable supply of resources for whichever side manages to claim it first. If the Alliance comes out victorious, it'll mean more swords and pikes for our troops. If the Horde were to win, those swords and pikes would still get made, they'd just be pointed at us! Now is the time to help the Alliance in Arathi Basin, <name>.
text.478: <You quickly remove the pendant from the crate and replace the lid.>
text.8372: The Silverwing Sentinels are at war with the Warsong Outriders due to the destruction the Orcs are causing to the forest. There are, however, more reasons to defend this particular forest than plain love for nature. The forest forms a strategic barrier that makes Ashenvale defendable against a large-scale attack. Without it, Astranaar would last a day or two before being annexed to the Barrens. Do your part in fighting the Warsong Outriders, <name>! For the Alliance!
text.97196: There is a servant of the Lich King that makes his home deep in the Death's Head quilboar lair known as Razorfen Downs. It is known to us that he makes use of a scrying orb to observe and direct the movements of his minions elsewhere. With this artifact, we'd be able to hunt down the covert agents of the Scourge and put an end to them and the threat they pose to Kalimdor forever. Go into Razorfen Downs to the lair of Amnennar the Coldbringer and retrieve the orb known as the Coldbringer's Eye for me.
text.541: Dwarves aiding the humans? Damn those filthy little beasts. We shall test the strength of the so-called Alliance. We'll see how anxious those little ankle-bashers are to help the humans once they feel our wrath. We know exactly where their stronghold is in this territory. They have established a barracks in southeastern Hillsbrad along Thoradin's Wall called Dun Garok. The final mission of this battle is to lay siege on Dun Garok, {class}. Captain Ironhill, their leader, must die.
text.96301: With the venomous, poisonous heart of the chimaera Ghansurok in hand, soak in the ancient waters of the Well of Eternity. Watch closely how the waters react to the corruption, how nature remembers what systemic corruption has tried to unmake. Bring the organ back to me, and together we will read the signs it bears, and learn whether balance can yet be restored... or if the wound runs too deep.
text.81783: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Warsong Lumber Camp. Find the sleeping Druid of the Claw Alyssian Windcaller there and escort her to safety. Then return to me.
text.99046: The Council of the Forest sent a small group of sentinels to the Oracle Tree some time ago. The tree sends messages to our elders, and it falls to us to deliver them to Darnassus safely. I received word that our most recent runner has not yet arrived. The Oracle's messages vary in frequency, but it has been abnormally long. Please head towards the Oracle Glade along the road to the west and check on her. It would have been Eralya Leafshadow's turn, and she is still in training. Elune guide you.
text.95988: Talked to Gray, didja? Ball of laughs, that guy. Last thing he needs is you gettin' him another drink. This is an inn not a bar. He's lucky I haven't thrown him out. You tryin' to take him with you, be my guest. Though I don't think he's in any condition to go anywhere like that. Not without a little goblin pick-me-up. Why don't ya gather some ingredients for me from this list while I prepare your little friend his 'drink.' We'll see if he still wants booze after he's had my specialty cocktail.
text.5903: I've tried many times to rout out the Scarlet Crusade through force alone, but to no avail. So, as an alternative, I've decided to make their lives more difficult. If you are willing to help, I want to infest that lumber mill with the most terrible species of termites ever found. In Plaguewood, near the once-great Stratholme, there is a breed that survived the plague and the Scourge combined. Find their mounds and fill this jar with them, so we can prepare them to be unleashed on the Crusade.
text.79984: Wirdal? Yeah I know him. He's a gnome, but I won't hold that against him as a fellow transpolyportion enthusiast like myself. He took off outta here a few months back for somewhere in Kalimdor, but he 'ports in every now and then to grab supplies. I could probably transpolyport you to him, but you'd need his coordinates or I'd probably just teleport you into a mountain or something. If you can find his quadrangulation beacons in Kalimdor and attuned to them, that would do the trick!
text.651: Four Stones of Binding are scattered throughout Arathi. These stones keep me pinned beneath the earth. To unlock them you must unlock the strongest: the Stone of Inner Binding. And to do that, you must gather keys from the other three. These stones are watched by guardians, but if you are clever, or lucky, you may find ways to banish them.
text.340: Chapter II was chock full of exciting tales of panther and tiger hunting. I could just kick myself for letting the pages blow away! It seems I was able to recover all of the pages with the exception of pages 10, 11, 14, and 16.
text.128: The Blackrock Clan must be destroyed. The Enemy has invaded our lands. These mountains fall under the sovereign right of the King of Stormwind. Our sources tell us that the leaders of each unit within the Clan are known as Champions. You'll find them in their encampment to the north, just west of the road to the Burning Steppes. Magistrate Solomon wants these foul brutes dead. Slay 15 Blackrock Champions and return to me.
text.526: You might have found one lightforge ingot in that chest, but that's not enough to craft anything decent! You should go back there and look for more. Maybe the murlocs around that wrecked ship have lightforge ingots on them.
text.95196: Listen up. I'm going to walk out that door behind you. Yer gonna wait until I'm good and gone, and then yer gonna meet me behind the graveyard outside o' town. Ensure yer not followed.
text.7500: The tome carries the mark of the Athenaeum.
text.97263: <Several misplaced packages have been left by the mailbox. You note that one of them is marked for delivery from Aerie Peak, to Ironforge, to Eldrun Stormbreaker. It is marked "urgent.">
text.79: I followed the legend of that Stalvan character for years. When those visiting nobles were slaughtered a few years back I went with Haggard to investigate. I found these muddy pages but we were never able to link the handwriting to that crazy man in the woods. Your trail of evidence proves his guilt. Take this to Commander Ebonlocke immediately and fill her in on what you've discovered!
text.82018: Are you familiar with the Temple of Atal'Hakkar? It has a storied history that I will not retell here, but it is currently under the stewardship of a host of mighty green dragons. The chief guardian of the temple is a great dragon named Eranikus, and he is known to be particularly attuned to the dream. It is my hope that he may be able to aid us. Go to the Swamp of Sorrows and meet with the ranger there known as Itharius. He may know how to reach out to Eranikus to petition his aid.
text.5721: Now, <name>, you will take part in battle of Darrowshire, and you will save Joseph Redpath. Place this relic bundle in the Darrowshire town square, and the spirits of Darrowshire will rise. Join their battle and assure that these two things come to pass: Davil must survive beyond the death of Horgus, and Redpath must survive to be corrupted, then defeated. After defeating the corrupted Redpath, his spirit will be saved. Speak with him, then return to his daughter Pamela.
text.5236: You carefully close the spigot in the control panel, watching the cauldron's putrid ichors drip into the empty bottle. With the poison in hand, it is time to return to Shadow Priestess Vandis at the Bulwark to complete the mission.
text.93156: Aye then, do you not believe me? I may be a drunkard, but I tell you true that the foresht is haunted by a twisted pygmy spirit... ghost... demon... thing! *hic* He were shmall in stature, but his magics are deadly as the day is long. His lair is filled to the brim with terrible totems of power that can turn you to dusht! The foresht spirits shwarm him and protect him. If you ever see him for yourself, you'll know. You'll know! *hic*
text.9048: You will find the remnants of our fallen heroes on the corpses of the Lords of Naxxramas. Bring those desecrated keepsakes to me along with wartorn plate scraps and crafting materials capable of revitalizing the cursed armor and I shall craft a fine piece of armor for you.
text.1219: Sifting through the loose dirt, the severed hand of an orc is found. And clutched in the hand is a bone-carved tube. And in the tube is a dirt-stained parchment. The parchment is written in orcish... and it looks important.
text.95064: The orcs have become an encroaching threat ever since their arrival. First, claiming the lands by the river and now their presence grows within the plains... I'll never understand their kind, nor do I care, truth be told, but I'll be damned if they think there's more ground to be taken.
text.9109: I make no pretenses, maggot. The darkness Plagueheart items hold could very well destroy the both of us. That is why the price is so high. If I'm going to die, it's going to be as a rich man. And I don't give an ounce of gnoll spit how you die, only that you do as I ask. Bring me what I require and we will both benefit - or die; but I've already explained this...
text.92343: The burrow you speak of is a tunnel to Blackmaw Hold. In the past, the furbolg have guarded it fiercely, making it inaccessible to outsiders. With this satyr situation, however, we can get inside. So close to Nordrassil, there would be actively growing roots. Older roots can be seen on the world's surface, but newer ones can only be found deep underground. Little is known of their magical properties. If you were to bring me some samples to study, the druids of Thunder Bluff would be in your debt.
text.91611: If you wish for a true test of angling prowess, there are bigger fish than you can catch with a rod. Mammoth Sharks lurk in the deepest waters of the northern and southern coasts. They swim far out, right before the sea floor drops away into the great ocean. They are massive creatures. I would advise you to bring a hunting party. If you do go after one, bring me a cut of the meat.
text.98971: This was once a helm of sorts, though it is difficult to tell it now in its twisted form. We can restore it, however. Like all things, there is a cost to this. Go to the bastion of Blackrock Spire and claim the left eye of the false warchief, Rend Blackhand. From there, reach the pinnacle of the stronghold and claim the right eye of General Drakkisath, chief agent of the Lord of Blackrock. Do this and you will remove two great evils from the world. Then I will cleanse the artifact you hold.
text.99036: The Lich called Ras Frostwhisper resides on the isle of Caer Darrow, in the Cult of the Damned training grounds known as the Scholomance. This creature has a number of alchemical components of some value, including a sample of Everfrost taken from the Frozen Throne itself. I need you to retrieve it for me. Oh, and while you are there, I also want you to dispose of the headmaster of the school, Gandling. Bring me his signet as proof.
text.874: You have hunted the beasts of the Barrens. Your spirit is strong. But a hunter must always be prepared. A true hunter can stalk prey down any path. Mountains and swamps will not sway him. Not even the sea. Find my sister, Mahren. She hunts the great water beasts along the coast. She will be your teacher in their ways. But be wary in your search for her, for the Barrens' coast is held by humans.
text.6162: My husband traveled Felwood for the honor of our clan, doing battle against the Shadow Council and other corrupt atrocities! After he escaped death numerous times, I received a letter from him saying that a druid asked him for help against a great befouled furbolg named Overlord Ror--the two were never heard from again. I want this Ror's clawed hand, <name>. I want it to pay for leaving me a widow! I believe the creature is to the south... near the Ashenvale border.
text.98916: There have been many battles at Darkspear Islands. However, they still be too close for our liking. This next one, defeat the Alliance while controlling all the outposts. Do this and show the dominance of the Darkspear Raiders.
text.93444: The most vicious fel chimaera of Hyjal is known as Ghansurok. It likes to swoop in and prey on wildlife caught out of their burrows. Not only that, it's making hippogryph travel in and out of Hyjal more stressful than usual! First, hunt down one of the Nightsabers hiding in the Summit's shadows. Next, place meat from the fallen cat somewhere on the northern ridge where chimaeras feed. Lure Ghansurok towards it. Slay the beast and return with its heart. Marn will study it to help heal Hyjal.
text.92545: You have performed your part well, <name>. I have a quest of my own. There is a force here, demonic in nature. This otherworldly evil has permeated this mountain for an age. I have seen its corrupting influence reaching out like greedy black tendrils. As this evil sleeps, it dreams, and its dreams bring madness for any that its corruption may touch. Come, step closer to the fire with me. We shall learn the name of this beast, and in so doing, obtain the means of its undoing.
text.8534: We've sent our best scouts deep into the silithid hives to gather intelligence. Scout Azenel has been watching the silithid movements at Hive'Zora for several days now. Find her and obtain a written report. We need to be able to act on that information as soon as possible, <name>.
text.9071: Would you honor me by returning the armor of those that fell in the defense of these lands? The armor has been desecrated and is undoubtedly being used for evil; however, with wartorn armor scraps, the desecrated armor can be renewed and worn for battle once more. Bring me the remnants of the fallen along with purification materials and Earthshatter shall be yours to don. Search Naxxramas.
text.819: A small placard on one of the ends of the keg says, "Chen Stormstout- May your spirit be raised and always raise your spirits."
text.902: Pulling open the face of the control console reveals a dense jumble of wires, tubing and other strange mechanical objects--most of which seem to serve no practical purpose. Pushing them aside and digging deeper into the console, you find the samophlange. A tug removes it from its housing.
text.95787: <Loremaster Dibbs' hands shake as he reads the scouting report and the troll legends.> Could it be? By this account it sounds like the lost troll city of I'lalai has risen just off the coast of Stranglethorn! We must investigate immediately. Why, if my research is correct this could be the archeological discovery of the century! Please, I know it is a long trek back to Stranglethorn but if you find yourself in this Drowned City, collect any legends you find there and return them to me.
text.2903: With the battle plans of the gnolls discovered, all that now remains is to bring the plans back to Hadoken Swiftstrider in Camp Mojache. Perhaps he or someone there can make further sense of what the gnolls are up to.
text.8910: Well met, {class}. I've something that might interest you. I have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor. The blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment. Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. You shall find the effort worth your while.
text.6146: I have made some adjustments to this command. Should our little ruse work, they will expose the Scarlet Oracle and we shall strike! Now pay attention, {class}. You are to deliver this command to the Crusader Lord, Valdelmar. How? You are going to hand it to him, imbecile. Take the command and this rotten apple to Tyr's Hand. When you cross into the city, eat the apple. You will transform into something more... palatable to the humans. Take the command and hand it to the Crusader Lord, Valdelmar.
text.1007: I would charge you with a task, <name>. I was on my small vessel, skimming over the submerged ruins of Zoram, when naga attacked me, surging from the water and tearing at me with their claws! I fled, carrying what supplies I could to make this meager camp. But when I reached the shore and ran... my prized possession was lost. Please, <name>, find the site of my ambush, along the coast to the north, and search for an ancient statuette. It is the reason I have braved the dangers of the Zoram Strand.
text.564: Ain't nothin' that irks me more than losin' these here beautiful horses. And believe me, we've lost quite a few between them pesky undead creeps, the dang Syndicate gang and all the other good-for-nothin' scoundrels pokin' about these parts. But I swear on my ol' grand-daddy's grave there ain't no bigger menace to our horses here than them Mountain Lions up in Alterac. Always comin' down from the hills and makin' my life difficult! You fancy yourself a hero? Go and do somethin' about it then!
text.8622: The unmentionable Old God slowly awakens from his slumber beneath Ahn'Qiraj. The terrible fate that awaits Azeroth could come in days or years; time has no meaning for beings of his power. When the stars are favorable, he will lash out against all living beings with terrible wrath. You must find him before then and find a way to bring his existence to an end. Do this and bring me a piece of his husk. I shall grant you armor no mortal has ever worn... armor fit for one who has slain a god!
text.92544: A band of Al'Aketh cult ruffians have taken up residence near the temple ruins just southwest of here, led by a real monster called Malduko Cloudcrush. This rabble has no doubt been dispatched here by High Priestess Lorthuna at the Shrine of Akir to attack travelers and coerce our people into joining the cult. I need to stay here at my post to alert travelers leaving the grove of the danger, but I would be grateful if you could do something about those cultists and their leader for me.
text.1100: You slowly open the weathered journal of Henrig Lonebrow....
text.93036: You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but it's obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer. You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.
text.97200: Ey, welcome {class}! Ya now be seasoned enough as an adventurer for me to teach you how to ride one of our raptors, for a fee of course. Zjolnir will provide ya with a free mount once you have trained with me, and after you will be able to purchase any additional mounts ya would like. There are many creatures out in the world, and each requires their own riding skill, but ya will have to find trainers for each. Speak to me when ya have enough gold, and I will teach ya about raptor riding.
text.93833: The owls of Hyjal are more than feathers and flight. Their talons, their plumes, even the bones whisper of the wild. We use these gifts to craft talismans, charms that bind the spirits and shield our kin. But the owls do not give freely. You must take what the mountain offers. Kill oa owls and bring their carcasses to me. Yes, we ask you to return the whole body to us, as we waste nothing provided by such graceful creatures.
text.7886: You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. Continue to aid the cause and bring me more talismans of merit. Do this, and you will earn even more of our trust.
text.8761: Never have I seen such tenacity! The Bronze Flight grants you one final enchantment. The Timeless One himself has requested it so! Hand me your signet ring so that I may make the necessary adjustments.
text.8246: <name> - for someone as exalted among the Zandalar as you are, I have something very special for you. Direct from our home in the South Seas... the Signets of the Zandalar! These signets are used to enhance any shoulder item you may possess. Should you seek might, mojo, or serenity - I have what you need! I ask for fifteen Zandalar Honor Tokens in exchange for your choice of one signet. If you have the tokens ready, then I'm ready to make a deal!
text.6881: The Frostwolf Clan is protected by a taint of elemental energy. Their shaman meddle in powers that will surely destroy us all if left unchecked. The damage has grown too great for the Circle to control! Ivus must be called to our aid. The Frostwolf soldiers carry elemental charms called storm crystals. We can use the charms to conjure Ivus. Venture forth and claim the crystals, <name>!
text.9059: I have discovered a use for the carapace of the crypt fiend. I am able to fashion an extremely light and very deadly set of armor by combining the fragments with some of the desecrated magical armors lost in Naxxramas. Bring me the items I require and I shall fashion for you a suit of armor the likes of which has never before been seen in our world!
text.95569: The owls are under threat by the fel corruption that afflicts the mountainside, and the creatures poisoned and enraged by those energies. Many owls have abandoned their nests for safer places higher up the mountain. Others have fallen in defense of their young. For the owls to have a future, their eggs must be protected and their fledglings nurtured. Bring the abandoned eggs to me. You may find eggs in abandoned nests at the base of trees north and east of here.
text.91564: We've been stuck here for five years, and we've had to build everything from scratch! Do you know how much I've had to improvise just to do any engineering? Hey, if you can help me out with some materials, I can make it worth your time! Build me a couple of Mithril Casings and a Mechanical Repair Kit so that I can fix up some stuff, and I'll show you a few things I've figured out.
text.50: I'll mix and mix till we have a mash For this will be our own private stash A still must be fashioned of metal strong Bring me some Truesilver so I can finish this song.
text.7141: The Explorers' League believes there are artifacts in Alterac Valley, but the Frostwolf orcs won't let us explore. We can't allow the Horde to stop our scholarly pursuits! Defeat the Frostwolf general, Drek'Thar. With him dead, the orcs will lose their edge. Drek'Thar is in Frostwolf Keep, in the south of Alterac Valley. Vanquish him, and then return to me.
text.84185: Valthalak's soul was stored in this amulet. In our greed we foolishly split it into three parts, not knowing the curse that would await us. The only way to stop Valthalak's spell is to put the medallion back together. Return to Deliana and tell her that Bodley is her only hope for finding the remaining pieces. Speak to her about any rewards you've arranged for. I, for once, shall rest in peace. I wish you the best of luck; you shall need every bit of it!
text.5221: The Scourge's plague cauldron stands before you, spewing vast amounts of toxins into the air. A small, non-descript access panel lies in the base of the cauldron's vast platform. Having already defeated the cauldron lord and acquired its key, you are free to add the appropriate reagents to the cauldron to make a counter agent to the plague.
text.95327: Looks like a deal's a deal. The Venture Co. got their comeuppance, Friz gets her loot, and everybody's happy. Overall a pretty smooth transaction if I do say so myself. Now scram, I got another shipment comin' in soon from some Southsea Pirates.
text.7924: You have proven your value to our efforts in Warsong Gulch. Continue to rage against the Silverwing Sentinels! Bring me more marks of honor!
text.93685: Can your miniscule brain comprehend the rarity of a flawless sphere of draenethyst, {race}? Draenei have spent lifetimes in search of just one of these crystals, only to meet horrible fates, their purpose unfulfilled. So you stand before Kum'isha, knowing what Kum'isha has requested and still wish to assist? Very well, {race}... At any time during your travels across these lands, should you find a flawless sphere of draenethyst, return it to me and I shall reward you with riches beyond your wildest dreams.
text.666: The treasure has been on the sea floor so long that the gems have calcified into thick stone. But the power harnessed in these goggles will allow you to locate them easily. A little gnomish ingenuity goes a long way! So borrow the Goggles of Gem Hunting, <name>, and see if you can collect some of the lost treasure for Captain O'Breen. I'd swim down there myself but...um...well, I have important scientific business to tend to up on the safe, dry land....er, yeah.
text.94487: The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed us with no warning, though their motives remain a mystery to me. I knew these cultists had clouds between their ears, but I never imagined they would upset the delicate balance here on Zephras with such brutality. Go, slay as many as you can and take their heirlooms if they wear any. <Elegael spits.> These storm-cursed cultists don't deserve to be called shen'dorei. The beasts of the forest can have their bodies. Their ashes don't deserve the winds.
text.84777: While you have proven yourself to me, you may need to continue to work toward proving yourself to the suspicious brethren of my tribe. To that end, I may be able to continue assisting you. Some of the Deadwood furbolgs wear a distinctive headdress that may be used as a means of proof in thinning their numbers. Bring me a feather from any headdresses you acquire; for every set of five you bring me, you will earn recognition amongst the Timbermaw.
text.93041: This discovery is devastating for our clan, but it is in our best interest to keep this only to those who need to know. Uthek is one such person who needs to be aware of what is going on here. I suspect she will know how to proceed. Take this to show her. For good measure, we should also bring evidence of the necromancy itself to her. Find a skull that looks recently cursed. I suspect they may be hoarding them in the maws of one of the goliath's skeletons.
text.98407: If the gnolls are growing so bold they are willing to camp this close to humans, there's no telling how much further they'll go. We need to deter them. The beasts are hardly organized, but they seem to respect strength above all else. If we can slay the worst of them, maybe claim some of their trophies, we can remind these gnolls why they should stay in the hills where they belong. Should you see any of their thrashers, bring me their collars. That should put the fear of the Alliance back into them.
text.5386: The smell of cooked fish has long been missing here at Ghost Walker Post. The trolls at Shadowprey Village are the best at catching fish... but alas, with all the centaur activities I have little time to make a journey to the trolls. Hrm... Do me a favor and journey to Shadowprey Village. Talk to the local fisherman Jinar'Zillen and bring me back my favorite, Bloodbelly fish. The road south of here will take you west to the troll village.
text.85612: King Rastakhan sends his regards, Master <name>. Such an honor has never been given to one outside the Zandalar tribe. <Jin'rokh bows.> Give me your talisman so that I may enhance it once more. Know that the Rage of Mugamba is now intrinsically connected to your very soul.
text.85602: Zanza can create the ancient troll enchantments with the right components. The first is a primal Hakkari idol that must be taken from the most powerful of the Hakkari lieutenants: Jin'do and the Bloodlord. The second is a punctured voodoo doll. These can be found in the piles of refuse that litter this foul place. Look inside the jinxed hoodoo piles. Bring me these things and I will create a powerful enchantment for you!
text.8778: The Ironforge Brigade has put in an unusual request for highly... volatile... components. Gather them and bring them to Mr. Nozzlespring from the Ironforge Brigade.
text.78926: Foolish blood elves toil with demonic magic. Have they not witnessed what happened with the naga and with the satyrs of Kalimdor? I fear that the blood elves will meet a similar deformation. Azeroth cannot afford to give birth to another vile race of monsters. I wish to study the brain stems of the satyr and naga so that I might deduce what fate the elves are headed toward. In Blackfathom Deeps, on the coast of Ashenvale, you will find both satyr and naga. 'Tis a long journey, <name>.
text.4245: Checking to see if your prepared to lead A-Me 01 back to Karna Remtravel, you flip the switch to the "Off" position. Glancing around once again to make sure none of the gorillas are coming, you prepare to see what happens when you flip the switch back to the "On" position. This is your last chance... are you sure this is what you want to do?
text.99051: It wouldn't be the first time those snakes bothered us. They need to be taught that their presence is not tolerated here. Find where their scouts are setting up camp and slaughter them. Bring me back their fins as proof. We need to act fast to make sure they understand.
text.786: Lower your voice, {class}. The Kolkar centaurs lie just over the ridge to the west in Kolkar Crag. Last night while they were raiding, I snuck into their village and discovered that the dirty beasts have a three-tiered attack planned on the trolls and orcs of Durotar. We mustn't let their invasion come to fruition. Perhaps you can muster the might needed to infiltrate Kolkar Crag and destroy their attack plans. Last I saw, they had divided them up amongst three of their leaders.
text.601: The water elementals were no doubt summoned by Gazban, the goblin wizard rumored to have discovered the Stone of the Tides. As you may know, the Stone of the Tides curses its bearer, causing him to fade in and out of existence... Perhaps we can find a way to counteract the curse. We can have a mage of Dalaran analyze the magical residue of one of the water elemental's bracers. I need you to go back to the island and retrieve a few specimens.
text.8659: It is said among us that the ornate shoulder armor worn by the mortal races started as an attempt to emulate the wings of a dragon. Bring me the bindings worn by the highest Qiraji leaders and I shall shape them into a set of pauldrons more dreadful than even the wings of Nefarian himself!
text.8765: Champion, should you decide to walk another path, present me with your signet ring and a mountain of scarabs from our enemies in Ahn'Qiraj.
text.94928: These hides are to be delivered to Powderfuse Port. It is a goblin-run port to the northeast. When you get there, deliver the hides to Friz Frazzlespark. Tell her they're from Cornelius. The details of our trade have already been worked out, so she'll know what they are for.
text.96084: I will spare you the grisly details, but these soldiers are violently ill. The nature of their sickness leads me to believe there is an issue with either their food or their water. I've already checked the crops coming in from the nearby farms, so this only leaves the water, which comes from the local rivers. The best place to collect a sample is from the pools in the plains to the north. Nearly every river runs through the area, so it would be wise to check for contamination there.
text.9198: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order. Work Order EN-558: 14 Thorium Tubes. All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged. -Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
text.370: The strategic documents from Executor Arren contain all the details we need to wipe the human infestation from the lands. According to the information, The Scarlet Crusade has assigned Captain Perrine and a brigade to the ruined tower southwest of Brill. Kill Perrine along with 3 Zealots and 3 Missionaries and report back to me.
text.98430: Hail, {class}. What brings you deep into such a dark and violent place? I was sent here by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof as a part of our efforts to communicate with the gnolls that have taken residence. The rest of my mission must remain a secret, as do all things with the Longwalkers, the trusted scouts of our chieftain. All you must know is our diplomacy was met with violence, and I fear I may be tonight's feast for the gnolls if you do not help me escape. Are you up to the task?
text.5902: Now that we have plenty of termites, take this steel reinforced barrel to the Northridge Lumber Mill south of Hearthglen--you'll find it to the west of the road that leads you up to the town. Once there, place the barrel in the center of the lumber mill; someplace high, like on a crate or something. After you open it, the rest should take care of itself. Just come back here and I'll reward you for helping me.
text.1010: There is a plant that once grew in the old ruins of Bathran's Haunt to the north. The plant was called Bathran's Hair and was known to cure ailments of the spirit. There is a sick child in the village, and I believe it is more than just a physical illness. Will you go to Bathran's Haunt and search it for Bathran's Hair? I may need it to properly treat the child. Bathran's Haunt lies north of Maestra's Post and just south of the border to Darkshore.
text.98545: Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery. You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time. <Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>
text.307: The Silver Stream Mine to the east ran dry long ago. It was converted by the Miners' League into a storage depot, but now Kobolds have moved in, putting their filthy paws on good, Dwarven tools! We'll root out those vermin soon enough, but the League wants someone to get their gear out of the mine before we warriors tromp in there and break things. It'll be a tough delve - you might want cohorts at your side. The gear is stored in Miners' League Crates throughout the mine. Good luck.
text.8458: I believe I can find this demon lord given the proper reagents. If he is indeed as powerful as I suspect, I will need items gathered from deadly creatures. But you act in the Warchief's name, so I am sure you will accept my task. First, I will have to break any wards he has against scrying. For this, I will need the scalp from a satyr--but not any satyr. The scalp must come from a Hatefury shadowstalker. Search for them among the ancient ruins in the northeast of Desolace.
text.95418: Me done with Twilight. Clubtoe free ogre now. Me go find Clugfist. He biggestest ogre Clubtoe ever see. He leave Twilight. Take many friends with him. It Clubtoe's turn. Me join free ogres. They go to the hills. Clubtoe miss hills. No more smashing rocks. Maybe you come sometime? Me stay here till coast is clear. You take Chogg'Zac's heads back to friends. Well. Maybe one head. Me get one too. Fair trade.
text.1422: While I begin work on your weapon, why don't you talk to Katar? He mentioned needing help with patrols along the beach, and I'd rather see you keep your wits and weapons prepared instead of getting drunk with some of the other louses I share this camp with.
text.9203: The bearer of this writ is entitled to payment in the form of an insignia of their choice upon completion of the contracted work order. Work Order AL-90: 1 Flask of Petrification. All filled orders should be delivered to Packmaster Stonebruiser at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. Contract is null and void if tampered with or damaged. -Dispatch Commander Metz, The Argent Dawn
text.93836: Muln has told me much of the elemental lords and I am afraid that we have good reason to fear Al'Akir. Now that the wards that have hidden Zephras from his view are down, we are utterly defenseless. If he chooses to attack us, we stand no chance against him here in his own domain. High Elder Shadowsong needs to know of the danger we are in, and more importantly, what our intentions are for our mission to Azeroth. We will find the means to save our home. I swear it.
text.6301: Industrial greed and continuous war have wrecked the lands of Stonetalon. Only the blessings of the Earthmother can cure such injury. <name>, I will require you to seek a special seed, the Gaea seed. They are only found here in Stonetalon Mountain, north of Sun Rock Retreat at Mirkfallon Lake, near the water's edge. Once you bring me the seeds I will imbue them with shamanistic power to speed their growth.
text.6922: The defeated water elemental has left behind a strange water globe. You surmise that the object somehow fed the beast energy. Inside the globe, a putrid-looking form of water sloshes about. The globe itself seems impervious to any sort of physical force. If anyone can make any sense of this item, it would be Je'neu Sancrea of the Earthen Ring. He is located at the Horde's Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale.
text.4295: Oh, ale! I would kill for some Dark Iron ale!! Quick, I'm getting sober! I know this because sobriety blurs my vision... and it's making you look like the {race} I slew last week!
text.597: The map shows Booty Bay with a red "X" drawn precisely at the spot at which you are standing. The scribbled text reads: "You men are to secure a camp at this location and keep quiet. Wait for the signal from the southern command post before attacking. If anyone approaches you, kill them."
text.84163: You kept your word and brought the device built by Mux. I believe a reward is in order if I'm to keep you interested in saving my skin. Bring me the belt and set of gloves that you wish to upgrade. I promise the ones I give you in return will be far superior.
text.7703: Now you da king, so maybe you get prized Gordok artifact back from creepy elf who calls himself Prince! Da king before you failed, just like all da other kings since Tortheldrin - da creepy elf - stole it from old timey Gordok king! Artifact is called da Gauntlet of Gordok Might. Old timey stories say only da one true king da Gordok can get it back. Old timey story also say creepy elf is still around here - you find it and it will become mighty gauntlet you wear forever! Yar, I show you!
text.99042: The Lich called Ras Frostwhisper resides on the isle of Caer Darrow, in the Cult of the Damned training grounds known as the Scholomance. This creature has a number of alchemical components of some value, including a sample of Everfrost taken from the Frozen Throne itself. I need you to retrieve it for me. Oh, and while you are there, I also want you to dispose of the headmaster of the school, Gandling. Bring me his signet as proof.
text.7702: If we want to put a dent in the productivity of the Dark Iron forces working out of the Slag Pit, we have to hit them where it's going to hurt the most. It's a little known fact but dwarves, particularly of the Dark Iron variety, need rest! Lots of rest! Now I ask you; How can they sleep without pillows? Exactly, <name>, they can't. This is why you must weasel your way into the Slag Pit and steal their pillows.
text.538: <name>. If you don't mind a long journey then I have a task for you, to again help Stormwind fill its library. The old kingdom of Alterac fell after the great war, and it had a large collection of books. It's a tragedy that the city is ruined, but even more tragic is all of their knowledge lost! We must recover what we can. Southshore is the closest town to the Ruins of Alterac. Go there and speak with Loremaster Dibbs. He can direct you to the ruins, and to what books may be found there.
text.1477: Our mages are conducting research at Nethergarde Keep in the Blasted Lands, research vital to our understanding of the Dark Portals. They require nearly constant supplies, but our supply line to Nethergarde is tenuous. You must help ensure the supplies make it to Nethergard. Report to Watchmaster Sorigal in Darkshire, and do as he asks. This task will take you into hostile lands, <name>. Prepare yourself.
text.8502: As the war effort mounts, the silithid presence in the area presents an ever increasing threat to our operations. You've been selected to partake on an assault on Hive'Ashi where your primary target will consist of Hive'Ashi workers. Report back to Commander Mar'alith after your task is completed.
text.98059: Hillsbrad's council hasn't answered our new magistrate's letters. The last word I pried out of a passing merchant from the town did little to justify their silence. We're only asking for a small platoon--yet I'm told multiple siege ballista rest in pristine condition within a walled-off compound. Walk into their town hall like a citizen returning a census request, and place this neatly upon the bookkeeping table. Return to me when the deed is done.
text.84152: Well met, {class}. I've something that might interest you. I have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality. I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor. The blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment. Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold. You shall find the effort worth your while.
text.87377: Bring me any doomed souls that cross your path, <name>. Let me rephrase that - you MUST bring them to me. MY duty is to stay and guide the souls of the lost. YOUR duty is to bring them to me. A word of advice, never handle more than one soul at a time. Trust me, your soul can only handle so much, and your mind... well... it can handle even less. This burden is now yours. Because you can, you must. Consider this a moral obligation.
text.1339: I hear Mountaineer Stormpike is looking for a runner. Someone to do a little traveling for him. How about it? Are you the {race} for the job? If so, then you'll find Stormpike at the top of the northern guard tower.
text.78265: I'm going to need fish oil - and a lot of it!
text.9117: <Father Montoy makes some strange gestures in the air in front of you.> Blessed boy, have you found the vestments of the fallen? The poor souls whose last breaths were taken on the field of battle - stripped of everything including their dignity. Bring me the desecrated remnants of the departed along with reagents of purification and you shall know faith.
text.4450: Oh, you know what? That reminds me. You wanna finish up a little job I took up while I was in Tanaris? It's easy... Krinkle Goodsteel in Gadgetzan was lookin' for some stuff found here in Searing Gorge and a few other places. Maybe you could take a look at the list and then bring it all to him? I'll just slide his ledger under the door if you're interested. Take that, and the stuff he wants back to him after ya collected it all.
text.3783: My friends are always coming up with great ideas. I've never felt like I could match them... until today! I just drew up the plans for something great! If you promise not to tell, I'll let you in on the secret... I'm going to make a mechanical yeti! Not only are my friends sure to be freaked out when they see it, but when they get over that, I know they'll be impressed! I need thick yeti fur from the ice thistle yeti to start with. Will you help? You'll find them to the southeast.
text.5: I've been stuck hiding in this ghost town for weeks, and I haven't eaten anything but grubs and weeds! I need some decent food, and I'm willing to trade well for it. Bring me a feast and I'll pay you handsomely. I heard Chef Grual at the Scarlet Raven Tavern in Darkshire makes very good Dusky Crab Cakes...
text.8667: The Twin Emperors... their incessant whispers are slowly taking a toll on my sanity. They mock me, knowing I cannot step further into their domain to save my brother Arygos. In my visions I see their monstrous faces adorned by powerful crowns. But I will have my revenge... I will transmute these symbols of Qiraji power to ones better suited to our needs. Bring me the components I require, <name>. I will give you a headpiece of unmatched power.
text.79981: This C.O.R.E. unit definitely fits the description that Ziri gave you, but it's badly damaged and covered in gunk. You can barely make out a faded sticker with what appears to be contact information for some sort of warranty. Only a few letters are visible. "Limi... arranty... claims contac.... Wi..... nde...ar"
text.95385: <Faint magic emanates from the scrap of scroll. The language is unfamiliar, though you intuit that it is not dangerous. Most would find the parchment useless, but there may be a unique collector that may find some use out of it.>
text.99023: There's power in a creature's heart. It's the core of one's life, and without it, the living cease to live. I sometimes miss the beating of my own heart, though I acknowledge that requiring a pulse to live is... strictly a liability. Travel to the Shaper's Terrace overlooking Un'goro Crater and retrieve the still-beating heart of the great Direhorn Matriarch there, as well as the hardened heart of the watcher, Nanaya. Do this and I will cleanse the armor piece you carry.
text.88721: Greetings, friend. Have you insignias of the Dawn or the Crusade that you would like to redeem for items of power? I must warn you; purchases made at a friendly reputation with the Dawn come with a hefty surcharge. I would advise that you gain a better reputation with the Dawn before moving forward with your plans.
text.8119: <Maywiki points to your talisman.> Look at it, <name>! It's come alive. The spirits dance around the orb. Give it to Maywiki so she can make one last adjustment.
text.89329: Disgusting. This place has become infested with rotting nerubian drones. I would see them destroyed.
text.97530: A merchant caravan took a wrong turn through the desert and got jumped by the Dunemaul ogres. Only reason they made it out alive is 'cause they tossed some cargo overboard to distract the brutes. Must be this merchant's got friends with the nobs runnin' ships and zeppelins, 'cause now they want ME pickin' up what got lost. I'm stuck here working. But if YOU see a nice shiny bangle while you're beatin' on ogres, I'll make it worth ya while.
text.1039: Ratchet is the only port in the Barrens. Most likely Velinde found a trading vessel in Ratchet to take her to Blackwater Cove in Azeroth. We've had limited dealings with the goblins that run the port, but the master of the dock should have information about the comings and goings of ship passengers. Follow the road southeast through Ashenvale and you will find yourself in the Barrens. Watch your step, <name>, warriors of the Horde patrol the land. You will be safe at the port, though.
text.842: Take this signed recruitment letter to the Crossroads. Sergra Darkthorn, curse her hide, is in charge there. She's a nasty shaman who will talk your head in circles before she lets you do anything useful. Thrall is convinced she's something special, but I'm not so sure. You'll just have to decide for yourself, pup...
text.6662: Me brother, Nipsy, runs a rat kabob operation on the other side of Deeprun. Ye needs to take this here crate o' rats to him before they go bad. Get a move on! Ye have ridden a tram before, aye? It's easy. Just step aboard when she arrives and enjoy the ride. An' keep yer arms and legs inside durin' the ride, lest ye be peglegged fer life.
text.8484: Your deeds go beyond the tale of a simple hero, <name>. If you are a representative of your people, then your people are ones we would work to make peace with. Please - take this offering to the dwarven king that resides in a mountain of iron; I believe you call this city Ironforge. In times past, he had tried to make contact with us on behalf of his Alliance. It is now only fitting to acknowledge you as the key in your Alliance's efforts in brokering peace.
text.7401: By order of Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl, all dwarves on the field of battle are to be killed on sight. Should you slay a dwarf in combat, rip out their spine, leaving a spineless heap of stink and rot to serve as a warning to any and all that dare oppose the might of the Frostwolf. Return to Sergeant Yazra Bloodsnarl with proof of your heroics.
